title_cn: 发展银发经济:目标定位与关键问题
title_en: Developing the Silver Economy:Strategic Goals and Key Issues
authors_en_and_affiliations: DU Yang(Institute of Population and Labor Economics,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences)
institutions_cn: 中国社会科学院人口与劳动经济研究所
index_title: 发展银发经济:目标定位与关键问题
abstract_cn: 发展银发经济,既是积极应对人口老龄化国家战略的重要组成部分,也是顺应人口老龄化形势变化以及经济增长动能转换的重大变革而提出的重要政策举措。应通过发展银发经济,为老年群体提供更高质量和更有价格竞争力的适老产品和养老服务。发展银发经济,应该充分利用人口结构变化中的积极因素,推动形成银发经济规模效应,充分发挥市场机制的决定性作用,激发老年群体参与经济活动的积极性,以普惠实用为导向优化农村适老产品与养老服务供给体系。鉴于农村地区的人口老龄化程度比城镇地区高,因地制宜促进农村地区银发经济的发展,不仅有助于满足农村老年群体的生活与服务需求,也有助于扎实推进乡村全面振兴。
abstract_en: As an important component of the national strategy to actively respond to population aging,developing the silver economy has been proposed as a major policy initiative in response to demographic changes and the transformation of economic growth drivers.From the perspective of development orientation,the silver economy should not be simply regarded as a new major engine of economic growth.A more appropriate positioning is to provide better age-friendly products and higher-quality elderly care services for the elderly population through developing the silver economy.Due to the accelerated aging process,industries related to population aging(such as healthcare and social services)have continuously expanded in scale,but their contribution to overall economic growth is less prominent than that of other sectors(such as transportation equipment and real estate).Therefore,the focus of developing the silver economy should be on improving the quality of life for the elderly population,meeting their multi-level and diversified needs through optimizing the supply system,enhancing their well-being,and enabling them to share the achievements of development and enjoy a happy later life.The development of the silver economy requires attention to several key issues.First,fully utilize the advantages of economies of scale.China has a large elderly population,and even segmented markets may achieve economies of scale,thereby continuously improving the specialization and economic efficiency of the silver economy.Moreover,the silver economy,when combined with China's strong manufacturing base,will inevitably form a new industry with international competitiveness.Second,give full play to the decisive role of market mechanisms.Producer services that support manufacturing remain underdeveloped,and the legal environment compatible with a market economy also needs to be improved.It is necessary to guide the market to develop in a regulated and orderly manner,promote sound competition,and properly handle the relationship between the public attributes of elderly services and market mechanisms.Third,stimulate the participation of the elderly population in economic activities.The accumulation and utilization of human capital among the elderly should be strengthened,and an employment-friendly labor market system should be established to create a better institutional environment for the elderly to participate in the labor market.Fourth,attach importance to heterogeneity within the elderly population.Significant differences exist between urban and rural elderly populations in terms of income level,income sources,and income stability;therefore,the development of the silver economy should be adapted to local conditions.Compared with urban areas,rural regions experience a higher degree of population aging,warranting targeted policy attention.The rural silver economy should be guided by the basic needs of older residents and emphasize the public service attributes of age-friendly products and elderly care.It should also be closely integrated with the rural revitalization strategy.Beyond improving basic services,efforts should explore the development and utilization of human resources among the rural elderly.

title_cn: 农村基本养老保险待遇优化:调整策略与财政补贴测算
title_en: Optimization of Rural Basic Pension Insurance Benefits:Adjustment Strategies and Fiscal Subsidy Calculations
authors_cn: 陈丹青 | 杨三思 | 唐建军
authors_en_and_affiliations: CHEN Danqing;YANG Sansi;TANG Jianjun(School of Agricultural Economics and Rural Development,Renmin University of China)
institutions_cn: 中国人民大学农业与农村发展学院
index_title: 农村基本养老保险待遇优化:调整策略与财政补贴测算
abstract_cn: 党的二十届三中全会和2025年中央“一号文件”明确指出,要逐步提高城乡居民基本养老保险基础养老金,对确定养老金待遇目标和建立动态增长机制提出了新要求。本文分析了农村基本养老保险待遇偏低的现状及主要原因,提出待遇调整目标及方案,并基于人均财政补贴的视角,针对不同调整方案开展财政补贴模拟测算。研究发现,农村居民养老金水平偏低,仅为城镇职工的约1/17,城乡差距明显。农村基本养老保险待遇水平低的主要原因在于,当前国家财政对农村基本养老保险的人均补贴力度仅为企业职工的1/3、机关事业单位的1/12,基础养老金标准缺乏动态调整机制,且个人账户积累水平较低。按2023年领取待遇的人数测算,若要将农村居民养老金提升至农村低保标准,财政补贴需在现有基础上增加约8200亿元/年,支出规模占GDP的0.9%;若调整个人缴费补贴机制,激励人均缴费档次提升至700元/年,可减少财政支出约840亿元/年。鉴于此,本文建议建立基础养老金标准常态化调整机制,逐步提高城乡居民基本养老保险待遇水平,完善财政激励措施,提升个人缴费档次,推动2035年前实现与农村低保标准的衔接。
abstract_en: Addressing the rural-urban income gap has been a priority for the Chinese government.Among all age groups,the urban-rural income gap is the largest for the age group of 6070,primarily due to the significant disparity in pension insurance benefits between urban and rural areas.The urban elderly enjoy high pensions,and social security income accounts for as much as 79%of their total post-retirement income.In contrast,the rural elderly receive much less pension,with social security income accounting for only 23.6%of their total income.As a result,rural elderly still need to rely on other income sources such as family transfer,agricultural production,and employment.Therefore,improving pension benefits for rural elderly will contribute to narrowing the urban-rural income gap.In 2025,the Chinese government explicitly emphasizes the gradual increase of pensions of the Rural Basic Pension Insurance(RBPI).However,the optimal pension benefit targets for rural residents and the dynamic growth mechanisms are yet to be explored.This paper analyzes the current situation and main causes of the insufficient benefits provided by the RBPI,proposes goals and scenarios for benefit improvement,and conducts simulations of fiscal subsidies under different scenarios from the perspective of per capita fiscal subsidies.This paper reveals that the primary reasons for the low RBPI benefits are that the per capita fiscal subsidies for RBPI are merely 1/3 of those for enterprise employees and 1/12 of those for public institution employees,a dynamic adjustment mechanism for basic pension standards is lacking,and the accumulation levels of individual accounts are low.Based on the number of pension recipients in 2023,elevating RBPI pensions to the rural minimum living guarantee standard would require an additional annual fiscal subsidy of around CNY 820.0 billion,accounting for 0.9%of the GDP in 2023.If the individuals are incentivized to increase their personal contributions to CNY 700 per year,it could reduce fiscal expenditure by approximately CNY 84 billion annually.Consequently,this paper recommends the establishment of a regular adjustment mechanism for basic pension standards to gradually raise RBPI benefits.Additionally,fiscal incentive strategies should be improved to enlarge individual payment scales and achieve the rural minimum living guarantee level by 2035.The contributions of the paper are twofold.First,it reveals the underlying reasons for the low pension benefits for rural residents.This paper demonstrates that the RBPI,which is the most reliant on fiscal subsidies,receives the smallest per capita fiscal subsidies from the government.Second,based on a simulation analysis,this paper calculates the fiscal subsidies required for multiple benefit-adjustment scenarios.The paper employs real-world governmental data on insurance participation structure,contribution composition,and fiscal subsidy,which avoids potential biases from assumed predictive parameters and draws more credible conclusions.

title_cn: 城乡居民基础养老金标准的邻近效应及其解释
title_en: Neighborhood Effects in Basic Pension Standards for Urban and Rural Residents
authors_cn: 王天宇 | 李心雨 | 刘凯
authors_en_and_affiliations: WANG Tianyu;LI Xinyu;LIU Kai(School of Labor and Human Resources,Renmin University of China;Institute for Employment and Welfare Studies,Renmin University of China)
institutions_cn: 中国人民大学劳动人事学院 | 中国人民大学中国就业与民生研究院
index_title: 城乡居民基础养老金标准的邻近效应及其解释
abstract_cn: 中国的社会保障水平在整体上不断提升的同时,呈现较大的地区差距,不利于基本公共服务均等化目标的实现。以往对社保水平地区差距的归因集中于分权治理模式下的地方财力差异,对府际关系的作用鲜有论及。本文以城乡居民基本养老保险为例,利用2014-2020年地级市层面数据,探讨城乡居民基础养老金标准制定过程中的政府间互动及其对养老金待遇不平等的影响。空间自回归模型的估计结果表明,养老金标准存在显著的邻近效应:邻市基础养老金平均标准每变动1元,本市基础养老金标准将同向变动0.121~0.237元。对省界城市的检验表明,省内邻市对基础养老金标准的影响远大于省外邻市,表明邻近效应主要来自有共同上级的地级市政府间的竞争压力,而非相邻城市间的学习模仿。进一步地,本文发现地级市之间围绕城乡居民基础养老金标准的“逐底竞争”和“逐顶竞争”同时存在,两者共同作用形成了基础养老金标准的省内不平等,并增加整体不平等程度。本文的结论对完善城乡居民基础养老金正常调整机制和优化基本公共服务均等化过程中的央地财政责任划分有一定的启示。
abstract_en: While China's social security system has been improving and overall benefit levels have risen,substantial regional disparities in social security benefits persist,constraining the equalization of basic public services.Prior research has largely interpreted these gaps through the lens of fiscal decentralization,emphasizing unequal local fiscal capacity,but has paid comparatively limited attention to how interactions among local governments shape social policy outcomes.Focusing on China's Basic Pension for Urban and Rural Residents,this study examines how prefecture-level governments respond to neighboring jurisdictions when setting basic pension standards,and how such interactions affect inequality in pension benefits.Using prefecture-level policy data on basic pension standards from 2014 to 2020,this study applies spatial econometric techniques and estimates spatial autoregressive models.The key question is whether basic pension standards exhibit neighborhood effects across cities and,if so,whether those effects primarily reflect policy learning and imitation or competitive pressure among local governments operating within the same administrative hierarchy.Empirical results reveal a significant and robust positive neighborhood effect in basic pension standards at the prefecture level.A CNY 1 increase in the average basic pension standard of neighboring cities is associated with a CNY 0.1210.237 increase in a city's own standard.Mechanism tests based on prefecture-level cities located along provincial borders show that within-province neighbors exert a much stronger influence than across-province neighbors,indicating that the neighborhood effect is driven mainly by competitive pressure among cities sharing the same superior government,rather than learning or imitation between adjacent cities.Heterogeneity analysis by fiscal dependence further suggests that"race-to-the-bottom"and"race-to-the-top"dynamics coexist in the setting of basic pension standards:Fiscally constrained cities tend to cluster around low or minimum standards,whereas cities with greater fiscal autonomy are more likely to raise standards and compete upward.The two dynamics jointly contribute to within-province inequality and increase overall inequality in basic pension standards.Based on these empirical findings,this study proposes three policy implications.First,the cost-sharing ratios for the basic pension for urban and rural residents among the central,provincial and municipal governments should be further specified,and fiscal responsibilities for financing basic pension should be clearly delineated among sub-provincial levels of government.Second,provincial-level pooling of the urban and rural resident pension system should be accelerated,with fiscally capable provinces encouraged to take the lead in unifying intra-provincial basic pension standards to effectively curb benefit inequality driven by intra-provincial competition.Third,incentive-compatible transfer payment and reward mechanisms should be strengthened to support fiscally constrained regions while restraining excessive benefit competition,thereby achieving the sustainability of the pension system while balancing national equity with local initiative.The marginal contributions of this study are as follows.Theoretically,it extends explanations of regional disparities in social security benefits beyond local fiscal capacity to incorporate intergovernmental relations,demonstrating that competitive dynamics widely discussed in economic policy also operate in social policy and that upward and downward competition can coexist within the same program.Empirically,by exploiting a longitudinal prefecture-level policy dataset,it systematically identifies spatial neighborhood effects in basic pension standards,providing new evidence on the operating mechanisms of China's social security system under decentralized governance.

title_cn: 城乡医保统筹是否促进农村人口代际职业向上流动?——基于风险分担与劳动决策视角的分析
title_en: Does the Integration of Urban and Rural Medical Insurance Promote Intergenerational Upward Occupational Mobility in Rural Populations?An Analysis from the Perspectives of Risk Sharing and Labor Decisions
authors_cn: 张锦华 | 袁琳 | 龚钰涵
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZHANG Jinhua;YUAN Lin;GONG Yuhan(School of Public Administration and Policy,Shanghai University of Finance and Economics)
institutions_cn: 上海财经大学公共管理学院
index_title: 城乡医保统筹是否促进农村人口代际职业向上流动?——基于风险分担与劳动决策视角的分析
abstract_cn: 优化收入分配、促进代际收入流动是扎实推进共同富裕的必然要求。本文聚焦基本公共服务均等化背景下的城乡医保统筹政策,利用2014-2018年中国劳动力动态调查数据匹配城市宏观统计数据,采用代际流动矩阵和计量模型分析该政策的实施如何促进农村人口突破传统代际职业流动界限。研究发现,城乡医保统筹政策的实施,显著促进了农村人口代际职业向上流动,这主要通过家庭风险应对能力提升及个体劳动决策选择优化发挥作用。异质性分析表明,上述政策效应在缴费档次、基金管理等执行细节中呈现清晰的地域差异,且农村家庭子代的受益程度亦受家庭风险状况和个体禀赋特征的影响。进一步地,城乡医保统筹政策的实施,不仅在短期内依托损失补偿功能和流动性促进机制发挥初步效应,而且通过深层次人力资本和社会资源积累呈现长期溢出效应。本文以调整和优化城乡医保统筹政策为突破口,为保障统筹区域医保权益均等化、畅通农村劳动力职业向上流动渠道及扎实推进共同富裕提供借鉴。
abstract_en: The integration of urban and rural medical insurance represents a cornerstone of China's healthcare system reform,playing a vital role in optimizing income distribution and facilitating intergenerational income mobility.Although existing research has documented its successes in health enhancement and poverty alleviation,systematic evidence remains limited concerning its causal effects,underlying mechanisms,and heterogeneity on upward intergenerational occupational mobility among rural populations.A comprehensive assessment of the policy influence is therefore essential for refining healthcare system design and advancing urban-rural integration strategies.This study utilizes data from the China Labor-force Dynamic Survey(CLDS)from 2014 to 2018,combined with prefecture-level statistics,employing intergenerational mobility matrices and a staggered difference-in-differences(DID)design to systematically evaluate policy impacts.Results indicate that the integration significantly increases the probability of upward intergenerational occupational mobility among rural residents by approximately 4.3%,a finding robust to multiple checks.Mechanism analysis reveals that the policy operates through two primary pathways:strengthening household risk resilience and improving labor market decisions.Heterogeneity analysis shows stronger effects in regions implementing unified premium structures and centralized fund management models,as well as among vulnerable subgroups with lower socioeconomic status or health disadvantages.Dynamic analysis confirms the policy's enduring and cumulative nature.This study offers three principal contributions.First,it introduces institutional evidence to intergenerational mobility studies from the perspective of public service equalization.Second,it identifies intergenerational spillover effects of the integration of urban and rural medical insurance,expanding the understanding of healthcare reform's welfare implications.Third,it develops a"policy intervention-micro mechanisms—intergenerational mobility"analytical framework that delineates how the integration of urban and rural medical insurance promotes occupational advancement.These findings provide empirical support and guidance for improving medical insurance systems,fostering social mobility,and progressing toward common prosperity.

title_cn: 代际流动性如何影响家庭消费差距——基于劳动力流动的分析视角
title_en: How Does Intergenerational Mobility Affect Household Consumption Disparity:An Analysis from the Perspective of Labor Mobility
authors_cn: 张诚 | 张卓 | 陈晓烽
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZHANG Cheng;ZHANG Zhuo;CHEN Xiaofeng(School of Business,Shantou University)
institutions_cn: 汕头大学商学院
index_title: 代际流动性如何影响家庭消费差距——基于劳动力流动的分析视角
abstract_cn: 代际流动性作为反映地区公平的重要指标,对推动消费升级的包容性发展具有重要意义。本文通过测度不同空间尺度下的居民消费差距,发现代际流动性的提高在缩小全国消费差距的同时,也加剧了地区内部的消费分化。该结论经过一系列的稳健性检验后依然成立。机制分析发现:一方面,劳动力倾向于流动至代际流动性更高的地区,提高原本处于财富分布低位家庭的收入,促进该部分家庭消费水平提升,进而缩小全国消费差距;另一方面,流动劳动力的技能分布并非随机,相较于中等技能劳动力,低技能和高技能的劳动力更倾向于流动,这加剧了流入地的人才结构分化,进而扩大当地消费差距。进一步分析发现,低技能劳动力的流入对当地低技能劳动力的消费水平无显著影响,但高技能劳动力的流入会提高当地高技能劳动力的消费水平,从而加剧当地居民的消费分化。本研究为制定提振内需的消费政策、缩小消费差距、提升居民幸福感提供了参考。
abstract_en: Intergenerational mobility,as an important indicator reflecting regional equity,plays a significant role in promoting inclusive development that upgrades consumption.This paper measures regional intergenerational mobility and household consumption gaps at different spatial scales.The empirical findings reveal a nuanced pattern:While improving intergenerational mobility narrows the overall national consumption gap,it simultaneously intensifies intra-regional consumption differentiation within local areas.These conclusions remain reliable after a series of robustness checks.The mechanism analysis reveals two distinct pathways through which intergenerational mobility affects consumption patterns.On one hand,labor demonstrates a tendency to migrate toward cities characterized by higher intergenerational mobility.This migration pattern raises the income levels of groups that were originally positioned at the lower end of the income distribution and boosts their consumption capacity,thereby contributing to the narrowing the overall consumption gap.On the other hand,by incorporating the analytical framework of the Roy model,this paper finds that the skill distribution of migrated workers is not random in nature.Specifically,both low-skilled workers and high-skilled workers exhibit a greater inclination to migrate compared to their middle-skilled counterparts.This particular migration tendency exacerbates the differentiation of talent structure in the destination regions and subsequently widens the local consumption gap within these areas.Further analysis reveals that the inflow of low-skilled labor has no significant impact on the consumption levels of local low-skilled workers,whereas the inflow of high-skilled labor increases the consumption levels of local high-skilled workers,thereby exacerbating consumption differentiation among local residents.Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the dual impact of intergenerational mobility on consumption disparities exhibits notable heterogeneity across different household registration types,migration distances,and cities with varying settlement thresholds.Specifically,migrant households with rural household registration demonstrate more pronounced dual effects on consumption disparities at both the national and urban levels;intra-provincial migration yields a more pronounced overall narrowing effect on consumption gaps compared to inter-provincial migration;cities with low household registration thresholds demonstrate stronger inclusivity,effectively reducing overall consumption disparities while moderately controlling intra-regional differentiation risks.This paper provides a valuable theoretical reference for formulating policies aimed at boosting domestic demand,narrowing consumption gaps,and enhancing residents'well-being.

authors_cn: 朱玉龙 | 冯淑怡 | 王博 | 樊鹏飞
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZHU Yulong;FENG Shuyi;WANG Bo;FAN Pengfei(School of Public Administration,Nanjing Agricultural University;China Resources&Environment and Development Academy,Nanjing Agricultural University)

index_title: 建设用地指标交易政策实施的共同富裕效应——基于县域城乡收入差距的视角
abstract_cn: 建设用地指标交易政策作为中国土地要素市场化配置改革的关键举措,对推动共同富裕具有重要意义。本文在共同富裕视域下,运用公共选择理论,使用全国2010-2022年1646个县域面板数据,构建多期双重差分模型,分析建设用地指标交易政策实施对县域城乡收入差距的影响。研究发现,建设用地指标交易政策实施显著缩小了指标流出县域的城乡收入差距。机制分析表明,建设用地指标交易政策实施激励了指标流出县域增加对农村的投资,主要表现为农村固定资产投资和财政支农支出的显著增长,这些投资提升了农村产业发展水平,提高了农村居民收入,进而缩小了县域城乡收入差距。进一步分析表明,当省内建设用地指标稀缺时,建设用地指标交易政策实施缩小县域城乡收入差距的作用表现为帕累托改进;当省内建设用地指标过剩时,县域城乡收入差距的缩小主要通过收入转移实现。此外,建设用地指标交易政策实施缩小城乡收入差距的效果在采取协议出让方式以及地形包含丘陵的县域更为明显。本文建议进一步推广和完善建设用地指标交易政策,充分发挥土地要素市场化配置改革对共同富裕的促进作用。
abstract_en: As a key component of China's market-oriented land allocation reform,the construction land quota trading policy plays an important role in advancing common prosperity.In this policy context,systematically assessing its income redistribution effects and transmission mechanisms provides empirical support for policy refinement and practical guidance for improving land allocation efficiency and narrowing the urban-rural income gap.This paper,from the perspective of common prosperity,uses the public choice theory to systematically analyze the impact of the construction land quota trading policy on the urban-rural income gap in county regions.It employs panel data from 1646 counties nationwide from 2010 to 2022 and constructs a multi-period difference-in-differences(DID)model for empirical testing.This paper finds that the implementation of the construction land quota trading policy significantly reduces the urban-rural income gap in counties with quota outflows.Mechanism analysis reveals that the policy incentivizes these counties to increase rural investments,manifested chiefly in substantial growth in rural fixed asset investments and fiscal support for agriculture.These investments enhance rural industrial development,increase rural residents'income,and consequently narrow the urban-rural income gap in county regions.Further analysis indicates that when construction land quotas are scarce within a province,the policy effect is characterized by Pareto improvement,while in provinces with excess quotas,the reduction in the urban-rural income gap primarily occurs through income transfer effects.Additionally,the effects are more pronounced in counties adopting agreement acquisition methods and those in hilly areas.It is recommended to further promote and refine the construction land quota trading policy,fully leveraging the support and facilitation role of market-oriented land allocation reform in promoting common prosperity.The marginal contributions of the paper are highlighted in two aspects.First,based on the public choice theory,it analyzes the construction land quota trading policy from the perspective of market-oriented land allocation reform.It dissects the specific mechanisms through which the policy fosters a shift in urban-rural resource allocation patterns,thus narrowing the urban-rural income gap,broadening the scope of common prosperity research.Second,it utilizes large sample data at the national level,employing panel data from 1646 counties from 2010 to 2022,and constructs a multi-period DID model for empirical testing,overcoming the limitations of local pilot studies,and more comprehensively revealing the overall effects and differentiated impacts of the policy implementation,providing robust empirical support for policy improvement.

title_cn: 非成员依赖如何影响农民合作社公司化
title_en: How Nonmember Dependence Affects Farmers'Cooperative Corporatization
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZHANG Jian;WANG Yongsheng(School of Economics,Central University of Finance and Economics)
institutions_cn: 中央财经大学经济学院
index_title: 非成员依赖如何影响农民合作社公司化
abstract_cn: 农业合作化是实现农业强国的重要实践方向和推动力量。然而,中国农民合作社公司化现象普遍,公司化使合作社这种有别于公司的组织形态难以发挥作用。本文旨在从合作社依赖对象(成员与非成员)视角理解合作社公司化的内在机理。本文构建了一个包含异质性成员、非成员依赖与合作社公司化的分析框架,分析发现:当合作社对非成员的依赖程度很高时,即当合作社转入的土地和收购非成员农产品很多(从而越不依赖于成员)时,合作社理事会就会有动机和激励扩大其持股比例与合作社盈余按股分红比例,合作社公司化程度也会提高。数值模拟分析和利用调研数据进行的计量分析均证实了非成员依赖与合作社公司化之间的这种因果关系。本文的研究结论不仅能为理解中国合作社公司化现象提供新视角,也能为农业经营主体变革背景下合作社如何进一步处理好效率与公平问题提供政策参考。
abstract_en: Agricultural cooperation is an important practical pathway for building up China's strength in agriculture.However,the corporatization of farmers'cooperatives has become widespread in China,constraining the role of cooperatives as an organizational form distinct from investor-owned firms.In practice,the boundary of cooperatives'dependence has gradually expanded from reliance on members to increasing dependence on nonmembers.This paper elucidates the internal mechanisms of cooperative corporatization from the perspective of cooperatives'dependence on nonmembers.This paper develops an analytical framework incorporating heterogeneous members,nonmember dependence,and cooperative corporatization.The analysis shows that when a cooperative's dependence on nonmembers is sufficiently high,which is reflected in large amounts of land rented from nonmembers and substantial procurement of agricultural products from them,the board of directors has stronger incentives to increase its equity share and raise the proportion of surplus distributed according to shareholdings.As a result,cooperative corporatization emerges and intensifies as dependence on nonmembers deepens.Subsequent numerical simulations and econometric analyses confirm the causal relationship implied by the theoretical model.The findings offer a new perspective on the corporatization of cooperatives in China by highlighting the role of nonmember dependence in shaping internal governance and surplus distribution.Additionally they provide policy implications for how cooperatives can better balance efficiency and equity in the context of structural transformation and the ongoing reorganization of agricultural production.The marginal contributions of this paper are threefold.First,this paper constructs a theoretical framework based on bargaining among heterogeneous cooperative members.Second,it shifts the analysis of cooperative corporatization toward the internal micro-level mechanisms of cooperative organizations,revealing how dependence on nonmember factors and products induces corporatization under the dominance of core members.Existing studies have largely focused on initial conditions or institutional environments,such as member heterogeneity,capital constraints,and regulatory deficiencies,while generally overlooking the internal mechanisms underlying the corporatization of cooperatives.Third,this paper provides empirical evidence on the effects of nonmember dependence on cooperative corporatization along both the intensive and extensive margins.

title_cn: 基层首创试验如何打通政策变迁的“最初一公里”?
title_en: How Can Grassroots Innovation Experiments Break Through the“First Mile”of Policy Change?
authors_cn: 罗建章 | 李仲宇 | 汪庆浩 | 李晓彤
authors_en_and_affiliations: LUO Jianzhang;LI Zhongyu;WANG Qinghao;LI Xiaotong(School of Public Policy and Management,Tsinghua University;China Institute for Rural Studies,Tsinghua University;School of Agricultural Economics and Rural Development,Renmin University of China)

index_title: 基层首创试验如何打通政策变迁的“最初一公里”?
abstract_cn: 基层首创试验有助于因地制宜、分类施策地进一步深化农村改革,扎实推进乡村全面振兴。农民首创精神被视作涉农政策变迁的关键,但已有研究却很少关注基层首创试验推动政策变迁“最初一公里”的行动策略。本文基于2019-2024年内蒙古官牛犋南社“统种共富”试验的参与式观察,通过结构化案例数据分析,揭示基层首创试验打通政策变迁“最初一公里”的政策接力过程:第一,基层试验倡议者凭借“基层首创”设定问题框架;第二,集体内部“差序动员”促成议程推广;第三,政策联盟依托“上下来去”方式促成经验扩散;第四,高层推动通过“行政吸纳”实现政策变迁,由此形成实验主义治理的“政策接力”机制,即“基层首创-差序动员-上下来去-行政吸纳”。本文以“政策接力说”对话政策企业家说和实验主义治理说,打开了基层首创试验打通政策变迁“最初一公里”的“黑箱”,对发挥农民首创精神、推进农业农村顶层设计与坚持问计于民相统一、在基层试验探索中寻找改革动力具有理论价值和现实启示。
abstract_en: An important starting point for further deepening rural reform and solidly promoting comprehensive rural revitalization is to develop various forms of appropriate-scale operations.How did the 5-year experiment of Inner Mongolia Guanniuju Nanshe realize the change from grassroots initiative to policy?Farmer initiative is regarded as the key to agriculture-related policy change,but little attention has been paid to this research topic.There are two competing explanations for how grassroots experiments can break through the"first mile"of policy change:the policy entrepreneur theory and the experimentalist governance theory.However,both have shortcomings.On the one hand,the policy entrepreneur theory provides an action framework for the leap of policy experiments,but there are differences between China and the West in terms of democratic systems,administrative systems,and the action logic of policy entrepreneurs.On the other hand,the experimentalist governance theory is in line with China's policy experimentation process of"pilot first,then promote",but the decisive factors for breaking through the"first mile"are significantly different from the rural reform practice in China.To reveal the process and mechanism of grassroots initiative driving the"first mile"of moderate-scale management from the strategic perspective of rural policy entrepreneurs,this paper adopts the case analysis method of structured data,which is suitable for the formation of structured data to explain cases through repeated comparison of phenomena and theories based on literature research.Based on the participatory observation of the experiment of Guanniuju Nanshe during 20192024,this paper reveals the strategy of the grassroots initiative experiment to break through the"first mile"of policy change through structured case data analysis.First,the grassroots pilot advocates set the policy issue framework by"grassroots initiative".Second,the collective promotes the agenda through"differential mobilization".Third,the"up-down circle"builds policy alliances to promote the diffusion of experience.Fourth,"administrative absorption"promotes policy change through the top level,thereby forming the Chinese characteristics of"grassroots initiativedifferential mobilizationup-down circle—administrative absorption"of the experimental governance strategy in China.This paper finds that the operating income brought by the"collective ownership and common prosperity"has three stages of increasing income:expanding area,raising unit production,and adjusting structure.This paper introduces the Western policy entrepreneur theory and the experimentalist governance theory,opens the"black box"of the grassroots initiative experiment to break through the"first mile"of policy change.

title_cn: 构建与农业新质生产力发展相适应的新型生产关系
title_en: Constructing New Production Relations Compatible with New Quality Productive Forces in Agriculture
authors_en_and_affiliations: LIN Wanlong(College of Economics and Management,China Agricultural University)
institutions_cn: 中国农业大学经济管理学院
index_title: 构建与农业新质生产力发展相适应的新型生产关系
abstract_cn: 农业新质生产力作为第四次科技革命催生的产物,正推动农业的业态属性、生产要素、产业边界发生根本性、革命性变化。农业新质生产力的发展,已对现有农业产业的生产要素产权制度、生产要素组合方式、利益分配格局产生了重大影响,也对相应的政策和管理体系提出了挑战。构建适应农业新质生产力发展的新型生产关系已成为必然要求。这种新型生产关系以及与之适应的上层建筑包括:构建更为清晰合理的数据产权制度、更为有效适应的产业组织模式、更为包容共享可及的利益联结机制、更为开放的“新三农”政策体系、更为灵活的农业公共管理体系以及更为交融的农业科技范式。唯有如此,才能为农业新质生产力的蓬勃发展扫清障碍,以新型生产关系激活农业新质生产力的乘数效应。
abstract_en: In the agricultural sector,the Fourth Industrial Revolution,characterized by the deep integration of modern biotechnology,information technology,and engineering technology,is cultivating new quality productive forces in agriculture.This development is driving fundamental and revolutionary changes in the natural attributes,production factors,and industrial boundaries of agriculture,powerfully propelling agriculture toward a“secondary industry”trend and increasingly freeing the production process from the rigid constraints of natural conditions.However,with the evolution of productive forces,conflicts with existing production relations are inevitable.This study aims to systematically analyze the theoretical logic of this transformation and propose pathways to construct new production relations that adapt to this transformation.This study examines the systemic contradictions between new quality productive forces in agriculture and current production relations from three core dimensions:ownership of the means of production,mode of production organization,and mode of product distribution.This study finds that the traditional definition and boundaries of agriculture are expanding,leading to specific institutional lags.First,regarding the means of production,data has become a key new factor of production,but its property rights characteristics,which combine private and public attributes,are still unclear,bringing governance challenges.Second,regarding production organization,the traditional family-based farming model faces limitations in adapting to the new trend of“using non-agricultural land for agricultural purposes”and obtaining external economies of scale through digital platforms.Third,regarding the distribution,the dominance of capital-and technology-intensive models puts smallholder farmers at risk of marginalization,potentially exacerbating the“technology gap”and posing a challenge to the goal of common prosperity under China’s national condition of“large country,small-scale agriculture”.Based on the above analysis,this study argues that building new production relations is inevitable and requires comprehensive reform strategies.At the economic level,the study proposes establishing a clearer and more rational data property rights system to balance the protection of private rights with the public demand for data sharing.This study advocates building a modern industrial organization system with agricultural technology enterprises as the main body,while vigorously promoting the“sharing economy”model to effectively connect small farmers with modern markets.Crucially,to resolve the dilemma between efficiency and fairness,an inclusive benefit-sharing mechanism must be established to ensure that traditional farmers are not excluded from the benefits of modernization.The marginal contribution of this study lies in its systematic explanation of“new quality productive force in agriculture”from a political economy perspective.Unlike studies that focus solely on technological applications,this study clarifies the theoretical logic behind how disruptive technologies force the restructuring of production relations.The study emphasizes that the core of China’s agricultural modernization lies not only in efficiency improvement but also in building an inclusive institutional system to prevent smallholder farmers from being alienated in the high-tech era,thus providing a theoretical basis and policy reference for high-quality agricultural development and rural revitalization.

title_cn: 农业新质生产力何以因地制宜内生发展
title_en: How Can New Quality Productive Forces in Agriculture Develop Endogenously Based on Local Conditions
authors_cn: 马玉婷 | 惠利 | 叶初升
authors_en_and_affiliations: MA Yuting;HUI Li;YE Chusheng(College of Economics and Management,Nanjing Forestry University;School of Economics,Huazhong University of Science and Technology;The Institute of State Governance,Huazhong University of Science and Technology;School of Economics and Management,Wuhan University;Center for Economic Development Research,Wuhan University)

index_title: 农业新质生产力何以因地制宜内生发展
abstract_cn: 因地制宜发展农业新质生产力,是推动农业高质量发展、加快实现农业强国的关键。湖北省潜江市近年来结合当地资源禀赋,逐步通过技术创新突破资源约束,实现了小龙虾养殖、加工、餐饮、文旅、电商等领域全产业链融合发展,不断推动传统农业向现代科技农业的转型升级,成为因地制宜发展农业新质生产力的实践典范。本文以湖北省潜江市的小龙虾产业为研究对象,在采用纵向单案例分析法的同时结合具体实践情境,系统探讨农业新质生产力因地制宜内生发展的过程。本文的研究发现,农业新质生产力植根于由自然资源、市场需求和农民主体创新组成的原生基础之上,发现和创造市场需求至关重要;在市场需求的牵引下,作为农业新质生产力核心动力的技术革命性突破内生于自然资源禀赋与市场需求间的矛盾,贯穿于从养殖模式到种苗繁育、从精深加工到冷链物流的产业链发展全过程;技术创新能够引领劳动力、土地、资本、技术和数据等要素不断优化重组,内生地形成生产要素的创新性配置,并在此过程中逐步改造传统产业、催生新产业新业态新模式,从而内生地推动产业深度转型升级;有效市场和有为政府的功能互补与动态协同治理,为因地制宜形成和发展农业新质生产力提供了重要的体制机制保障。本文不仅以理论阐释实践,高度重视因地制宜的原生基础,重点强调农业新质生产力发展的内生性,而且,研究所得结论能为政府积极引导和推动因地制宜发展农业新质生产力提供有学理支撑的实践借鉴。
abstract_en: This paper examines the crayfish industry in Qianjiang City,Hubei Province,adopting a longitudinal single-case research method to explore the endogenous development process of new quality productive forces in agriculture within a practical context.The findings of this paper show that new quality productive forces in agriculture originate from local natural resources,market demand,and innovation by farmers,where identifying and creating market demand is crucial.Driven by market demand,revolutionary technological breakthroughs,the core driving forces,emerge endogenously from contradictions between natural resource endowments and market needs,reshaping the entire industrial chain from breeding models and seedling cultivation to deep processing and cold-chain logistics.Technological innovation further optimizes the allocation of labor,land,capital,technology,and data,endogenously shaping innovative factor allocation.This process transforms traditional industries,fosters new industries,business forms,and models,and endogenously promotes deep industrial transformation and upgrading.The complementary functions of an effective market and a proactive government,along with dynamic collaborative governance,provide important institutional guarantees for developing new quality productive forces in agriculture based on local conditions.Compared with existing literature,the marginal contributions of this paper are as follows.First,it integrates macro theory with concrete practice to examine the specific generation and development process of new quality productive forces in agriculture,using theoretical insights to interpret practice.Second,it combines universal principles with specific practical contexts to provide an in-depth and concrete analysis of developing new quality productive forces in agriculture based on local conditions,offering methodological supplementation for analyzing such processes.Third,it highlights the foundation for developing new quality productive forces in agriculture based on local conditions,revealing the importance of their embryonic forms in practice.Fourth,it particularly emphasizes the endogenous nature of new quality productive forces in agriculture and extracts from practice a theoretical framework for the endogenous development of new quality productive forces in agriculture based on local conditions.The policy implications are as follows.First,it is necessary to enhance recognition of the specificity and endogeneity of new quality productive forces in agriculture,value their native foundations,fully stimulate innovation vitality among farmers,proactively create market demand,reshape the value of natural resources,and tap into local developmental momentum.Second,the government should play roles in organization and coordination,policy support,and institutional guarantees,establish a government-enterprise-research collaborative system,drive technological innovation iteration and industrial application,innovate factor allocation methods,and extend industrial and value chains.Third,it is necessary to emphasize synergy between the government and the market,establish dynamic governance mechanisms adapted to different stages of industrial development,and build an ecosystem for the sustainable development of new quality productive forces in agriculture.

title_cn: 政策性牲畜保险参与能否提升牧户生产效率——基于内蒙古牧区的经验证据
title_en: Does Participation in Policy-Oriented Livestock Insurance Improve Herders’Production Efficiency?Empirical Evidence from Pastoral Areas in Inner Mongolia
authors_cn: 柴智慧 | 李艾橦 | 高翠玲
authors_en_and_affiliations: CHAI Zhihui;LI Aitong;GAO Cuiling(College of Economics and Management,Inner Mongolia Agricultural University;College of Humanities and Social Sciences,Inner Mongolia Agricultural University)
institutions_cn: 内蒙古农业大学经济管理学院 | 内蒙古农业大学人文社会科学学院
index_title: 政策性牲畜保险参与能否提升牧户生产效率——基于内蒙古牧区的经验证据
abstract_cn: 草原畜牧业作为中国牧区的支柱产业,其稳定发展关乎牧区民生与经济安全。推行政策性牲畜保险,不仅能增强牧户抵御风险的能力,也为畜牧业迈向可持续发展提供了重要保障。本文基于2020年与2024年对内蒙古牧区的两轮田野调查数据,实证检验牧户参与政策性牲畜保险对其生产效率的影响及其内在机制。研究发现,政策性牲畜保险参与能够显著提升牧户的生产效率,并且在有效控制内生性问题后,这一正向结论依然稳健。机制分析表明,政策性牲畜保险参与主要通过提升牧户技术采纳程度和信贷可得性两条路径,间接驱动生产效率提升,其中的技术路径主要体现为畜产品营销类技术的应用。异质性分析显示,政策性牲畜保险参与对牧户生产效率的促进作用存在显著的群体与区域差异,其对生产效率的积极影响在全职、大规模草场以及位于内蒙古自治区东部地区的牧户中表现得更为显著。基于上述结论,本文提出如下政策建议:围绕风险保障与效率激励并重的目标,推动政策性牲畜保险产品精准化设计与功能拓展,构建保险、技术与金融协同支持体系,并针对不同经营类型与区域特征提供差异化保险供给。
abstract_en: As an important risk management tool,policy-oriented livestock insurance serves the functions of risk diversification and economic compensation,but the specific pathways by which it affects the production efficiency of herding households remain unclear.Based on field survey data from pastoral areas in Inner Mongolia,this paper systematically explores the impact of livestock insurance participation on the production efficiency of herding households and its underlying mechanisms.A theoretical model is constructed using a stochastic frontier production function to identify the impact of insurance participation on technical efficiency.The instrumental variable method is employed to address potential endogeneity issues.Robustness tests are conducted using a combination of propensity score matching(PSM)and an endogenous switching regression model.This paper finds that the average production efficiency of herding households is relatively low.Livestock insurance participation can significantly enhance their production efficiency.Mechanism tests reveal that livestock insurance participation indirectly drives improvements in production efficiency primarily through two pathways:promoting the adoption of livestock product marketing-related technologies by herding households and increasing their access to credit.Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the productivity-enhancing effect of insurance is more pronounced among full-time,large-scale herders and those in eastern Inner Mongolia.The effect is smaller among herders with medium or small-scale pastures and insignificant among part-time herders or those in central and western Inner Mongolia.Accordingly,this paper proposes the following policy implications.First,it should advance the precision and functional expansion of insurance products to achieve the dual objectives of risk protection and efficiency incentives.Second,it should establish a collaborative support system integrating insurance,technology,and finance,with technology adoption and credit access as key mechanisms.Third,it should strengthen the provision of differentiated insurance products tailored to various operation types and regional characteristics to enhance the structural policy effectiveness of insurance.The potential marginal contributions of this paper lie in three aspects.First,it expands the research perspective on agricultural insurance.Second,it identifies and tests the key transmission mechanisms through which livestock insurance participation affects production efficiency.Third,it provides empirically generalizable evidence for optimizing insurance policies in pastoral areas.

title_cn: 乡村绿色转型中生态系统的适应性治理机制研究——以红树林保护为例
title_en: The Adaptive Governance Mechanism of Ecosystems from the Perspective of Rural Green Development:A Case Study of Mangrove Conservation
authors_en_and_affiliations: DU Yanqiang;LIN Lin(College of Public Administration,Nanjing Agricultural University)
institutions_cn: 南京农业大学公共管理学院
index_title: 乡村绿色转型中生态系统的适应性治理机制研究——以红树林保护为例
abstract_cn: 本文基于对福建省泉州湾红树林生态系统的深度调查,以“前置壁垒-过程调适-结果增能”构建中国情境下适应性治理解释框架,系统提炼生态系统的适应性治理机制。研究发现:第一,基于乡村绿色转型背景,红树林生态系统治理面临生态保护与渔民生计协同不足、多元主体共建共治机制缺乏、生态产品价值实现困难等棘手问题。第二,适应性治理的实现取决于过程调适,关键要与地方治理结构、村集体经济特征相耦合,进而推动央地目标的聚合与社会力量的有效动员。第三,生态系统治理的可持续性不仅依赖过程调适,也需构建“调适-增能”转化机制,通过“价值识别-机制构建-价值实现”的演化路径,增强多元主体的认同感,打通生态价值与社会经济效益的转换通道,进而激发乡村绿色发展的内生动力。本文立足中国情境探索生态系统治理案例中蕴含的“中国之治”,既为推动乡村绿色转型、探索乡村环境治理现代化的可行路径提供了实践样板,也为推进人与自然和谐共生的治理创新提供了政策启示。
abstract_en: Exploring multiple pathways to achieve the harmonious coexistence between humans and nature represents a critical issue in promoting rural green development.Mangroves,as a typical observational sample for advancing green transformation in coastal rural areas,embody inherent structural tensions among ecological conservation,the transition of village collective economies,and the improvement of fisher livelihoods.Existing research on mangroves predominantly focuses on restoration and conservation within the natural sciences,revealing a notable lack of scholarly attention from the social sciences to the governance practices of China’s mangrove ecosystems.To address this research gap,this study,based on in-depth field research conducted in Quanzhou Bay,Fujian Province,constructs an analytical framework of“pre-existing barriers–process adaptation–outcome empowerment”to elucidate the logic of adaptive governance for ecosystems within the Chinese context and systematically extracts its underlying mechanisms.The main findings of this study are threefold.First,against the backdrop of rural green transformation,mangrove ecosystem governance faces a series of wicked problems,including insufficient synergy between ecological protection and fisher livelihoods,a lack of mechanisms for multi-stakeholder joint contribution and shared benefits,and difficulties in realizing the value of ecological products.Second,the realization of adaptive governance hinges critically on“process adaptation”.Its effectiveness depends on whether adaptive mechanisms can be effectively coupled with local governance structures and the characteristics of village collective economies,thereby facilitating the alignment of central and local objectives and the effective mobilization of social forces.Third,the sustainability of ecosystem governance relies not merely on process adaptation but,more fundamentally,on constructing an“adaptation–empowerment”transformation mechanism.Through the evolutionary pathway of“value identification–mechanism construction–value realization”,this mechanism enhances the sense of identity among diverse stakeholders,establishes a conversion mechanism between ecological value and socio-economic benefits,and ultimately stimulates the endogenous momentum for rural green development.This study proposes the following policy implications:(1)upholding the Party’s overall leadership in ecological civilization construction;(2)striking a balance between ecological restoration and the capacity for rural green development;and(3)effectively balancing the relationship between external support and internal drive.The marginal contributions of this paper are as follows.On one hand,it innovatively adopts the perspective of rural community governance,thereby expanding the predominant research paradigms centered on natural ecological technologies or macro-level policies.This shift responds to the institutional adaptability challenges faced by ecosystem governance during rural green development transformation,serving to mutually corroborate or complement existing domestic research on rural resource governance and the integration of rural ecological industries.On the other hand,it employs an in-depth analysis of a typical case to reveal how ecosystem protection can be coordinated with villages’organizational structures,industrial logic,and governance mechanisms.By integrating local governance structures and village collective economies into the analytical framework of adaptive governance,it provides practical experience for constructing a pluralistic,synergistic,and institutionally sustainable model of ecological governance.

title_cn: 海洋牧场建设如何影响沿海地区水生态环境质量——来自国家级海洋牧场示范区的证据
title_en: How Does Marine Ranching Construction Affect the Aquatic Ecological Environment Quality in Coastal Areas?Evidence from National Marine Ranching Demonstration Areas
authors_cn: 张卓群 | 李均超 | 单菁菁 | 冯冬发
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZHANG Zhuoqun;LI Junchao;SHAN Jingjing;FENG Dongfa(Faculty of Applied Economics,University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;Research Institute for Eco-civilization,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;School of Public Policy and Management,Tsinghua University;School of Economics and Management,Nanchang University)
institutions_cn: 中国社会科学院大学应用经济学院 | 中国社会科学院生态文明研究所 | 清华大学公共管理学院 | 南昌大学经济管理学院
index_title: 海洋牧场建设如何影响沿海地区水生态环境质量——来自国家级海洋牧场示范区的证据
abstract_cn: 海洋牧场建设对践行大食物观、推动海洋生态文明建设进程以及实施“海洋强国”战略具有重要意义。本文采用交错双重差分模型,基于农业农村部公布的前七批国家级海洋牧场示范区名单,构建中国沿海102个县2010-2022年的面板数据集,研究国家级海洋牧场示范区建设对沿海地区水生态环境质量的影响。研究发现:第一,国家级海洋牧场示范区建设能够有效提升沿海地区水生态环境质量,该结论经过一系列安慰剂检验和稳健性检验后依然成立。第二,海洋牧场建设能够通过推动文旅产业发展和促进陆源污染治理来有效提升沿海地区水生态环境质量。第三,在绿色技术应用水平较低、海洋渔业装备水平较低、农业数字化转型水平较高的地区以及非东部海洋经济圈,海洋牧场建设对沿海地区水生态环境质量的提升效果更加显著。第四,政府通过加强监管与优化服务,能够进一步增强海洋牧场建设对沿海地区水生态环境质量的提升作用。因此,应深化国家级海洋牧场示范区建设与海洋生态文明建设的协同联动,推动文旅产业融合,持续推进陆源污染治理体系建设,强化政府监管与服务在海洋牧场建设中的关键作用,促进国家级海洋牧场示范区建设在提升沿海地区水生态环境质量方面发挥更大作用。
abstract_en: As a key measure to practice the concept of great food security,advance marine ecological civilization construction,and implement the maritime power strategy,the construction of modern marine ranching serves as a“golden key”to resolving the contradiction between the decline of traditional fishery resources and ecological protection.This study focuses on the ecological effects of the construction of National Marine Ranching Demonstration Areas(NMRDAs),aiming to scientifically evaluate their impact on the aquatic ecological environment quality in coastal areas,clarify the action paths and heterogeneous characteristics,and provide a decision-making basis for improving policies and measures to enhance coastal aquatic ecological environment quality through NMRDAs construction.Treating the construction of NMRDAs as a quasi-natural experiment,this study constructs a panel dataset of 102 coastal counties in China from 2010 to 2022 and employs a staggered difference-in-differences(DID)model to examine the policy’s impact on coastal aquatic ecological environment quality.The research results are as follows.First,the construction of NMRDAs can effectively improve the aquatic ecological environment quality in coastal areas,and this conclusion remains valid after a series of placebo tests and robustness checks.Second,NMRDAs construction effectively enhances the coastal aquatic ecological environment quality by promoting the development of cultural and tourism industries and advancing terrestrial pollution control.Third,the improvement effect is more significant in areas with low green technology application,low levels of marine fishery equipment,and high level of agricultural digital transformation,as well as those within non-eastern marine economic circles.Fourth,the government further strengthens the positive impact of NMRDAs construction on the coastal aquatic ecological environment quality by intensifying supervision and optimizing services.Based on the research conclusions,the following implications are proposed.First,it is necessary to deepen the coordinated linkage between NMRDAs construction and marine ecological civilization construction.Second,the government should promote the integration of the cultural and tourism industries and continuously advance the construction of the terrestrial pollution control system.Third,it should strengthen the critical role of government supervision and services in NMRDAs construction.The innovations of this study are reflected in three aspects.First,it conducts a comprehensive quantitative study on the impact of marine ranching construction on the coastal aquatic ecological environment quality at the national level.Second,it carries out a mechanistic analysis from two perspectives,promoting the development of cultural and tourism industries and advancing terrestrial pollution control.Third,it focuses on exploring the role of the government,examining the key regulatory effects of fishery law enforcement intensity,the professionalization level of fishery administration teams,and the construction of basic fishery public facilities.

title_cn: 乡村治理有效的实现机制——基于治理目标与治理过程的双重视角
title_en: The Implementation Mechanism of Effective Rural Governance:From the Dual Perspectives of Governance Objectives and Governance Process
authors_cn: 向书坚 | 黄桃 | 吴志敏
authors_en_and_affiliations: XIANG Shujian;HUANG Tao;WU Zhimin(School of Statistics and Data Science,Zhejiang Gongshang University;School of Mathematical Sciences,Zhejiang University)
institutions_cn: 浙江工商大学统计与数据科学学院 | 浙江大学数学科学学院
index_title: 乡村治理有效的实现机制——基于治理目标与治理过程的双重视角
abstract_cn: 实现乡村振兴,治理有效是基础,现有研究对乡村治理有效的内在机制尚未进行系统性实证考察。本文基于中国农村与家庭的追踪调查数据,综合运用PLS-SEM、fsQCA、OLS等方法,重点关注乡村治理过程和结果是否有效,并探究治理有效的实现路径和非均衡机制。研究表明:在要素层面,治理有效是技术赋能、组织优化、政策环境支撑等因素多重作用的结果,法律和规则支持是提高治理能力的必要前提条件,治理方式数字化则推动了治理能力的提升。高治理能力下的治理模式具有“多重并发和非对称性”特征,存在两类治理有效的典型模式,即“党建引领与技术增能”强治理型下的统合型治理模式和占据主导地位的“法治韧性与传统支撑”稳定型治理模式。在本底条件分异下,乡村治理模式呈现区域“法治和党建引领”梯级格局。具体而言,东部和东北部、一线或新一线城市周边、土地资源丰富的乡村在党建统合型治理模式中具有示范效应;而中西部和三线城市周边、宗族文化强、人口少、土地资源匮乏的乡村,易出现由“党建单向嵌入”引发的治理悖论。据此,本文从分类分区治理和健全多元共治等方面提出政策启示,为有效推进乡村治理实践提供借鉴。
abstract_en: Effective governance is essential for achieving rural revitalization.Guided by the rural revitalization strategy,China’s rural governance is evolving from traditional administrative management towards diverse governance models.As interactions between the external system and the kernel system of rural development intensify,these governance models increasingly differ across developmental stages and village types.This study investigates the mechanisms underlying effective rural governance.Using data from the China longitudinal household and village surveys,it adopts a mixed-methods approach that integrates partial least squares structural equation modeling(PLS-SEM),fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis(fsQCA),and ordinary least squares(OLS)regression to analyze the pathways and conditional mechanisms of effective governance.This study reveals three key findings.First,governance effectiveness stems from technological empowerment,organizational optimization,and a supportive policy environment,with legal and institutional support as a prerequisite for high governance capacity,and digitalization acts as a driving force specifically under such conditions.Second,high-capacity governance models exhibit multiple conjunctural causation and causal asymmetry.Two typical models of effective governance are identified:an integrative“Party leadership and technology empowerment”model,and a stable model of“rule-of-law resilience supported by traditional foundations”.Third,governance effectiveness shows spatial heterogeneity due to local conditions,forming a regional-tiered pattern integrating the rule of law and Party leadership.Villages in eastern and northeastern China,those near first-tier or new first-tier cities,and those with abundant land resources tend to demonstrate exemplary effects under the integrative Party Leadership governance model.In contrast,villages in central and western regions,those surrounding third-tier cities,and those with strong clan culture,small populations,and scarce land resources are more prone to a governance paradox arising from unidirectional embedding of Party leadership.Accordingly,this paper advocates category-based policies,establishing governance early-warning and intervention mechanisms,and building a sustainable multi-stakeholder collaborative framework.The main marginal contributions of this paper are as follows.First,it constructs an analytical framework of“governance capacity-governance model-governance effectiveness”,revealing the mechanisms of governance effectiveness through the dual lenses of objectives and processes.Second,it uses a mixed-methods approach to identify two effective and three ineffective governance models.Third,based on nationwide multi-source micro-level survey data,it offers empirical evidence with high external validity.

authors_cn: 孟恩慧 | 何雨可 | 牛耕

index_title: 基层政务公开标准化规范化建设对家庭创业的影响
abstract_cn: 基层是服务经营主体的最前端,是营商环境建设的“最后一公里”。深化政务公开作为促进基层政府治理能力提升的重要途径,对营造公开透明、可预期的营商环境具有重要作用。基层政务公开是基层政府与公众最直接的联系纽带。基层政务公开标准化规范化试点政策旨在推动政务公开从“形式化”向“实质化”转变,解决基层政府在以往政务公开中存在的随意性等问题。本文基于2017年开始实施的基层政务公开标准化规范化试点政策,利用中国家庭金融调查(CHFS)2013-2021年5期微观调查数据,构建双重差分模型,实证研究了基层政务公开标准化规范化建设对家庭创业的影响。研究发现,基层政务公开标准化规范化建设显著提升了家庭创业概率,这一结论在经过一系列稳健性检验后依然成立。机制分析表明,基层政务公开标准化规范化建设主要通过降低制度性交易成本和政策不确定性感知程度两条路径促进家庭创业。进一步研究发现,完善基层组织建设(实行“一肩挑”或“两委”交叉任职)、改善要素和信息流通环境,有助于进一步发挥基层政务公开标准化规范化建设的创业促进作用。此外,研究还发现基层政务公开标准化规范化建设能显著促进机会型创业、扩大企业规模,但短期内对家庭工商业项目营业收入的影响并不显著。本文的研究发现为进一步优化基层营商环境、激发经济发展活力提供了重要的经验证据和政策启示。
abstract_en: Grassroots governments constitute the frontline of public service delivery to market entities and represent the“last mile”of business environment construction.For a long time,government information disclosure at the grassroots level in China has been characterized by considerable discretion,low information quality,and fragmented platforms.To address these issues,the Chinese government launched a pilot program on the standardized and institutionalized construction of grassroots government information disclosure in 2017,aiming to promote a transition of information disclosure from formal compliance to substantive effectiveness through standardized procedures and institutional arrangements.Against the backdrop of China’s economic transition and rising uncertainty in the international economic environment,employment pressures have intensified.Whether the implementation of the standardized and institutionalized grassroots government information disclosure policy can effectively stimulate market vitality and thereby promote household entrepreneurship is therefore of substantial practical relevance.This study treats the pilot policy as a quasi-natural experiment and employs five waves of micro-level data from the China Household Finance Survey(CHFS)covering the period 2013-2021.Using this dataset,the study empirically examines the effect of standardized and institutionalized grassroots government information disclosure on household entrepreneurship.The results indicate that the standardized and institutionalized construction of grassroots government information disclosure significantly increases the probability of household entrepreneurship,and this finding remains robust across a series of robustness checks.Mechanism analyses suggest that the policy mainly promotes household entrepreneurship by reducing institutional transaction costs and alleviating households’perceived policy uncertainty.Further analyses reveal that strengthening grassroots organizational capacity and improving the environment for factor and information circulation help to amplify the entrepreneurship-enhancing effects of standardized information disclosure.These findings provide important empirical evidence and policy implications for optimizing the grassroots business environment and stimulating economic dynamism.The marginal contributions of this study are twofold.First,while existing literature predominantly focuses on the effects of macro-level institutional environments on economic activities,relatively limited attention has been paid to the economic consequences of grassroots institutional development.This paper extends the analysis of institutions and entrepreneurship to the grassroots level and identifies the entrepreneurial effects of standardized and institutionalized government information disclosure.Second,from the perspective of government governance,this study examines how standardized grassroots information disclosure influences household entrepreneurial decisions,highlighting the role of this institutional arrangement in the entrepreneurial decision-making process.

title_en: How Can the Central Government Units’Fixed-Point Assistance Enable the County-Level Economic Development:Evidence Based on Satellite Thermal Imaging

index_title: 中央单位定点帮扶何以赋能县域经济发展?——来自卫星热成像数据的经验证据
abstract_cn: 在脱贫攻坚全面胜利与乡村全面振兴战略接续推进的背景下,中央单位定点帮扶在推动被帮扶县域经济发展中发挥了重要作用。本文结合2021-2023年县域面板数据,引入卫星热成像数据来测度县域经济发展水平,系统揭示中央单位定点帮扶政策实施对县域经济发展的赋能路径及机制。研究发现:中央单位定点帮扶从产业、组织、消费、人才四个维度协同发力,赋能县域经济发展。其中,组织帮扶在民族地区呈现“制度适配性优势”,而挂职干部担任第一书记的人才帮扶产生了“引领效应”。机制检验表明,提升经营主体创业活力、推动产业结构升级以及促进人力资本高级化,构成了中央单位定点帮扶赋能县域经济发展的关键路径。此外,本文还验证了被帮扶县域的较高资源禀赋水平能够强化帮扶效能,提高营商环境水平能够促进人才帮扶效能,扩大挂职干部规模能够改善组织帮扶效能。本文为优化中央单位定点帮扶措施促进县域经济发展和乡村全面振兴提供了微观层面的决策参考与实践启示。
abstract_en: Against the backdrop of the comprehensive success in poverty alleviation and the continuous advancement of the rural revitalization strategy,the central government units’fixed-point assistance has played a significant role in driving economic development in the assisted counties.However,existing research has not yet examined the underlying mechanisms from the perspective of institutional advantage.Furthermore,the commonly used GDP indicator cannot be properly deflated due to the lack of county-level price indices,introducing endogeneity bias into economic measurement.Therefore,this study innovatively introduces satellite thermal imaging data to proxy for real economic activity.It systematically reveals the empowering mechanisms of the central government units’fixed-point assistance policy from an institutional advantage perspective.The empirical results indicate that the central government units’fixed-point assistance significantly empowers county-level economic development.This empowerment functions through four synergistic channels:industrial assistance,organizational assistance,consumption assistance,and talent assistance.Mechanism analysis reveals that boosting the entrepreneurial vitality of market entities,facilitating industrial structure upgrading,and advancing human capital development constitute the critical pathways through which the central government units’fixed-point assistance empowers county-level economic development.Further heterogeneity analysis reveals two distinct advantages:organizational assistance demonstrates an“institutional adaptability advantage”in ethnic regions,while talent assistance-with seconded cadres as first secretaries-creates a“leadership effect”.It also confirms that greater resource endowment amplifies overall effectiveness,a better business environment enhances talent assistance,and more seconded cadres improve organizational assistance.Accordingly,this paper proposes:First,synergize industrial and consumption assistance to upgrade distinctive local industries.Second,innovate organizational and talent models through better cadre selection and training to turn external support into endogenous drivers.Third,substantially increase the tilt of resource allocation toward border ethnic regions,with a focused support on infrastructure construction and the cultivation of characteristic industries,so as to effectively stimulate market vitality.Fourth,deepen business environment reforms by supporting returnee entrepreneurs and new types of business entities.

title_cn: 统筹发展“四个农业”的现实挑战与路径选择
title_en: Realistic Challenges and Path Choices for Coordinated Development of the“Four Agricultures”
authors_en_and_affiliations: WANG Mingli;YAN Zhaohui(Institute of Agricultural Economics and Development,Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences)
institutions_cn: 中国农业科学院农业经济与发展研究所
index_title: 统筹发展“四个农业”的现实挑战与路径选择
abstract_cn: “十五五”时期是扎实推进乡村全面振兴、加快建设农业强国的关键时期。面对资源环境约束收紧、生产要素结构变革、消费需求升级与全球农业竞争加剧的多重挑战,统筹发展科技农业、绿色农业、质量农业、品牌农业成为推动农业现代化的必然选择。本文的分析表明,统筹发展“四个农业”的内涵是:立足“大国小农”的基本国情,以“四个农业”的基本功能为支撑,通过机制设计与治理创新,推动“四个农业”深度互嵌、协同联动,最终实现“把农业建成现代化大产业”的目标。统筹发展“四个农业”,具有目标多维、要素渗透、过程循环、治理协同的特征。本文构建了由科技赋能链、市场反馈链组成的“双链耦合”分析框架,分析了促进二者双向互动的稳定价值内核,即“绿色-质量”价值内核。本文的研究进一步指出,统筹发展“四个农业”的挑战在于农业科技供需错配、绿色农业和质量农业价值实现难、品牌溢价反哺链不畅等,深层次的原因则是政策分割、考核短视与协同治理缺失。基于上述分析,本文从推动科技供需适配、构建绿色农业可持续发展机制、加强质量监管和品牌治理、完善利益联结机制、建立价值实现反哺机制和协同治理体系等方面提出了统筹发展“四个农业”的可行路径。
abstract_en: The 15th Five-Year Plan period is a pivotal stage for comprehensively advancing rural vitalization and building up China’s strength in agriculture.Amid intertwined challenges,including tightening resource and environmental constraints,structural shifts in production factors,upgraded consumer demand,and intensified global agricultural competition,the integrated development of technology-driven agriculture,green agriculture,quality agriculture,and brand agriculture has become an inevitable choice to advance agricultural modernization.This paper defines its connotation as advancing the in-depth integration and synergistic linkage of the“Four Agricultures”through mechanism design and governance innovation,anchored in China’s reality of“small-scale agriculture in a large country”and underpinned by the core functions of the four models,to ultimately develop agriculture into a modern large-scale industry.This paradigm features multi-dimensional goals,factor infiltration,cyclical processes,and collaborative governance.A“dual-chain coupling”analytical framework consisting of a technology empowerment chain and a market feedback chain is constructed herein.Applying this framework,the key challenges for the integrated development of the“Four Agricultures”are identified.First,the technology empowerment chain breaks down due to structural sci-tech supply-demand mismatch,a weakened public agricultural technology extension system,and a lack of organized bridging mechanisms.Second,the market feedback chain malfunctions,as regional public brands face the“tragedy of the commons”,hindering value realization,and there is no brand premium feedback mechanism for the industrial chain upstream disrupting the incentive cycle.Third,the“green-quality”core value is unstable,due to insufficient market incentives for green transformation,hurdles in quality standard implementation and supervision,and poor coordination between green and quality certification systems.These challenges stem essentially from cross-departmental policy fragmentation,short-sighted assessment and incentive mechanisms,and inadequate collaborative governance.Accordingly,four targeted paths are proposed:(1)reconstructing the technology empowerment chain for demand-oriented sci-tech supply-demand alignment;(2)consolidating the“green-quality”core value to build a credit-centered market mechanism for ecological value realization;(3)smoothing the market feedback chain by enhancing agricultural brand property governance and optimizing the industrial value feedback mechanism;and(4)establishing a robust collaborative governance system to address policy fragmentation through top-level design,assessment reform,and multi-stakeholder collaboration platforms.The marginal contributions of this study are as follows:(1)taking the integrated development of the“Four Agricultures”as a holistic research object;(2)innovatively developing the“dual-chain coupling”framework and revealing its inherent operational mechanism;(3)attributing practical challenges to the systemic failure of the dual chains and their intrinsic link with fragmented governance;and(4)formulating targeted policy paths aligned with the framework logic,providing concrete references for its integrated development.

title_cn: 生态修复农业:内涵特征、发展逻辑与推进策略
title_en: Ecological Restoration Agriculture:Conceptual Features,Development Logic,and Promotion Strategies
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZOU Baoling;YU Fawen(College of Economics and Management,Southwest University;Research Center for Rural Economy and Management,Southwest University;Rural Development Institute,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences)
institutions_cn: 西南大学经济管理学院 | 西南大学农村经济与管理研究中心 | 中国社会科学院农村发展研究所
index_title: 生态修复农业:内涵特征、发展逻辑与推进策略
abstract_cn: 在农业绿色转型持续推进的过程中,大量退化或生态条件恶劣区域难以同时纳入常规农业生产体系与生态修复实践,凸显了现有农业发展模式在生态修复协同方面的结构性局限。在此背景下,本文系统阐释了“生态修复农业”这一新型农业发展模式的内涵特征、发展逻辑与推进策略。生态修复农业以退化或恶劣生态系统为载体,以农业生产活动为实现途径,依托特别的技术体系开发利用非常规农业资源,实现农产品生产与生态系统恢复的协同推进。生态修复农业具有利用非常规农业环境和资源、依赖特殊技术体系等基本特征,兼具生态修复与农业生产双重功能,在拓展农业发展空间、促进生态修复市场化等方面展现出独特优势。从理论上看,其发展基础在于生态系统恢复过程中对自然力量的有效利用、农业资源与空间的拓展潜力、农业生物生境适应性的可塑性,以及农业固有的生态功能与生态修复目标的高度契合。从实践层面看,生态修复农业的推进,有赖于政府引导、关键技术突破、社会力量参与及制度保障。现有实践案例显示,该模式具有较强的经济可行性和综合效益,发展前景良好。未来应通过加强技术创新、健全制度体系、强化规划管理和完善政策支持,推动生态修复农业的持续健康发展。
abstract_en: In promoting agricultural green transformation,many degraded or ecologically fragile areas cannot be simultaneously incorporated into conventional agricultural production systems and ecological restoration practices.This limitation reveals the structural constrations of existing agricultural development models in coordinating agricultural production with ecological restoration.Against this background,this paper systematically examines a new agricultural development model,known as ecological restoration agriculture(ERA),by analyzing its conceptual features,development logic,and promotion strategies.ERA takes degraded or harsh ecosystems as its spatial carrier and agricultural production activities as its operational pathway.It relies on specialized technical systems to develop and utilize unconventional agricultural resources,thereby achieving the coordinated advancement of agricultural production and ecosystem restoration.ERA is characterized by the utilization of non-traditional agricultural environments and resources,dependence on specialized technologies,and the integration of ecological restoration functions with agricultural production functions.This model demonstrates distinct advantages in expanding agricultural development space and promoting the market-oriented operation of ecological restoration.From a theoretical perspective,the development of ERA is grounded in four key foundations.First,it is based on the effective use of the natural recovery process in ecosystem.Second,it reflects the potential expansion of agricultural resources and production space beyond conventional arable land.Third,it draws on the plasticity of agricultural organisms’habitat adaptability through selective breeding and biotechnology.Fourth,it aligns agricultural ecological functions with the objectives of ecological restoration,forming a high degree of functional compatibility between agricultural activities and ecosystem rehabilitation.From a practical perspective,the advancement of ERA depends on several institutional and technical conditions,including government guidance,breakthroughs in key technologies,participation of social forces,and sound institutional safeguards.Existing practical cases indicate that ERA exhibits relatively strong economic feasibility and comprehensive benefits by combining ecological improvement with industrial development and livelihood enhancement.By utilizing previously unused or marginal natural resources in ecologically degraded regions,ERA can promote agricultural development while simultaneously stimulating related industries such as agricultural processing and eco-tourism,thereby creating new opportunities for regional socio-economic development and employment growth.The findings suggest that ERA provides a viable pathway for addressing the dual challenges of ecological degradation and agricultural development in fragile areas.Policy implications include strengthening technological innovation,improving institutional arrangements,enhancing spatial planning and management,and establishing integrated policy support systems covering technical guidance,fiscal subsidies,tax incentives,and land-use policies.This study contributes by conceptualizing ERA as an integrated framework linking ecological restoration with agricultural production,and by clarifying its theoretical foundations and promotion mechanisms.It extends existing research on nature-based solutions and agricultural green development by highlighting the role of unconventional agricultural resources and degraded ecosystems in expanding agricultural development pathways.

title_cn: 西部特色产业转型升级的演进逻辑与驱动路径
title_en: The Evolutionary Logic and Driving Mechanisms Underpinning the Transformation and Upgrading of Specialty Industries in Western China
authors_cn: 罗睿 | 刘婉钰 | 丁赛
authors_en_and_affiliations: LUO Rui;LIU Wanyu;DING Sai(School of Sociology and Anthropology,University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;Institute of Agricultural Economics and Development,Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences;The Institute of Ethnology and Anthropology,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences)

index_title: 西部特色产业转型升级的演进逻辑与驱动路径
abstract_cn: 加快推动西部特色产业转型升级是传承地方特色文化、激发区域内生发展动力、培育新质生产力的重要途径。本文以云南省文山三七产业为案例,采用长周期、持续性跟踪访谈和田野调研的研究方法,基于复杂适应系统理论探究其实现特色产业转型升级的演进逻辑,揭示拥有特色文化资源禀赋的西部地区实现产业转型升级的驱动路径。研究发现:第一,文山三七产业发展经历要素整合、效率提升和创新突破三个阶段,通过地理标志产权价值界定、传统知识转化和核心技术攻关,推动该地区从区域性原材料供应基地跃升为具备全球价值链网络主导能力的重要枢纽,实现产业系统层级的适应性跃迁。第二,制度与技术的协同演化通过地方文化的黏合、催化与整合呈现递归强化特征,依托传统文化在知识转化和价值认同上的独特优势,实现产业制度体系和技术能力的动态平衡。第三,西部特色产业通过文化资本降低技术本土化适配成本,同时通过文化价值增值重构价值链位势,形成文化赋能驱动产业转型升级的非对称性优势。最后,本文从提升地方特色产业文化支持力度、深化特色资源管理制度改革、强化西部企业创新主体地位三个方面提出政策启示。本文为推进西部特色产业转型升级提供更具综合性、动态性的学理依据与有益参考。
abstract_en: It is a consensus that the regional resource endowment and cultural genes of specialty industries are irreplaceable.However,the evolutionary logic and driving mechanisms underpinning the transformation and upgrading of specialty industries in Western China remain unclear.Based on the complex adaptive systems(CAS)theory,this paper constructs an“institution-technology”dual-helix driving model.Through a grounded analysis of the evolutionary process of the transformation and upgrading of the Panax notoginseng industry in Wenshan,it reveals the evolutionary logic and driving mechanisms of specialty industries in Western China endowed with unique cultural capital,thereby providing a mechanistic explanation for developing new quality productive forces according to local conditions.This paper finds that:(1)The transformation and upgrading of specialty industries requires overcoming a tripartite ecological-institutional-cognitive constraint system.This nonlinear process involves ecological carrying capacity thresholds,institution-technology mismatches,and discursive incongruence between traditional and modern knowledge as core barriers.(2)Specialty industries in Western China navigate adaptive transitions through three distinct phases.First,in the factor integration period(2001–2008),the government established geographical indication rights and validated cultural capital,laying the groundwork for industrial intensification.Second,in the efficiency enhancement period(2009–2018),“industry-university-research”collaborations scientized traditional knowledge,while comprehensive industry-chain standards reduced adaptation costs.Third,in the innovation breakthrough period(2019–2025),government and enterprises collaborate to lead the development of international standards and resource integration,propelling the region beyond its historical constraints as a mere raw material supplier,thereby elevating it into a strategic hub capable of orchestrating global value chain networks.(3)Cultural capital drives transformation by performing three functions:its genomic atlas function establishes biological parameter databases to reduce technological trial-and-error costs;its demand-response function enhances market premiums through narrative reconstruction;and its field-construction function integrates the dual-helix momentum of“institutional supply-technological breakthrough”.The policy implications are as follows.First,it should incorporate the cultural capital of specialty industries as an independent production factor to translate ethnic medicinal wisdom into international standard parameters.Second,it should deepen institutional reforms for specialty resource management to ensure their orderly development.Third,it should strengthen innovation capacity in Western China by prioritizing license approval for culturally derived products,thereby systematically converting resources like traditional rituals and oral histories into geo-authentic brand assets..

title_cn: 农村集体产权制度改革能否降低乡村债务风险
title_en: Can the Rural Collective Property Rights System Reform Reduce the Debt Risk in Rural Areas
authors_cn: 唐溧 | 马惠娴 | 马九杰 | 胡梦园
authors_en_and_affiliations: TANG Li;MA Huixian;MA Jiujie;HU Mengyuan(College of Finance,Nanjing Agricultural University;School of Agricultural Economics and Rural Development,Renmin University of China)
institutions_cn: 南京农业大学金融学院 | 中国人民大学农业与农村发展学院
index_title: 农村集体产权制度改革能否降低乡村债务风险
abstract_cn: 安全、可控的乡村债务是发展新型农村集体经济的重要支撑。本文利用2011-2021年农业农村部全国农村固定观察点数据,考察农村集体产权制度改革能否降低乡村债务风险。研究发现,农村集体产权制度改革的实施显著降低了乡村债务风险,这主要源于相关改革举措能够有效控制乡村债务规模、提高固定资产价值,从减债和增源两方面降低债务风险。但由于对壮大新型农村集体经济发展方式的探索仍不充分,现阶段通过增加新型农村集体经济收入来降低债务风险的机制尚未充分显现。另外,异质性分析表明,农村集体产权制度改革对乡村治理水平较高、交通设施较完善和经济发展水平较低的村庄债务风险的降低效果更好。据此,本文认为,在深化农村集体产权制度改革的进程中,在加强债务治理的同时,应着力提升村集体资产运营效率和市场化水平,提高村集体经营性收入,并加强村庄治理,提高交通便利水平,以更好地发挥农村集体产权制度改革在降低乡村债务风险方面的作用。
abstract_en: Reducing rural debt risks is an important prerequisite for promoting comprehensive rural revitalization and developing the new-type rural collective economy.The high level of village-level debt has attracted great attention from academia and government departments.Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China,the reform of the rural collective property rights system in China has been continuously deepened,which is an important means to develop the new-type rural collective economy.Generally speaking,a more perfect collective property rights system will bring multiple benefits at the economic and governance levels for the development of the new-type rural collective economy.Therefore,whether the rural collective property rights system reform can achieve the governance goal of reducing rural debt risks still needs to be tested at the empirical level.Research findings indicate that rural collective property rights system reform reduces the debt risk in rural areas significantly.This is mainly attributed to the measures taken in the early stage of the rural collective property rights system reform,which can enhance financial management and internal supervision,thereby significantly reducing the debt scale and increasing the value of fixed assets.This reduces debt risk from both the aspects of debt reduction and resource increase.However,due to the insufficient exploration of the development modes for strengthening the new-type rural collective economy,the mechanism for reducing debt risks by increasing the income of the new-type rural collective economy has not fully emerged at this stage.In addition,heterogeneity analysis reveals that the rural collective property rights system reform has a better effect on reducing the debt risk of villages with better rural governance,better transportation facilities,and lower economic development levels.The possible marginal contributions of this paper are as follows.First,a measurement index for village-level debt risk is constructed from a unified perspective of debt scale and constraints of debt-repayment resources,and alternative indicators are used for verification in the robustness test,thereby providing an operational measurement idea for the study of village-level debt risk.Second,based on that existing literature mainly focuses on the impacts of the rural collective property rights system reform on the development of the rural collective economy and rural governance,this paper further examines whether this reform has achieved the governance goal in terms of debt risk prevention and resolution,thereby expanding the research perspective of the policy performance evaluation of the rural collective property rights system reform.Third,this paper systematically analyzes the impact path of the rural collective property rights system reform on rural debt risks from two aspects:debt scale and debt-repayment resource constraints.It reveals the mechanism by which the rural collective property rights system reform reduces rural debt risks and provides empirical evidence for understanding the debt governance effect of the rural collective property rights system reform.
