title_cn: 农村集体经济组织增收治理逻辑——基于“弱关系-结构洞”分析框架的案例研究
title_en: The Logic of Income-Growth Governance in Rural Collective Economic Organizations:A Case Study Based on the“Weak Ties-Structural Holes”Analytical Framework
authors_en_and_affiliations: QIN Guanyu;LI Tao(College of Economics and Management,Northwest A&F University)
institutions_cn: 西北农林科技大学经济管理学院
index_title: 农村集体经济组织增收治理逻辑——基于“弱关系-结构洞”分析框架的案例研究
abstract_cn: 农村集体经济组织在实践中普遍面临增收困境,但已有研究多受具体案例情境的约束,主要从困境成因剖析或经验模式总结入手,缺乏系统的理论整合与完整的案例验证。本文立足农村集体经济组织的三类增收困境,将资源编排理论和社会网络理论相结合,以“弱关系转化-结构洞复苏-结构洞优势应用”为理论分析主线,嵌入资源编排理论中的资源组织、资源捆绑与能力利用机制,构建农村集体经济组织增收治理的“弱关系-结构洞”分析框架,并通过多案例研究系统厘清其增收治理逻辑。研究表明,农村集体经济组织通过文化嵌入和利益联结机制,将特定弱关系转化为稳定的强关系,是推进增收治理的前提条件;进一步复苏自身结构洞位置并构建经营模式,是开展增收治理的关键支撑;最终利用结构洞优势开展经营并培育竞争能力,是完成增收治理的核心驱动力。为此,要充分发挥关系能动性,挖掘蕴藏在农村社会网络中的经济资源,复苏农村集体经济组织的结构洞位置并发挥其优势,摆脱增收困境。本文旨在为农村集体经济组织收入增长研究贡献基于中国农村社会网络的新视角,揭示增收治理的核心逻辑;在打破案例研究情境局限的同时,丰富增收治理的理论内涵,提升研究结论指导实践的普遍性。
abstract_en: Rural collective economic organizations face persistent income-growth dilemmas in practice.Existing studies are mostly constrained by specific case contexts and primarily focus on identifying the causes of these dilemmas or summarizing practice-based models,leaving a gap in systematic theoretical integration and comprehensive case-based validation.Based on the three types of the income-growth dilemma of rural collective economic organizations,this paper integrates resource orchestration theory and social network theory.It takes the“weak ties transformation–structural holes revival–structural holes advantage application”perspective as the core analytical thread,and embeds the three practical mechanisms of resource orchestration:resource structuring,resource bundling,and capability leveraging.Then,it constructs a“weak ties–structural holes”analytical framework for income-growth governance in rural collective economic organizations and elucidates the governance logic through a multi-case study.This paper finds that transforming specific weak ties into stable strong ties through cultural embedding and benefit linkage mechanisms constitutes the precondition for launching income-growth governance,as it enables rural collective economic organizations to mobilize relational resources and complete initial resource structuring within rural social networks.Based on this,reviving their structural hole positions and constructing business models provides the key support for advancing income-growth governance by facilitating resource bundling across heterogeneous actors.Ultimately,leveraging structural hole advantages in business operations and cultivating competitive capabilities forms the core driving force for accomplishing income-growth governance by enabling capability leveraging toward sustainable income generation.Accordingly,it is essential to give full play to relational agency,harness the economic resources latent in rural social networks,and revive and leverage the structural hole positions of rural collective economic organizations,thereby extricating them from the income-growth dilemma.This paper aims to contribute a new perspective on income growth in rural collective economic organizations grounded in the structure and dynamics of Chinese rural social networks,and elucidates the core logic of income-growth governance.By transcending case-specific contextual constraints,it enriches the theoretical understanding of income-growth governance and enhances the generalizability of the research findings for guiding practice.

title_cn: “一带一路”倡议何以影响共建国家企业劳动收入份额——来自当地微观企业数据的证据
title_en: How Does the Belt and Road Initiative Affect the Labor Income Share of Enterprises in Participating Countries:Evidence Based on the Data of Local Enterprises
authors_cn: 马新啸 | 梁正一 | 赵艳平 | 刘潋
authors_en_and_affiliations: MA Xinxiao;LIANG Zhengyi;ZHAO Yanping;LIU Lian(College of Management,Ocean University of China;School of Economics,Ocean University of China;China Business Working Capital Management Research Center,Ocean University of China;School of Business,Sun Yat-Sen University)

index_title: “一带一路”倡议何以影响共建国家企业劳动收入份额——来自当地微观企业数据的证据
abstract_cn: “一带一路”倡议是全球共享发展机遇和构建人类命运共同体的关键举措,对推动共建国家实现共同富裕具有重要影响。本文通过Thomson One Banker数据库整理得到1992-2021年“一带一路”共建国家微观企业的数据,基于劳动收入份额的视角,研究“一带一路”倡议能否促进共建国家企业更加公平地进行劳资分配。研究发现:国家加入“一带一路”倡议后,当地企业的劳动收入份额平均上升2.2%,劳动报酬在初次分配中的比例得到提升。机制检验表明,“一带一路”倡议通过完善共建国家的基础设施、政策制度和融资环境,促进贸易合作和人文交流,不仅能够扩大共建国家的劳动力市场需求,提高当地劳动者的技能水平,而且能够完善共建国家的劳工保障制度,促进当地劳动者跨区域流动,进而提升共建国家劳动者的议价能力,推动当地企业劳动收入份额的提升。异质性分析表明,“一带一路”倡议对共建国家企业劳动收入份额的提升作用,在地理距离与中国更远、社会文化与中国相近、居民收入水平较低、劳工保护制度较差的国家更为明显,在处于成熟期、规模较小以及研发投入较高的企业更为显著,在资本密集型、劳动要素回报较高以及整体要素产出较高的行业更加突出。经济后果检验表明,“一带一路”倡议还能提高共建国家微观企业的雇员数量和工资水平,具有良好的社会效益。
abstract_en: The Belt and Road Initiative(BRI)is a key measure for sharing development opportunities and building a community with a shared future for mankind.It plays a crucial role in advancing common prosperity among participating countries.This paper uses the Thomson One Banker database to obtain the data of enterprises in participating countries from 1992 to 2021.From the perspective of labor income share,this paper investigates whether the BRI can promote fairer distribution within enterprises in participating countries.The main findings are:(1)After countries joined the BRI,the labor income share of local enterprises increases significantly by 2.2%,indicating an improved proportion of labor compensation in primary income distribution.(2)Mechanism tests reveal that the BRI,by enhancing infrastructure,policy systems,and financing environments in participating countries,and by fostering trade cooperation and cultural exchanges,not only expands labor market demand and elevates the skill levels of local workers but also improves labor institution safeguards and facilitates cross-regional mobility of the local workforce.These effects collectively enhance the bargaining power of workers in participating countries,thereby increasing the labor income share in local enterprises.(3)Heterogeneity analysis shows that the labor income share-enhancing effect of the BRI is more pronounced in countries geographically farther from China,socioculturally closer to China,with lower resident income levels,and weaker labor protection systems.Additionally,the effect is more significant in enterprises that are in their mature stage,smaller in scale,and with higher R&D investment,as well as in capital-intensive industries,have higher returns to labor factors,and exhibit higher overall factor output.(4)Finally,tests on economic consequences indicate that the BRI increases the number of employees and wage levels in enterprises in the participating countries,demonstrating positive social benefits.This paper presents the following contributions.First,by utilizing enterprise data from participating countries,it investigates the impact of the BRI on labor-capital distribution within market entities in these countries,thereby significantly expanding research on the international economic implications of the BRI.Second,it provides an important extension to research on factors influencing the labor-income share of enterprises across different countries,innovatively shifting the research perspective on the BRI from a“participating countries’narrative”to“local enterprises’behavior”.Third,the findings offer a scientific basis for accurately assessing the social benefits of the BRI for participating countries at the micro-mechanism level.

index_title: “一带一路”倡议对非共建国家农产品出口的影响——基于外部性的分析视角
abstract_cn: “一带一路”倡议作为重要的国际合作平台,在推动共建国家出口贸易方面已取得显著成效,但鲜有文献深入探讨其对非共建国家出口带来的影响。本文基于1996-2019年全球双边产品贸易数据的实证研究发现:“一带一路”倡议对共建国家间农产品出口具有较强的促进作用,同时使得非共建国家向共建国家的农产品出口金额提升3.84%,农产品出口份额提升3.62%。异质性分析表明,“一带一路”倡议对非共建国家产生的外部性在农产品种类、农产品特征、进出口国地理位置方面均存在显著差异。进一步研究表明,“一带一路”倡议通过共建国家的外商直接投资机制和政府治理机制对非共建国家农产品出口产生影响,并且该正向外部性体现为在不改变非共建国家农产品出口比较优势的情况下实现的贸易创造。本文研究有助于消除国际社会对“一带一路”倡议的误解和质疑,彰显“一带一路”倡议共享机遇的发展理念。
abstract_en: As an international cooperation platform,the Belt and Road Initiative has achieved significant results in promoting the export trade of participating countries.However,does it generate spillover effects on exports to non-participating countries?Demonstrating such positive externalities helps reduce international skepticism toward the Belt and Road Initiative and facilitate its deeper implementation and wider diffusion.However,existing literature rarely examines this externality directly.Based on global bilateral product trade data from 1996 to 2019,this study finds that the Belt and Road Initiative increased the value of agricultural exports from non-participating to participating countries by 3.84%and raised the share of such exports by 3.62%.In comparison,the Initiative exerted a stronger promoting effect on agricultural trade among participating countries.The external effects on non-participating countries exhibit significant heterogeneity across agricultural product categories,product characteristics,and regional dimensions.The spillover effects are empirically validated through mediating mechanisms,namely,the foreign direct investment and the governance quality of participating countries.These externalities are shown to be trade-creating rather than trade-diverting,and they do not erode non-participating countries’comparative advantage in exports.The marginal contributions of this study are threefold.First,using product-level data at the HS 1996 six-digit level from the CEPII-BACI database,this study is the first to construct three indicators of agricultural product characteristics,namely,transport dependence,time sensitivity,and risk resilience.Then,this study finds that the Initiative’s external effects are heterogeneous across the three characteristics,highlighting the potential application value of these indicators.Second,this study does not confine the analysis to countries along the Belt and Road,nor does it mix participating and non-participating countries within the same empirical framework.By focusing on non-participating countries,this study identifies more directly the Initiative’s positive externalities on their agricultural exports and avoids bias arising from confounding influences.Third,this study uncovers the hard-connectivity and soft-connectivity channels through which the Initiative generates external effects for non-participating countries,thereby filling a gap in existing literature on underlying mechanisms.Generally,this study contributes to dispelling misconceptions and doubts in the international community regarding the Belt and Road Initiative,highlighting its development philosophy of sharing opportunities.

title_cn: 阻碍人口流入乡村的村民身份认同与外群排斥——来自列表实验的证据
title_en: Villagers’Identity and Out-Group Exclusion that Affect the Population Flow into Villages:Evidence from a List Experiment
authors_cn: 李彬 | 周战强 | 支惠 | 何召鹏
authors_en_and_affiliations: LI Bin;ZHOU Zhanqiang;ZHI Hui;HE Zhaopeng(School of Economics,Central University of Finance and Economics)

abstract_cn: 城乡融合发展是实现乡村振兴和共同富裕的必然要求,而促进要素的双向自由流动是城乡融合发展的核心。但数据显示,当前人口流入乡村的规模还很小。本文基于身份经济学理论,运用信息干预的列表实验方法,揭示了村民隐藏的对外来人口的外群排斥行为及其影响因素。研究发现:第一,约有24%的村民排斥外来人口,但他们会隐藏这一真实态度;第二,向村民传递人口流入可以提高土地流转收益的信息干预能够显著降低其对外来人口的排斥;第三,若村民认为外来人口的到来会损害人居与社会环境,则他们会显著提高对外来人口的排斥。这些发现意味着,通过外部资源流入提高村民经济收入和实施促进社会融合的公共政策可以缓解村民对外来人口的社会排斥,吸引人才流入乡村。本文通过引入村民外群排斥这一社会因素,深化了对要素流入乡村阻碍机制的理解,并通过引入信息干预的列表实验方法,实证测定了村民外群排斥的水平,系统分析了其潜在影响因素,从而为制定促进要素流入乡村的政策提供了依据。
abstract_en: The free flow of various factors to rural areas is a prerequisite for China to achieve comprehensive revitalization in rural regions.Population is the most important factor among the productive factors.So far,hundreds of millions of people have moved from rural areas to cities.However,the scale of population flowing to rural areas remains small.Existing research has found that the main factors inhibiting population flow to rural areas are urban-rural disparity in factor returns,the household registration system,and the constraints of rural property rights systems.This paper argues that there is another significant factor hindering population flow to rural areas—the exclusion of outsiders by villagers.As the social isolation in China’s rural areas far exceeds that in urban communities,the closed nature of rural household registration policies makes it difficult for villagers to regard outsiders as part of their own community.Such group differences lead to villagers’exclusion of outsiders.This paper first constructs a theoretical model characterizing villagers’identity recognition and exclusion of outsiders.The model elucidates the motivations behind villagers’exclusion behaviors,deriving potential influences of factors such as income and social environment,which form the core research hypotheses.To mitigate the“social expectation bias”,this paper employs a list experiment with incidental information intervention.Conducted in 59 administrative villages across 19 provinces(autonomous regions and municipalities)involving 415 rural households,the field-based list questionnaire experiment investigates the actual extent of villagers’exclusion of outsiders and its determinants.The theoretical analysis in this study demonstrates that villagers exhibit identity-based exclusion of migrants,with their attitudes toward outsiders evolving in response to income changes and shifts in living environments.Field experiment results partially validate the theoretical expectations.First,approximately 24%of villagers exclude migrants but conceal their actual attitudes.Second,information interventions conveying that population inflow enhances land transfer benefits significantly reduce exclusion.Third,villagers perceive migrants as damaging their living and social environments,leading to heightened exclusion.Heterogeneity analysis reveals significant variations in exclusion levels across genders,ethnic groups,religious affiliations,education levels,and political orientations,with notable regional disparities.Villages in villages with higher public expenditures exhibit stronger exclusion tendencies.These findings suggest that villagers’exclusion of outsiders may indeed hinder population flow into rural areas.Implementing public policies to boost villagers’economic income through external resources and promote social integration can mitigate villagers’exclusion of outsiders,thereby attracting talent and other resources to rural areas.The marginal contributions are as follows.This paper is the first to discover evidence of severe out-group exclusion in rural China.By introducing the social factor of villagers’out-group exclusion,this paper deepens the understanding of the mechanisms hindering the flow of factors into rural areas.Moreover,by employing the list experiment method with information intervention,this paper is the first to measure villagers’out-group exclusion behavior and conduct a systematic questionnaire analysis of various potential factors influencing villagers’out-group exclusion.Thereby,this paper provides a new empirical basis for formulating policies to promote the flow of factors into rural areas.

title_en: The Ecological Wealth View Oriented Toward Chinese Modernization:Theoretical Interpretation and Policy Implications
authors_en_and_affiliations: QI Yu;DENG Ziwi(School of Public Finance and Taxation,Zhongnan University of Economics and Law)
institutions_cn: 中南财经政法大学财政税务学院
index_title: 面向中国式现代化的生态财富观:理论阐释与政策意涵
abstract_cn: 面向中国式现代化的生态财富观,是对解放和发展新质生产力的整体性、系统性认识。生态财富以自然资本为核心生产资料,呈现出多维功能。商品性生态财富由人类劳动与“生态生产”共同创造,非商品性生态财富则由政府、市场和社会多元主体协同供给,深刻反映了新时代背景下人与自然、人与人之间的特定关系。生态财富的价值实现是将其蕴含的生态价值转化为经济价值与社会价值的过程。为打通价值转化通道,应明确生态要素的产权类型与分配结构,建立健全生态产品消费市场体系,以技术创新引领生态生产力发展,并通过制度建设构建与生态生产力相适应的生态生产关系。同时,还应注重实现生态财富的持续积累、公平分配与有序流动。以生态财富创造及其价值实现为路径推进共同富裕,需要深刻把握其内在的经济逻辑、制度逻辑和社会逻辑。在实践中,应持续做大、做强、做优生态财富,加强生态环境本底保护,保障生态财富的有效供给,规范生态财富积累机制与分配秩序,扎实推动共同富裕。
abstract_en: Amidst the major changes unseen in a century,ecological issues are no longer mere environmental concerns but have increasingly become systemic constraints concerning development quality,social equity,and national security.Existing research on ecological wealth predominantly focuses on specific areas,and practical explorations mostly take the form of individual policies,presenting an overall fragmented characteristic.Therefore,focusing on the links of production,circulation,exchange,consumption,and distribution,this paper constructs a theoretical analytical framework of"wealth creation-value realization-common prosperity"to interpret the ecological wealth view oriented toward Chinese modernization and its policy implications.The main findings of this study are as follows.Ecological wealth is a composite form of wealth that takes natural capital as its core means of production and demonstrates multi-dimensional functions,including ecological protection,economic development,social service,and the safeguarding of national security.Commodity ecological wealth is co-created by human labor and"ecological production",while non-commodity ecological wealth is jointly supplied by the government,market,and society.To transform the ecological value embedded in ecological wealth into economic and social value,it is necessary to clarify the property rights of ecological elements,establish a sound market system for the consumption of ecological products,adhere to technological innovation,and achieve the continuous accumulation and fair distribution of ecological wealth.In practice,it is imperative to respect economic logic,institutional logic,and social logic,continuously expand,strengthen,and optimize ecological wealth,strengthen the protection of the ecological environment,ensure the effective supply of ecological wealth,standardize the accumulation mechanism and distribution order of ecological wealth,and solidly promote substantive progress in common prosperity.The innovations and marginal contributions of this study are reflected in the following aspects.First,this study constructs a systematic analytical framework for wealth that covers all links in the national economic circulation.Second,guided by the Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization and Xi Jinping Thought on Economy,and rooted in the inherent logic of ecological civilization construction and the operational mechanism of the"Two Mountains"theory,this study distills the essence of the ecological wealth view oriented toward Chinese modernization.Third,it summarizes the economic,institutional,and social logic of leveraging ecological wealth creation and its value realization to advance common prosperity,and proposes specific practical pathways.

title_cn: 以农村互助养老促进老有所为:内在机制、现实困境与优化路径
title_en: Promoting Productive Ageing Through Rural Mutual Support for the Elderly:Internal Mechanisms,Practical Challenges,and Optimization Paths
authors_en_and_affiliations: WANG Hui;CHEN Xiaoyuan(School of Public Policy and Administration,Chongqing University;Chongqing Collaborative Innovation Center for Local Governance at CQU)
institutions_cn: 重庆大学公共管理学院 | 重庆大学重庆市地方政府治理协同创新中心
index_title: 以农村互助养老促进老有所为:内在机制、现实困境与优化路径
abstract_cn: 农村在面临巨大养老压力的同时,也具有丰富的老年人力资源。然而,既有研究多关注如何实现老有所养,对促进老有所为关注不足。与其他养老方式相比,农村互助养老在保障老有所养的同时,还具有促进老有所为的潜能。本文分析了农村互助养老促进老有所为的可能空间及其内在机制,并基于现实困境提出了优化路径。研究有以下发现:农村互助养老可以通过动员整合、角色转换、机会创设三重机制促进老有所为。互助养老将分散化的农村老年人整合为组织化的群体,将其角色从传统固有的养老服务消费者转变为生产者,既通过聚焦以老助老和自主治理在互助养老组织内部创设老有所为的机会空间,又通过与乡村振兴的联结在组织外部创设老有所为的机会空间。然而,作为仍处于探索阶段的养老方式,以农村互助养老促进老有所为面临互助养老组织长效运行基础不牢固、消极老龄观制约和互助传统弱化、老年人参与程度和参与能力有限、机会空间创设有限等现实困境。因此,需要保障农村互助养老长效运行,夯实思想文化基础,实现更广泛的老年群体参与,从组织内部和外部共同创设老有所为的机会空间。
abstract_en: While facing immense pressure in elderly care,rural areas possess abundant resources among their ageing populations.However,existing research has largely focused on ensuring basic care for the elderly,with insufficient attention given to fostering productive ageing.Compared to other elderly care models,rural mutual support for the elderly not only provides care for the elderly but also holds potential for enabling productive ageing.This paper analyzes the potential space and underlying mechanisms through which rural mutual support for the elderly can facilitate productive ageing,proposing optimization pathways based on practical constraints.This paper presents the following findings.Rural mutual support for the elderly promotes productive ageing through three mechanisms:mobilization and integration,role transformation,and opportunity creation.Specifically,it organizes dispersed elderly individuals in rural areas into collective groups,transforming their roles from traditional consumers of elderly care services into producers.Opportunities for productive ageing are created internally within mutual support organizations through peer support and self-governance,while additional opportunities are generated externally through connections with rural revitalization.However,as an elderly care model still in its exploratory stage,promoting productive ageing through rural mutual support for the elderly faces several practical challenges,including the unstable foundation for the long-term operation of mutual support organizations,constraints from negative perceptions of ageing and weakening mutual support traditions,limited participation levels and capabilities among the elderly,and insufficient opportunities for productive ageing.Therefore,it is necessary to strengthen the sustainable operation of rural mutual support for the elderly,consolidate its cultural and ideological foundations,expand participation among the elderly,and create opportunity spaces for productive ageing within and beyond organizations.The contributions of the paper are threefold.First,it breaks away from the traditional welfare-oriented approach to elderly care,examines rural mutual support for the elderly from the perspective of productive ageing,and emphasizes the initiative of the elderly in the elderly care.Second,it analyzes the internal mechanisms through which rural mutual support for the elderly promotes productive ageing.Third,it examines the practical constraints on promoting productive ageing through rural mutual support from four perspectives of organizations,environments,subjects,and objects,and proposes targeted optimization pathways.

title_cn: 技术适应性:农村老年群体数字包容的实现逻辑
title_en: Technological Adaptability:The Realization Logic of Digital Inclusion for Rural Elderly
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZHANG Yihan(National Institute of Cultural Development,Wuhan University)
institutions_cn: 武汉大学国家文化发展研究院
index_title: 技术适应性:农村老年群体数字包容的实现逻辑
abstract_cn: 在数字下乡与人口老龄化并行的背景下,如何实现农村老年群体的数字包容,已成为推进数字乡村建设的重要议题。本文提出“技术适应性”这一核心概念,构建“场景-关系-主体”三维分析框架,以浙江省杭州市萧山区楼塔镇“美美大同”数字治理系统为案例,探讨数字乡村建设中农村老年群体包容性路径的形成机制。研究发现,实现数字包容的关键在于数字技术要具备“适应性”,具体表现为数字技术的规则体系在进入乡村社会时主动识别、响应并协同在地社会基础的动态过程。技术适应性主要通过三个维度作用于农村老年群体:在场景维度,数字技术通过嵌入乡村空间环境、社会文化与治理运行结构,从外部工具转变为内生媒介;在关系维度,数字技术能有效激活和重构血缘、地缘等传统社会网络,并将其转化为支持老年人数字融入的社会资本;在主体维度,数字技术能通过适老化设计、物质精神复合激励与角色重塑等方式,充分契合老年人的身心状态、认知模式与价值期待。研究进一步揭示,由技术适应性所构建的技术与社会良性互动关系,有助于推动数字下乡成为激发社会协作、实现乡村数字包容的长效实践。本文研究为促进农村老年群体的数字融入提供了理论参照,对建设具有中国特色的包容型数字乡村具有重要启示。
abstract_en: Against the backdrop of the parallel advancement of digital technology in rural areas and population ageing,achieving digital inclusion for the rural elderly has become a crucial issue in promoting digital village construction.This study focuses on the core issue of"how to achieve digital inclusion for the rural elderly",proposes the core concept of"technological adaptability",and constructs a three-dimensional analytical framework of"scene-relationship-subject".Taking the"Meimei Datong"digital governance system in Louta Town,Xiaoshan District,Hangzhou City,Zhejiang Province,as a case,it explores the formation mechanism of inclusive pathways in digital village construction.The study yields three main conclusions.First,the key to achieving digital inclusion lies in the"technological adaptability"of digital technology—a dynamic process wherein the rule systems of digital technology actively identify,respond to,and coordinate with local social foundations upon entering rural society,thereby achieving the goal of digital inclusion.Second,technological adaptability affects rural elderly through three dimensions.In the scene dimension,digital technology embeds itself into rural spatial environments,socio-cultural contexts,and governance structures,transforming from an external tool into an endogenous medium.In the relationship dimension,digital technology effectively activates and reconstructs traditional social networks based on kinship and geography,converting them into social capital that supports the digital integration of the elderly.In the subject dimension,through age-friendly design,combined material and spiritual incentives,and social role reconstruction,digital technology aligns closely with the physical and mental conditions,cognitive patterns,and value expectations of the elderly.Third,sustainable digital inclusion is built upon the foundation of continuous technology-society interaction.Accordingly,this study proposes policy implications,including promoting context-specific institutional design,cultivating community-driven social support capabilities in rural areas,and establishing a multi-dimensional evaluation mechanism centered on the elderly population's lived experiences.The main marginal contributions of this study are as follows.First,it proposes and elaborates the concept of"technological adaptability",expanding the technological sociology perspective within digital inclusion research.Second,it constructs a three-dimensional"scene-relationship-subject"analyticalframework,providing systematic analytical tools for understanding the interaction mechanisms between digital technology and rural society.Third,it reveals the internal logic through which technological adaptability operates on rural elderly populations,offering theoretical references for promoting the digital integration of rural elderly and providing important insights for constructing inclusive digital villages with Chinese characteristics.

title_cn: 产业链纵向整合对涉农企业韧性的影响——以生猪产业为例
title_en: Impact of Vertical Supply Chain Integration on the Resilience of Agriculture-related Enterprises:Taking the Pig Industry as an Example
authors_cn: 季晨 | 徐子龙 | 傅洁敏 | 周洁红
authors_en_and_affiliations: JI Chen;XU Zilong;FU Jiemin;ZHOU Jiehong(School of Public Affairs,Zhejiang University;China Academy for Rural Development,Zhejiang University;Hangzhou United Bank)
institutions_cn: 浙江大学公共管理学院 | 浙江大学中国农村发展研究院 | 杭州联合银行
index_title: 产业链纵向整合对涉农企业韧性的影响——以生猪产业为例
abstract_cn: 增强涉农企业韧性是提升农业产业韧性、推进农业强国建设的重要支撑。通过产业链纵向整合提升涉农企业韧性是产业组织赋能农业韧性的重要方式。本文以生猪产业为例,利用浙大卡特-企研中国涉农研究数据库中2015-2021年8889家生猪养殖企业数据,基于非洲猪瘟冲击的风险视角,实证检验产业链纵向整合对生猪养殖企业韧性的影响及其作用机制。研究发现,实施产业链纵向整合的企业在冲击发生后表现出更强的韧性,经过一系列稳健性检验后结论依然成立。机制分析表明,涉农企业应通过提高安全生产管理水平、技术创新管理水平提升其在风险冲击前的抵御和调适能力,并通过提高食品质量管理水平和市场品牌建设水平提升其在风险冲击后的恢复和增长能力,从而提升企业韧性。异质性分析表明,生猪养殖产业链前向整合与后向整合均显著提升企业韧性,其中产业链前向整合的作用相对更强。产业链纵向整合对不同规模企业韧性均有提升效果,大规模的生猪养殖企业采取产业链前向整合的韧性提升效果更佳,而中小型企业则更适合通过产业链后向整合增强韧性。政策制定部门可以进一步支持和鼓励生猪养殖企业依据自身禀赋与发展阶段选择适配的产业链纵向整合方式以应对风险冲击,并支持和鼓励生猪养殖企业通过产业链纵向整合提升企业韧性。
abstract_en: Enhancing the resilience of agriculture-related enterprises is an important foundation for enhancing the resilience of the agricultural industry and building up China's strength in agriculture.Improving the resilience of agriculture-related enterprises through vertical supply chain integration represents an important organizational strategy for enhancing agricultural resilience.Taking the pig industry as an example,the African swine fever(ASF)shock,a major external shock that severely disrupted production and pig market stability,provided a quasi-natural experiment to examine how pig enterprises respond to extreme disruptions through organizational adaptation,thereby offering valuable insights for resilience theory.Therefore,this study employs data from 8889 pig production enterprises from 2015 to 2021 obtained from the China Academy for Rural Development-Qiyan China Agri-research Database(CCAD)to investigate how vertical supply chain integration affects the resilience of pig production enterprises and explores the underlying mechanisms.The empirical results show that firms adopting vertical supply chain integration exhibit stronger resilience after the shock.These results remain valid after a series of robustness tests.Mechanism analysis indicates that vertical supply chain integration enhances firm resilience through four channels.Before the shock,it strengthens firms'capacity to resist and adjust to risks by improving safe production management and technological innovation management,thereby enabling them to better withstand initial disruptions.After the shock,it facilitates recovery and growth by improving food quality management and market brand development,which helps firms regain market share and build long-term consumer trust.These mechanisms jointly enhance firms'resilience.Together,they form a coherent system that spans pre-shock prevention and post-shock adaptation.This highlights the multifaceted role of vertical supply chain integration in enhancing resilience.Heterogeneity analysis reveals that both forward and backward vertical supply chain integration taken by pig production enterprises significantly improve firm resilience,while the effect of forward integration is stronger,likely due to its direct access to downstream markets and consumer feedback.Additionally vertical supply chain integration of pig production enterprises improves resilience across firms of different sizes.Large-scale enterprises benefit more from forward integration,whereas small and medium-sized pig production enterprises achieve greater resilience gains through backward integration,as it secures a stable input supply and reduces upstream uncertainty.Policymakers can further support and encourage pig production enterprises to choose suitable models of vertical supply chain integration based on their endowments and stage of development,aiming to cope with the impact of the risks.They should support and encourage these enterprises to enhance corporate resilience through vertical supply chain integration,for instance,by providing targeted subsidies and technical guidance,and facilitating stable partnerships along the supply chain.Such measures can help firms better match integration models with their operational realities and long-term development goals,thereby maximizing the resilience-enhancing effects of vertical supply chain integration.

title_cn: 线上平台接入与小微商户经营韧性——基于动态能力的视角
title_en: Online Platform Access and the Business Resilience of Small and Micro Merchants:A Dynamic Capabilities-Based Analysis
authors_cn: 李冰 | 肖斌卿 | 肖条军
authors_en_and_affiliations: LI Bing;XIAO Binqing;XIAO Tiaojun(College of Finance,Nanjing Agricultural University;School of Management and Engineering,Nanjing University;Jiangsu Key Laboratory of Digital Finance,Nanjing University)
institutions_cn: 南京农业大学金融学院 | 南京大学工程管理学院 | 南京大学江苏省数字金融重点实验室
index_title: 线上平台接入与小微商户经营韧性——基于动态能力的视角
abstract_cn: 线上平台是推动数字经济与实体经济融合的关键载体,线上平台接入能否增强小微商户在突发危机下的经营韧性以及何种机制发挥作用尚缺乏系统性探究。本文利用蚂蚁集团的支付宝码商微观数据,以小微商户所在区县被列入“中高风险地区”名单作为突发危机的准自然实验场景,构建多时点双重差分模型检验线上平台接入对小微商户经营韧性的影响,并基于动态能力理论分析线上平台接入的作用机制。研究发现:线上平台接入显著增强了小微商户在突发危机下的经营韧性,该作用随小微商户线上平台接入程度的提高而增强。线上平台接入有助于小微商户捕捉政策信息、响应市场变化与重构渠道结构,进而提高小微商户在突发危机下的机会感知能力、机会把握能力和变革重构能力,增强其经营韧性。生存必需型小微商户会更多受益于线上平台接入。在总人口和老年人口规模越大的区县,线上平台接入对小微商户经营韧性的增强作用越弱。研究结论为促使小微经济体通过线上平台接入方式增强其应对突发危机的动态能力与经营韧性、有效推进数字经济与实体经济深度融合、促进实体经济高质量发展具有一定的现实意义与政策启示。
abstract_en: Enhancing the business resilience of small and micro merchants(SMMs)is crucial for safeguarding high-quality development of the real economy and promoting inclusive growth.As a key enabler of integrating the digital economy with the real economy,online platforms have the potential to reshape how SMMs respond to external shocks.However,it remains underexplored whether and how online platform access enhances the business resilience of SMMs during unexpected crises.Using micro-level data from QR-code-enabled SMMs on Alipay,this paper measures platform access by adoption of online channels and its access degree by the share of online transactions in total transactions.County-level designation as a"medium-or high-risk area"serves as a quasi-natural experiment.A multi-period difference-in-differences(DID)model identifies the causal effects,with mechanism analyses grounded in the dynamic capability framework.The results show three main findings.First,online platform access significantly improves SMMs'business resilience,with the effect strengthening as the access degree increases.Second,platform access enhances dynamic capabilities-opportunity sensing,seizing,and reconfiguration—by enabling more effective policy information acquisition,faster market response,and flexible channel restructuring,thereby boosting SMMs business resilience.Third,the effect is stronger for survival-essential SMMs but weaker in counties with larger populations or higher shares of elderly residents.These findings provide practical insights into promoting the integration of the digital and real economies and strengthening SMMs'resilience through online platform access.First,platform-based empowerment should be leveraged to cultivate SMMs'dynamic capabilities and deepen their integration into platform ecosystems.Second,SMMs should proactively adopt and utilize platform tools to enhance their ability to cope with crisis shocks.Third,governments should strike a balance between development promotion and regulatory governance to create a supportive institutional environment for the digital transformation of SMMs.This study makes three marginal contributions.First,from the perspective of digital platform empowerment,it examines whether online platform access enhances SMMs'business resilience,extending research on how the digital economy enhances the real economy resilience.Second,by constructing refined measures of SMMs'platform access and its degree of access and embedding them in a dynamic capability framework,this study systematically identifies the mechanisms through which online platform access affects SMMs'business resilience.Third,based on a large-sample empirical design,this paper provides new evidence on the application and development of dynamic capability theory in the context of Chinese small and micro merchants'business practices.

title_cn: 劳务品牌如何促进农村劳动力高质量充分就业
title_en: How Does Labor Brand Promote High-Quality and Full Employment of Rural Labor Forces
authors_cn: 李根丽 | 赵佳佳 | 刘冬 | 刘天军
authors_en_and_affiliations: LI Genli;ZHAO Jiajia;LIU Dong;LIU Tianjun(College of Economics&Management,Northwest A&F University;The Policy and Economic Research Institute,China Academy of Information and Communications Technology)
institutions_cn: 西北农林科技大学经济管理学院 | 中国信息通信研究院政策与经济研究所
index_title: 劳务品牌如何促进农村劳动力高质量充分就业
abstract_cn: 实现农村劳动力高质量充分就业是扎实推进共同富裕的重要基础。劳务品牌作为践行“投资于人”理念的具象化载体,在促进农村劳动力高质量充分就业方面成效显著,但其作用机理尚缺乏系统性理论阐释。本文将劳务品牌作为促进农村劳动力高质量充分就业的切入点,构建劳务品牌促进农村劳动力高质量充分就业的理论分析框架,并以“紫阳修脚师”为例,揭示劳务品牌促进农村劳动力高质量充分就业的作用机制与支撑条件。研究发现:劳务品牌通过人力资本差异化效应与职业技能专业化效应促进农村劳动力充分就业,通过劳务协作组织化效应与劳动关系契约化效应促进农村劳动力稳定就业,通过身份标签重构化效应与价值创造长效化效应促进农村劳动力体面就业,进而共同促进农村劳动力高质量充分就业。技能培训、组织协同和信用建设,既是劳务品牌促进农村劳动力高质量充分就业的支撑条件,也是进一步提升其促进效能的关键着力点。
abstract_en: Achieving high-quality and full employment of rural labor forces is a crucial foundation for solidly advancing common prosperity.As a concrete manifestation of the"investing in human capital"concept,the labor brand has demonstrated significant effectiveness in promoting high-quality and full employment of rural labor forces.However,the underlying mechanisms of this role still lack a systematic theoretical explanation.This paper takes labor brand as the entry point for promoting high-quality and full employment,constructs a theoretical framework analyzing how labor brand promotes high-quality and full employment of rural labor forces,and uses the"Ziyang Pedicurist"brand as a case study to reveal the mechanisms and conditions through which labor brand promotes high-quality and full employment of rural labor forces.The findings show that labor brand promotes full employment of rural labor forces through the differentiation effect of human capital and the specialization effect of vocational skills,promotes stable employment of rural labor forces through the organizational effect of labor cooperation and the contractualization effect of labor relations,and promotes decent employment of rural labor forces through the identity tag reconstruction effect and the long-term value creation effect,thereby jointly promoting high-quality and full employment of rural labor forces.Further analysis identifies skills training,organizational synergy,and credit system development as the necessary conditions for the labor brand to promote high-quality and full employment of rural labor forces.Strengthening the skill training system,improving the organizational collaborative governance mechanism,and deepening the credit system construction of the labor brand are key to enhancing the promotion effectiveness of labor brands.The marginal contributions of this paper are threefold.First,it expands the theoretical research system of labor brand,enriches the theoretical connotation of"labor service"as a special commodity in the context of deepening division of labor,and promotes the development and improvement of theories related to labor brand.Second,it constructs a theoretical framework for how labor brand promotes high-quality and full employment of rural labor forces,opens up the"black box"of how labor brand promotes full stable,and decent employment of rural labor forces,and addresses the shortcomings of existing research in depicting the mechanisms through which labor brand promotes high-quality and full employment of rural labor forces.Third,it analyzes the necessary conditions for labor brands to promote high-quality and full employment of rural labor forces,elaborates on the important roles of skills training,organizational synergy,and credit system development in this process,and provides specific operational pathways for enhancing the effectiveness of labor brands.

title_cn: 光伏惠民政策实施能否带来能源公平
title_en: Can the Photovoltaic Support Policy Promote Energy Equity
authors_en_and_affiliations: LI Fanlue;HE Ke(College of Economics and Management,Huazhong Agricultural University;Laboratory of Green and Low-carbon Development in Agriculture,Huazhong Agricultural University)
institutions_cn: 华中农业大学农业绿色低碳发展实验室 | 华中农业大学经济管理学院
index_title: 光伏惠民政策实施能否带来能源公平
abstract_cn: 在全面推进乡村振兴与“双碳”战略深度融合的进程中,农村能源消费结构正在经历深刻变革。然而,受制于基础设施薄弱与收入分化显著,清洁能源普及过程中的不平等问题日益凸显,这已成为制约绿色低碳转型与实现共同富裕的瓶颈。本文聚焦于分析光伏惠民政策的实施,探讨其在缓解农村能源消费不平等方面的作用。利用2012-2022年中国家庭追踪调查数据,结合Kakwani指数和多时点双重差分模型,本文发现,光伏惠民政策实施,不仅显著降低了农村能源消费不平等,而且通过提升能源可获得性和可负担性为农村家庭带来了福祉。进一步分析表明,光伏惠民政策实施在地形适宜、空气质量较好、粮食主产区等地区产生了更为显著的能源消费不平等缓解效果。本文的研究结论验证了因地制宜推动光伏产业发展的重要性,强调光伏产业发展需综合考虑地区的自然条件和社会经济条件。
abstract_en: Against the backdrop of China's vigorous implementation of the Rural Revitalization Strategy and the deepening of its"dual carbon"goals,rural energy transition has become not only a matter of promoting low-carbon development but also an important policy issue closely tied to common prosperity.In recent years,clean energy technologies have expanded into rural areas,creating more opportunities for rural households to access modern energy.However,the transition does not necessarily guarantee the achievement of energy equity.Due to disparities in infrastructure conditions,resource endowments,and household affordability,rural households do not benefit equally from the clean energy transition.Using household data from the China Family Panel Studies(CFPS)from 2012 to 2022,this paper employs a difference-in-differences(DID)model with multiple time periods to identify the impact of the photovoltaic support policy on rural energy inequality.The results yield several major findings.First,the policy significantly reduces rural energy inequality.Second,the policy mainly works by improving energy accessibility and energy affordability.Third,the policy effects vary significantly across regions.Its inequality-reducing effect is more pronounced in areas with lower terrain relief,those with better air quality,and in major grain-producing counties.Based on these findings,this paper draws several policy implications.First,while steadily expanding the coverage of the photovoltaic support policy,greater efforts should be made to improve its promotion and implementation mechanisms to enhance its accessibility and long-term sustainability in rural areas.Second,policy design should place greater emphasis on improving rural households'energy accessibility and affordability,thereby further strengthening the effectiveness of photovoltaic support measures.Third,regional heterogeneity should be fully taken into account to establish a stratified and differentiated support system for photovoltaic development,thereby improving policy adaptability.The innovations of this paper are reflected in two aspects.First,it introduces an equity perspective into the evaluation of photovoltaic support policies by focusing on energy inequality among rural households,thereby expanding the analytical dimension of energy justice research.Second,by examining the roles of energy accessibility and affordability,this paper develops an analytical framework for understanding how photovoltaic support policies affect rural energy inequality,which helps deepen our understanding of the distributive effects of clean energy policies.More broadly,by focusing on distributional issues in the clean energy transition,this study responds to the practical concern of how to advance efficiency and equity simultaneously and provides empirical evidence for optimizing the design of energy transition policies.

index_title: 减污降碳与粮食安全的协同权衡:基于化肥行业补贴改革与碳氮定价的模型证据
abstract_cn: 对农业部门而言,推动减污降碳协同增效面临明显的约束。因此,在农业高质量发展与“双碳”目标的双重约束要求下,如何破解化肥减量与粮食安全之间的协同难题成为政策设计的关键。本文利用中国农业生产及其环境影响模型(MAg PIE-China),以价格机制为切入点,从供给端的行业补贴改革和排放端的环境定价两个维度出发,通过构造反事实情景、取消化肥行业补贴情景、征收温室气体排放税情景以及组合情景,评估了化肥行业补贴改革和碳氮定价政策对减污降碳和粮食安全的权衡与协同效应。本文发现,取消化肥行业补贴和实施碳氮定价政策均可减少氮肥施用量并降低氧化亚氮排放和氮素污染。其中,氮税和碳税政策的减污降碳效应更加显著,但同时会导致食物价格上涨以及食物自给率下降,对粮食安全构成潜在风险。进一步分析表明,如采取渐进税率征收氮税与取消化肥行业补贴相结合的政策组合,则可在2030年有效减缓食物价格的上涨和食物自给率的下降,在最大限度地保障粮食安全的同时,实现减污降碳效果。研究结果为构建农业减污降碳与粮食安全的协同治理路径提供了量化支撑,并为农业绿色低碳转型政策的优化提供了前瞻性依据。
abstract_en: Reconciling fertilizer reduction with food security is a central policy challenge for achieving high-quality agricultural development and China's carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals.Fertilizer remains indispensable for sustaining crop yields,but its long-standing extensive pattern has lowered nutrient use efficiency and intensified pollution.Identifying policy instruments that can simultaneously reduce environmental damages and enhance food security is therefore critical.This paper uses a China-specific version of the Model of Agricultural Production and its Impact on the Environment(MAgPIE-China)to assess the effects of fertilizer manufacturing subsidy reform and emission pricing on nitrogen pollution,greenhouse gas(GHG)emissions,and food security.This paper finds that both fertilizer subsidy removal and GHG taxation reduce fertilizer use,N2O emissions,and nitrogen pollution,but with significantly different implications for food security.Carbon and nitrogen taxation deliver larger environmental gains,but they raise food prices and reduce food self-sufficiency,creating potential food security risks.By contrast,a combined policy of subsidy removal and gradually phased-in nitrogen taxation substantially attenuates these adverse effects by 2030,while still achieving meaningful reductions in N2O emissions and nitrogen pollution.In cost-effectiveness terms,subsidy removal achieves greater fertilizer reduction per unit cost than either carbon or nitrogen taxation,whereas carbon and nitrogen taxation are more effective in delivering larger total reductions in N2O emissions and nitrogen pollution.These findings suggest that agricultural green transition cannot rely on a single policy instrument.A more effective approach is a coordinated policy package that combines subsidy reform with phased emission pricing and is complemented by decoupled compensation,green technology R&D,and investment in green public infrastructure.This paper contributes to existing literature in three respects.First,it provides an evaluation of medium-and long-term policy effects under multiple constraints,complementing studies that rely primarily on field experiments or reduced-form empirical evidence.Second,it examines fertilizer manufacturing subsidy reform,emission pricing,and their combination within a unified framework,thereby providing evidence on the differences and complementarities among alternative price-based policy instruments in promoting fertilizer reduction.Third,by focusing on policy synergies and trade-offs,the paper quantifies how input-side and emissions-side pricing mechanisms shape agricultural pollution reduction,GHG mitigation,and food security.

title_cn: 机器学习方法在农业经济研究中的应用与展望
title_en: Applications and Prospects of Machine Learning Methods in Agricultural Economic Research
authors_cn: 仇焕广 | 吕新业 | 王丹丹
authors_en_and_affiliations: QIU Huanguang;LYU Xinye;WANG Dandan(School of Economics,Liaoning University;Institute of Agricultural Economics and Development,Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences;Li Anmin Institute of Economic Research,Liaoning University)

index_title: 机器学习方法在农业经济研究中的应用与展望
abstract_cn: 机器学习以数据驱动为核心,正成为推动农业经济理论与方法演进的关键力量之一。本文在梳理国内外相关文献的基础上,构建了面向农业经济问题的“任务-数据-方法”分析框架,将相关研究归纳为预测模拟与政策评估、类型识别与特征刻画、动态决策与策略优化三大类核心任务,并对应阐述了监督学习、无监督学习与强化学习等机器学习方法的基本原理与适用场景。本文进一步从研究目标、模型设定、因果识别等维度,探讨了机器学习与传统计量方法在范式上的差异与互补关系。通过述评机器学习在预测模拟、政策评估、特征提取与动态优化等领域的应用进展,本文指出其在数据基础、模型可解释性、因果推断有效性以及外推稳健性等方面仍面临挑战。最后,本文结合中国农业经济的结构性约束与发展需求,提出应将机器学习嵌入既有理论与识别框架中,推动农业经济研究范式从结构建模向智能学习、由理论推演向数据驱动、由静态评估向动态优化转变。
abstract_en: Machine learning(ML),as a fundamentally data-driven approach,is increasingly reshaping the theoretical and methodological foundations of agricultural economics.This paper provides a comprehensive review of the integration of ML into agricultural economic research and proposes a"task-data-method"analytical framework that systematically links research questions to appropriate ML approaches.Within this framework,the major research tasks in agricultural economics are categorized into three domains:prediction and simulation for policy evaluation,typology identification and feature characterization,and dynamic decision-making and strategy optimization.Corresponding to these tasks,this paper reviews the foundational principles and application contexts of supervised learning,unsupervised learning,and reinforcement learning,with particular attention to regularized regression,tree-based ensemble methods,support vector machines,deep neural networks,clustering algorithms,and dimensionality reduction techniques.The review then turns to the differences and complementarities between ML and conventional econometrics in terms of research objectives,model specification,and causal interpretation.Whereas ML emphasizes predictive performance,flexible modeling,and pattern discovery in high-dimensional settings,econometric methods remain central to causal identification,mechanism analysis,and policy inference.This paper argues that the two approaches are best understood as conditionally complementary rather than competing paradigms.In particular,causal ML methods,such as causal forests,double/debiased machine learning,and deep instrumental variables,combine algorithmic flexibility with rigorous identification strategies and expand the toolkit for agricultural policy evaluation and farm household analysis.The paper further reviews representative applications of ML across the three task domains.In prediction and simulation,ML has improved crop yield forecasting,agricultural price prediction,and risk classification,often through the incorporation of remote sensing imagery,textual information,and other unstructured data sources.In policy evaluation,causal ML methods have expanded the capacity to estimate heterogeneous treatment effects and address high-dimensional confounding in studies of agricultural subsidies,rural governance,land protection,and green development.In terms of the typology construction and feature extraction,unsupervised methods have been used for farmer classification,market segmentation,and anomaly detection.In terms of dynamic optimization,reinforcement learning and multi-agent systems have been applied to crop management,supply chain coordination,and policy simulation under behavioral feedback.Given the structural constraints and strategic priorities of China's agricultural sector,particularly food security,farmland protection,green transition,and rural revitalization,this paper proposes a forward-looking research agenda centered on three priorities:developing application-oriented exemplars in high-value policy domains,promoting integrated evaluation frameworks that combine credible identification strategies with ML tools,and strengthening data infrastructure and interdisciplinary research capacity.Rather than serving as a black-box substitute for econometric analysis,ML should be embedded within established theoretical and empirical frameworks to enhance the analysis of high-dimensional heterogeneity,the simulation of complex systems,and the optimization of dynamic decision-making.More broadly,the integration of ML into agricultural economics has the potential to extend the field from static evaluation toward dynamic optimization and from theory-led inference toward data-enriched discovery.

abstract_cn: 促进城乡融合发展是中国式现代化的重要支撑,区域协调发展是中国式现代化的内在要求。党的二十大报告指出要着力推进城乡融合和区域协调发展。党的二十届三中全会对完善城乡融合发展体制机制、完善实施区域协调发展战略机制作出重要战略部署。《中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划的建议》强调要促进城乡融合发展,并对“优化区域经济布局,促进区域协调发展”作出专章部署。2025年12月中央经济工作会议进一步将“坚持协调发展,促进城乡融合和区域联动”明确列为2026年经济工作的重点任务之一。2026年中央“一号文件”对推动城乡要素双向流动作出了专门部署。为深入贯彻党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神,推动学术界加强对城乡融合和区域协调发展相关问题的深入研究与思想交流,第四届“中国式现代化经济发展前沿论坛”将于2026年5月在上海举办。本届论坛由《中国农村经济》编辑部和上海财经大学中国式现代化研究院主办,上海财经大学城乡发展研究院协办,将聚焦“十五五”时期推进城乡融合和区域协调发展的重大理论与现实问题,以期凝聚学术界智慧,为全面推进中国式现代化贡献力量。

title_cn: 论巩固和完善农村基本经营制度
title_en: Consolidating and Improving the Basic Rural Management System
authors_en_and_affiliations: HU Lingxiao(Rural Development Institute,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences)
institutions_cn: 中国社会科学院农村发展研究所
index_title: 论巩固和完善农村基本经营制度
abstract_cn: 巩固和完善农村基本经营制度,是加快农业农村现代化、扎实推进乡村全面振兴的重要保障。为找准巩固和完善农村基本经营制度的重点和思路,本文构建了以问题主线为牵引,内含制度要素、制度属性、制度内容的分析框架。本文认为,农村基本经营制度在应对农村经营问题的过程中,已形成农业发展和农村集体经济发展两条问题主线,从“产权”和“经营”两个制度要素出发,可划分为农地产权制度、农村集体经营性资产产权制度、农业经营制度、农村集体经济经营管理制度四项制度内容,且每一项制度内容都被赋予了“统分结合”的制度属性。在农业发展问题主线下,巩固和完善农村基本经营制度的重点是提高“分”的效率和创新“统”的形式,其思路是以“稳定、深化、提高”推动实现更高质量的“分”,在此基础上推动实现更有效的“统”;在农村集体经济发展问题主线下,巩固和完善农村基本经营制度的重点是健全农村集体经营性资产产权制度和建立健全农村集体经济经营管理制度,其思路是深化农村集体经营性资产产权制度改革,探索农村集体经济经营管理制度“统分结合”的实现形式。在巩固和完善农村基本经营制度的过程中,必须树立辩证思维,关注“统”与“分”的内在联系,坚持“宜分则分,宜统则统”、坚持“统”与“分”赋能互促、坚持提高“统分结合”的包容性。
abstract_en: Consolidating and improving the basic rural management system serves as an important institutional guarantee for accelerating agricultural and rural modernization and steadily advancing all-round rural revitalization.To deepen the understanding of this system and identify the priorities and pathways for its consolidation and improvement,this paper develops an analytical framework led by problem-oriented main lines,which includes institutional elements,institutional attributes,and institutional contents.This paper holds that,the evolution of the basic rural management system has been fundamentally shaped by its responses to two main problem lines:agricultural development and rural collective economic development.Based on the two institutional elements of property rights and operation,the system can be divided into four institutional components:the farmland property rights system,the property rights system for rural collective operational assets,the agricultural operation system,and the operation and management system for the rural collective economy.Each institutional component is characterized by the institutional attribute of“integrating unified and decentralized operations”.Under the main line of agricultural development,the priority of consolidating and improving the basic rural management system is to enhance the efficiency of the“decentralized”dimension and innovate forms of the“unified”dimension.The proposed approach is to promote higher-quality decentralization through“stabilization,deepening,and upgrading”,and on this basis,achieve more effective unification.Under the main line of rural collective economic development,the priority is to improve the property rights system for rural collective operational assets and establish a sound operation and management system for the rural collective economy.The approach is to deepen the reform of the property rights system for rural collective operational assets and explore effective forms of“integrating unified and decentralized operations”for the operation and management system for the rural collective economy.In the process of consolidating and improving the basic rural management system,it is essential to adopt dialectical thinking,emphasize the intrinsic linkage between“unification”and“decentralization”,adhere to the principle of“decentralizing where appropriate and unifying where appropriate”,pursue mutual empowerment and reinforcement of unification and decentralization,and enhance the inclusiveness of the integrated system of unified and decentralized operations.

title_cn: 县域城乡融合发展的理论逻辑与实践模式——基于中国特色实践的一般性分析框架
title_en: Theoretical Logic and Practical Models of County-Level Urban-Rural Integrated Development:Toward a General Analytical Framework Based on Chinese Practice
authors_cn: 钟苏娟 | 黄贤金 | 贾铠阳
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZHONG Sujuan;HUANG Xianjin;JIA Kaiyang(School of Government,Nanjing University;School of Geography and Ocean Science,Nanjing University;School of Public Administration,Nanjing Agricultural University)

abstract_cn: 中国城乡融合发展正迈向以县域为重要切入点的新阶段。立足县域发展实践,构建系统性分析框架并提炼适用于中国情境的实践模式,是构建城乡融合发展的自主知识体系的必然要求。首先,本文构建“空间-功能-生计”三维分析框架,阐明县域城乡融合发展本质上是城乡空间格局优化、地域功能协同以及居民生计转型相互关联的多维动态过程。在实践中,国土空间治理现代化指引下的城乡空间格局优化是逻辑起点,国家战略叠加下城乡地域功能的协同是逻辑展开,流动生计视角下城乡居民生计的多元保障是逻辑归宿。其次,本文进一步揭示大城市周边县域、专业功能县域、农产品主产区县域、重点生态功能区县域和人口流失县域这五类县域在空间形态、功能定位和生计模式上的差异化特征及其面临的系统性挑战。最后,本文提出与五类县域相适配的城乡融合发展模式:大城市周边县域的“空间协同型”融合、专业功能县域的“功能增强型”融合、农产品主产区县域的“生计优化型”融合、重点生态功能区县域的“功能互补型”融合以及人口流失县域的“空间重构型”融合。本研究认为,应建立县域分类施策与动态评估体系,构建县域多尺度空间协同网络,健全政策统筹协调机制,并完善强农惠农富农政策支持体系,进而促进县域城乡融合发展。
abstract_en: China’s urban-rural integrated development has entered a new stage in which counties serve as a key entry point.Grounded in county-level practice,this paper argues that building a systematic analytical framework and identifying context-specific development models are essential to advancing an independent knowledge system of urban-rural integrated development in China.Recognizing the county as a composite territorial unit with both urban and rural attributes,this paper develops a theoretical framework for county-level urban-rural integrated development and distills differentiated practical models tailored to diverse county conditions.This study constructs a three-dimensional analytical framework of“space-function-livelihood”,elucidating that county-level urban-rural integrated development is a dynamic process involving spatial restructuring,functional coordination,and livelihood transformation.These dimensions are not merely parallel categories but internally coupled components of an integrated framework.In practice,optimizing urban-rural spatial patterns under modern territorial spatial governance constitutes the logical starting point;coordinating territorial functions under overlapping development strategies serves as the key intermediate mechanism;and diversifying and stabilizing urban and rural livelihoods,from the perspective of livelihood mobility,represents the ultimate objective.Based on this framework,the study identifies five major types of counties:peri-metropolitan counties,specialized functional counties,major agricultural production counties,key ecological function counties,and population-shrinking counties,and systematically examines their differentiated characteristics and structural challenges in terms of spatial form,functional orientation,and livelihood patterns.Accordingly,five adaptive urban-rural integrated development models are proposed:spatial coordination-oriented integration for peri-metropolitan counties,function enhancement-oriented integration for specialized functional counties,livelihood optimization-oriented integration for major agricultural production counties,functional complementarity-oriented integration for ecological function counties,and spatial restructuring-oriented integration for population-shrinking counties.The study suggests that future efforts to advance county-level urban-rural integrated development should adopt differentiated and dynamic policy approaches,foster multi-scalar spatial coordination networks,strengthen strategic alignment mechanisms,and improve policy systems supporting agriculture,rural development,and farmers’livelihoods.

abstract_cn: 在城乡融合背景下,培育一批“有文化、懂技术、善经营、会管理”的高素质农民,对于壮大新型农业农村人才队伍、改善农村人力资本结构以及助力县域经济发展具有重要意义。本文借助新型职业农民培育示范政策实施这一准自然实验,将2011-2022年1762个县域层面的面板数据与“浙大卡特-企研中国涉农研究数据库”相匹配,采用渐进双重差分模型识别该政策实施对县域经济发展的影响及其作用机制。研究结果表明,新型职业农民培育示范政策的实施使得示范县的经济发展水平显著提高。机制分析结果表明,该政策的实施主要通过农业产业链延伸和县域市场扩容两条路径促进县域经济发展。异质性分析表明,该政策的实施对县域经济发展的推动作用,在原贫困县、教育资源丰富、农业竞争力强以及市场营商环境优良的地区更为显著。本文既能为高素质农民培育驱动县域经济发展提供有力的经验证据,也能为未来完善农民综合素质培训机制、服务乡村振兴战略提供实践启示。
abstract_en: Against the backdrop of the in-depth implementation of the rural revitalization strategy,China is promoting the cultivation of high-quality farmers,aiming to overcome the constraints of rural human capital.As a key component of China’s efforts to cultivate high-quality farmers,the demonstration policies for training new professional farmers play a significant role in expanding the pool of new agricultural and rural talent,improving the structure of rural human capital,and boosting county-level economic development.This study focuses on the economic effects of the Demonstration Policy for Cultivating New Professional Farmers(DPCNPF).It not only provides a theoretical basis for deepening the cultivation of high-quality farmers and promoting the transformation and upgrading of county-level economies in the new era,but also offers policy insights for comprehensively advancing rural revitalization and accelerating the formation of new quality productive forces in agriculture.This paper utilizes the implementation of the DPCNPF as an exogenous shock.By linking county-level panel data with a database of agriculture-related enterprises and employing a staggered difference-in-differences model,this paper systematically evaluates the impact of this policy on county-level economic development and its underlying mechanisms.The findings are as follows.First,the implementation of the DPCNPF significantly boosts the economic development of demonstration counties.This conclusion remains robust after a series of robustness tests,including endogeneity checks,heterogeneity tests,and control for the interference of concurrent policies.Second,the implementation of the DPCNPF primarily promotes county-level economic development through two channels:the extension of agricultural industrial chains and the expansion of county-level markets.Third,the policy’s role in driving county-level economic development is more pronounced in former poverty-stricken counties,regions with abundant educational resources,areas with strong agricultural competitiveness,and regions with favorable market and business environments.Fourth,the implementation of the DPCNPF can generate synergistic effects when combined with the Comprehensive Demonstration Counties for E-commerce in Rural Areas and Agricultural and Rural Big Data Pilot policies in promoting county-level economic development.Based on the findings,this paper proposes the following implications.First,it is necessary to vigorously advance the development of a high-quality farmer workforce and expand the scope of DPCNPF.Second,it is essential to promote agricultural modernization,increase support for innovation and entrepreneurship in rural areas,encourage the integrated development of the primary,secondary,and tertiary sectors in rural areas,and strengthen the industrial foundation and market environment for county-level economic development.Third,it is essential to optimize the planning and design of the policy framework to guide the training of high-quality farmers and industrial layout in a manner tailored to local conditions.This study is innovative in three respects.First,it quantitatively assesses the catalytic effect of the DPCNPF on county-level economic development in China.Second,by examining the extension of agricultural industrial chains and the expansion of county-level markets,this paper systematically reveals the multiple pathways through which the policy exerts its effects,thereby expanding the research frontier on how the cultivation of high-quality farmers empowers county-level economic development.Third,based on a multidimensional analysis of county-level economic conditions,educational resources,agricultural competitiveness,and the business environment,this paper provides a reference for local governments to optimize resource allocation and formulate differentiated and targeted policies for cultivating high-quality farmers.

title_cn: 返乡创业试点政策实施如何助推城乡融合发展
title_en: How Does the Implementation of the Pilot Policy for Returning Home to Set up Business Promote Integrated Urban-Rural Development?
authors_cn: 肖霞 | 徐成铭 | 黄亮雄
authors_en_and_affiliations: Xiao Xia;Xu Chengming;Huang Liangxiong(School of Economics and Finance,South China University of Technology;School of Government,Beijing Normal University)
institutions_cn: 华南理工大学经济与金融学院 | 北京师范大学政府管理学院
index_title: 返乡创业试点政策实施如何助推城乡融合发展
abstract_cn: 促进劳动力返乡创业,是新时代加快发展农村经济、助推城乡融合发展的重要举措。本文采用双重机器学习法和双重差分模型,基于2007-2023年县域面板数据,考察返乡创业试点政策实施对城乡融合发展的影响及其作用机制。研究发现:返乡创业试点政策实施对城乡融合发展具有显著的促进作用,这一结论在经过调整研究样本、更换分割方式等一系列稳健性检验后依然成立。该效应呈现显著的异质性特征,在人口较密集地区、经济发展水平较高地区和低海拔地区,返乡创业试点政策实施对城乡融合发展的促进效果更为突出。进一步研究发现,提升要素配置效率和强化技术创新效应是返乡创业试点政策实施助推城乡融合发展的重要路径。同时,数字经济发展在返乡创业试点政策实施助推城乡融合发展的过程中发挥正向调节作用。因此,应分类梯次推进返乡创业试点政策扩围,重点提升要素配置效率,持续推动技术创新,强化数字经济发展在返乡创业过程中的关键作用,促进返乡创业试点政策实施在助推城乡融合发展方面发挥更大作用。
abstract_en: Promoting returning home to set up business in the new era serves as a crucial lever for stimulating endogenous rural development,activating new drivers of the rural economy,and facilitating two-way flows of factors between urban and rural areas,thereby advancing deep integrated urban-rural development.This paper takes China’s return home to set up business pilot policy as a quasi-natural experiment.Using county-level panel data from 2007 to 2023,we construct a multidimensional composite indicator of integrated urban-rural development and employ both difference-in-differences(DID)and double machine learning(DML)approaches to empirically examine the policy’s effects and mechanisms.The results show that the pilot policy significantly promotes integrated urban-rural development.This finding remains robust after a series of checks,including sample period adjustment,interaction effects,alternative sample-splitting methods,province-by-year fixed effects,alternative machine learning specifications,and placebo tests.Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the policy’s positive effects are more pronounced in areas with high population density,high economic development,and low altitude.Further mechanism analysis indicates that the policy facilitates integrated urban-rural development primarily by improving factor allocation efficiency and strengthening technological innovation.Within the innovation channel,utility model innovations contribute more than design innovations.Moreover,the development of the digital economy plays a positive moderating role,amplifying the policy’s impact.Based on these findings,this paper proposes several policy implications.First,the pilot policy should be continued and gradually expanded,but implementation must be tailored to local resource endowments rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach.Second,the key mechanisms—factor allocation efficiency and technological innovation—should be reinforced.Third,the enabling role of the digital economy should be harnessed to create a multiplier effect through the synergy of return home to set up business and digitalization.Our findings provide empirical support and practical insights for refining return home to set up business policies,advancing integrated urban-rural development,and promoting rural revitalization.

title_cn: 超越结构与行动:政府赋能农村集体经济发展的可持续机制
title_en: Beyond Structure and Action:A Sustainable Mechanism for Government to Empower the Development of the Rural Collective Economy
authors_cn: 李小艺 | 佟健 | 任利刚
authors_en_and_affiliations: LI Xiaoyi;TONG Jian;REN Ligang(College of Public Administration,Guizhou University of Finance and Economics;School of Economics,Guizhou University)
institutions_cn: 贵州财经大学公共管理学院 | 贵州大学经济学院
index_title: 超越结构与行动:政府赋能农村集体经济发展的可持续机制
abstract_cn: 对于农村集体经济发展影响因素的研究,长期存在着社会建构与个体行为两种解释视角。前者强调结构的规范性和价值性对农村集体经济的塑造,后者则强调行为主体意识和行动的能动性对农村集体经济发展的重要作用。两种视角虽然都具有一定的解释力,但存在各自的理念局限,导致两种视角均存在认知偏差,难以揭示政府外部干预转化为农村集体经济发展内生动力的具体机制。为突破这一理论瓶颈,本文以贵州省岩博村为典型案例,建构“超越结构与行动”的分析框架,基于对该村二十余年的集体经济发展历程的分析,指出农村集体经济的可持续发展源于地方政府的“结构供给”与村庄多元主体“行动策略”之间的良性互动,并进一步识别出组织赋能、激励赋能与制度赋能的结构与行动互动机制。组织赋能机制为农村集体经济的创建与发展赋予动力与动能,激励赋能机制完成农村集体经济发展资源的动员与转化,制度赋能机制则促成农村集体经济运行规则的内化与融合。研究表明,农村集体经济可持续发展的实质是结构与行动在互动过程中生成的三重逻辑,即清晰的产权秩序奠定了激励相容的经济基础、组织的治理尺度扩展与规则创新提供了制度保障、价值融合的共同体认同则生成了最深层的韧性内核。本文结论深化了对政府角色与农村集体经济发展内生动力之间复杂关系的理解,为通过政府精准干预,进而促进农村集体经济实现从“输血”到“造血”的根本性转变提供了理论依据与实践启示。
abstract_en: For a long time,there have been two explanatory perspectives on the factors influencing the development of the rural collective economy:social construction and individual behavior.The former emphasizes the shaping of the rural collective economy by the standardization and value of the structure,while the latter emphasizes the important role of the subject consciousness and the initiative of the action in the development of the rural collective economy.Although both perspectives have certain explanatory power,they have their conceptual limitations,which lead to cognitive bias in both perspectives,and make it difficult to reveal the specific mechanism of how external government intervention can be transformed into endogenous motivation for the development of the rural collective economy.To break through this theoretical bottleneck,this paper,based on rethinking the two paradigms of structuralism and activism,takes the 20-year development of the rural collective economy in Yanbo Village of Guizhou Province as a typical case,constructs a theoretical analysis framework of“transcending structure and action”.It points out that the sustainable development of the rural collective economy stems from the benign interaction between the“structural supply”of local government and the“action strategy”of village multi-subjects,and further identifies the interaction mechanism between structure and action of organizational,incentive,and institutional empowerment.These three mechanisms are interlocking and jointly drive the rural collective economy from reconstruction to transformation and finally to deepening development.Organizational empowerment mechanism provides driving forces for the development of the rural collective economy;incentive empowerment mechanism completes the mobilization and transformation of development resources for the rural collective economy;and institutional empowerment mechanism promotes the internalization and integration of operation rules of the rural collective economy.This paper finds that the essence of the sustainable development of the rural collective economy is the triple logic generated by the interaction between structure and action,that is,the clear property right order lays the economic foundation for incentive compatibility,the expansion of organizational governance scale and rule innovation provides institutional guarantee,and the community identity of value integration generates the deepest core of resilience.The conclusion of this paper deepens the understanding of the complex relationship between the role of the government and the endogenous driving force of the rural collective economic development,and provides a theoretical basis and practical enlightenment for promoting the fundamental transformation of the rural collective economy from“blood transfusion”to“hematopoiesis”through accurate government intervention.

title_cn: 中国农村信用发展水平测度、演变及其影响因素的组态分析
title_en: The Measurement,Evolution,and Configuration Analysis of Influencing Factors of Rural Credit Development Level in China
authors_cn: 田侃 | 温国强 | 贾万颖
authors_en_and_affiliations: TIAN Kan;WEN Guoqiang;JIA Wanying(National Academy of Economic Strategy,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;Credit Research Center,National Academy of Economic Strategy,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;Faculty of Applied Economics,University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;School of Management,Sichuan Agricultural University)
institutions_cn: 中国社会科学院财经战略研究院 | 中国社会科学院财经战略研究院信用研究中心 | 中国社会科学院大学应用经济学院 | 四川农业大学管理学院
index_title: 中国农村信用发展水平测度、演变及其影响因素的组态分析
abstract_cn: 持续提升农村信用发展水平,关乎财政金融支农效率,更关系乡村治理现代化和产业高质量发展。在2026年中央“一号文件”部署扎实推进乡村全面振兴并要求创新乡村振兴投融资机制、强调推动农村信用体系建设的背景下,本文构建起农村“信用环境-信用规制-信用应用”的分析框架,描述中国农村信用发展水平演变特征,从组态视角分析其影响因素与时空差异。研究发现,在2019-2023年,中国农村信用指数总体呈现缓慢增长趋势,这主要得益于农村信用规制指数和农村信用应用指数提升的拉动。驱动农村信用发展水平提升的组态主要有3类:“乡村建设-产业发展-乡村治理”多元驱动型组态、“产业发展-乡村治理”双元驱动型组态、“乡村建设-乡村治理”双元驱动型组态。不同组态的驱动机制存在时空差异与分维度指数差异。从时间看,3类组态在2020年与2021年的适应性均出现不同程度的下降。从空间看,3类组态分别契合欠发达县域数量较少、较多以及数量为零的省份。从分维度指数看,多元驱动型组态侧重于提升农村信用应用水平,2类双元驱动型组态侧重于提升农村信用规制水平。立足“十五五”时期农村信用发展,本文提出推动乡土信用与现代信用融合、加快推进农村信用体系建设、平衡农村信用的普惠性和风险性、缩小农村信用发展的区域差异、完善相关法律法规及工作机制的建议。
abstract_en: Continuously improving rural credit development is related to the efficiency of fiscal and financial support for agriculture,and is essential to the credit foundation of rural governance modernization and high-quality industrial development.In the context of the Rural Revitalization Strategy,this study constructs an analytical framework of“rural credit environment–rural credit regulation–rural credit application”to describe the trend of rural credit development in China.Additionally,this study analyzes its influencing factors and combinatory effects from a configurational perspective,providing important insights for improving public credit information monitoring,enhancing rural credit governance,and narrowing regional credit development disparities.The results indicate that during the sample period,China’s rural credit index shows a slow upward trend,primarily driven by the improvement in the rural credit regulation and application index,and the contribution of the rural credit environment to the growth of the total index was small.Three configurational paths driving rural credit development are identified:(1)The multi-drive type that emphasizes rural construction,rural industrial development,and rural governance;(2)the“rural industrial development–rural governance”dual-driven model emphasizes the integration of market contract governance and social norms;and(3)it emphasizes the“rural construction–rural governance”dual-driven type of coordination between village construction investment,village planning,and public service supply.The driving mechanisms of these paths exhibit spatial-temporal and dimensional differences.The adaptability of three configurational paths declining to varying extents in 2020 and 2021.Among them,the multi-driven type fits the less developed provinces with a small number of counties,focusing on improving rural credit application,the“rural industrial development–rural governance”dual-driven type fits the less developed provinces with a large number of counties,and the“rural construction–rural governance”dual-driven type fits the less developed provinces with zero number of counties.The two types of dual-driven configurations mainly improve rural credit regulation.Grounded in the development of rural credit during the 15th Five-Year Plan period,this study proposes to promote the integration of traditional and modern credit systems,accelerate the construction of the rural credit system,balance inclusiveness and risk,reduce regional disparities,and improve relevant legal and institutional frameworks.

title_cn: 环境规制对空气污染城乡分布的影响研究——以国家环境空气监测站的建立为例
title_en: The Impact of Environmental Regulation on the Urban-Rural Distribution of Air Pollution:Evidence From the Establishment of National Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Stations
authors_cn: 王玉泽 | 张诗怡 | 杨开忠
authors_en_and_affiliations: WANG Yuze;ZHANG Shiyi;YANG Kaizhong(College of Economics and Management,Huazhong Agricultural University;Faculty of Applied Economics,University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;Research Institute for Eco-civilization,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;Laboratory for Intelligent Food Security Governance,Huazhong Agricultural University;Xianning Branch,National Bureau of Statistics)
institutions_cn: 华中农业大学经济管理学院 | 中国社会科学院生态文明研究所 | 华中农业大学粮食安全数智治理实验室 | 国家统计局咸宁调查队 | 中国社会科学院大学应用经济学院
index_title: 环境规制对空气污染城乡分布的影响研究——以国家环境空气监测站的建立为例
abstract_cn: 考察环境规制对空气污染城乡分布的影响,能够回应“环境规制能否引致城乡空气污染转移”这一经典学术问题,对于推进城乡生态环境协同治理具有重要意义。国家环境空气监测站是环境规制体系的重要组成部分,其空间布局呈现明显的城市偏向。本文利用国家环境空气监测站的三期建设方案,系统地评估了这一环境规制举措对空气污染城乡分布的影响,并基于污染企业的策略性行为揭示有关作用机制。研究发现:在国家环境空气监测站建立后,城市地区PM2.5质量浓度显著下降,而农村地区的污染下降程度十分有限;虽然国家环境空气监测站建立的环境收益主要集中在城市地区,即环境规制影响了空气污染的城乡分布,但并未引致空气污染从城市向农村转移。微观机制验证结果显示,在国家环境空气监测站建立后,与农村地区相比,城市地区污染企业的生产规模下降更多、污染减排力度更大、新污染企业进入得更少,因此,城市地区从这一环境规制中获得了更多环境收益;同时,国家环境空气监测站的建立,没有导致城、乡污染企业的退出或绿色创新总量发生变化,也并未引致污染企业的城乡迁移。空间溢出分析表明,国家环境空气监测站的建立并未引致城乡空气污染的跨区域转移。进一步研究显示,城市地区从国家环境空气监测站的建立中获得较多环境收益的同时,也承担更多经济成本。本文结论对于优化国家环境空气监测站的城乡布局、促进城乡空气质量协同提升具有重要政策含义。
abstract_en: Examining the impact of environmental regulation on the urban-rural distribution of air pollution helps address the long-standing academic question of whether environmental regulation induces pollution transfer between urban and rural areas,and is of great significance for promoting coordinated urban-rural ecological governance.National ambient air quality monitoring stations(hereafter,“monitoring stations”)constitute a core component of China’s environmental regulatory system,and their spatial distribution exhibits a pronounced urban bias.Exploiting variation in implementation timing,prefectural coverage,and urban-rural exposure to monitoring stations,this paper systematically evaluates the effects of this environmental regulatory measure on the urban-rural distribution of air pollution,and elucidates the underlying mechanisms through the strategic responses of polluting firms.The findings yield important policy implications for optimizing the urban-rural allocation of monitoring stations and promoting coordinated improvements in air quality across urban and rural areas.The results indicate that following the establishment of monitoring stations,PM2.5 concentrations decline significantly in urban areas,whereas pollution reductions in rural areas are limited.Although the environmental benefits of monitoring stations are concentrated primarily in urban areas,which suggests that environmental regulation affects the urban-rural distribution of air pollution,the policy does not induce pollution transfer from urban to rural areas.Evidence on the micro-level mechanisms shows that,relative to rural areas,polluting firms in urban areas experience larger reductions in production scale,undertake greater pollution abatement efforts,and face fewer entries of new polluting firms after the introduction of monitoring stations.Consequently,urban areas derive greater environmental benefits from environmental regulation.Meanwhile,the establishment of monitoring stations does not induce firm exits,promote green innovation,or lead to the relocation of polluting firms between urban and rural areas.Spatial spillover analyses further demonstrate that state-controlled air quality monitoring stations do not trigger cross-regional urban-rural transfers of air pollution.Additional analyses reveal that although urban areas reap greater environmental benefits from the policy,they also incur higher economic costs.The contributions of this paper are as follows.First,by examining the impact of monitoring-station establishment on the urban-rural distribution of air pollution,this paper extends the scope of research on the effects of monitoring stations.Second,it broadens the analytical scope of pollution transfer by incorporating the urban-rural dimension and provides the first empirical evidence on whether environmental regulation induces urban-rural air pollution transfer.Third,it systematically analyzes the strategic responses of polluting firms in urban and rural areas across six dimensions:production scale,pollution emissions,urban-rural relocation,firm entry,firm exit,and green innovation,thereby offering new evidence on the environmental regulation and firms’strategic behavior from an urban-rural perspective.
