abstract_cn: 绿色算力基础设施建设对强化绿色算力高效供给、降低企业用算成本和促进包容性绿色发展具有重要意义。本文将“国家绿色数据中心建设”作为一项准自然实验,采用多期双重差分模型实证考察绿色算力基础设施建设对包容性绿色发展效率的影响。研究发现:第一,绿色算力基础设施建设显著提升了包容性绿色发展效率,该结论在经过一系列稳健性检验后依然成立。第二,绿色算力基础设施建设通过促进绿色创新合作、引导算力产业集聚、优化资源配置等方式提升包容性绿色发展效率。第三,在电信行业、非资源型城市及环境保护重点城市,绿色算力基础设施建设对包容性绿色发展效率的促进作用更加显著。因此,应深化绿色算力基础设施建设与包容性绿色发展效率的协同联动,推动绿色创新合作与算力产业集聚深度融合,持续优化要素配置机制,促进绿色算力基础设施在提升经济社会包容性与环境可持续性方面发挥更大作用。
abstract_en: The construction of green computing power infrastructure serves as a pivotal practice in cultivating new quality productive forces,integrating the three attributes of greenness,inclusiveness,and efficiency enhancement,thereby holding significant implications for improving inclusive green development efficiency.Based on panel data from 278 Chinese cities from 2011 to 2022,and employing the construction of the national green data center as a quasi-natural experiment,this study systematically examines the impact of the construction of green computing power infrastructure on inclusive green development efficiency,and the underlying mechanisms,using a staggered difference-in-differences(DID)model,a mediating effect model,and various robustness checks.The results show that the construction of green computing power infrastructure significantly improves inclusive green development efficiency,a finding that remains robust after a series of robustness tests,including replacing the dependent variable,using an alternative intensity difference-in-differences model,controlling for policy interference,and conducting placebo tests.Mechanism analysis reveals that the construction of green computing power infrastructure operates through three core pathways:the green innovation collaboration mechanism,the computing power industry agglomeration mechanism,and the factor allocation mechanism.The marginal contributions of this paper are threefold.First,by focusing on the specific sub-domain of the construction of green computing power infrastructure,this study systematically examines its effect on inclusive green development efficiency,thereby broadening the research perspective on the determinants of inclusive green development.By exploiting the quasi-natural experiment of the construction of a national green data center and employing a DID model to identify the causal relationship between the construction of green computing power infrastructure and the inclusive green development efficiency,this study aims to address the limitations of causal identification in existing literature.Second,this study constructs a measurement framework for inclusive green development efficiency that integrates both social inclusion and green sustainability dimensions,thereby enhancing the theoretical completeness and practical applicability of the relevant indicator system.Unlike traditional studies that treat environmental pollution as the sole undesirable output,this study incorporates social inclusion indicators,such as the urban-rural income gap,the unemployment rate,and the equalization of public services,alongside multiple pollutant emissions as environmental indicators into a unified input-output framework,achieving the simultaneous quantification of the“economic–environmental–social”tri-dimensional perspective,and thus enhancing the theoretical rigor and explanatory power of the measurement of inclusive green development efficiency.Third,this paper attempts to clarify the internal logic through which the construction of green computing power infrastructure promotes inclusive green development efficiency from the perspectives of green innovation collaboration,computing power industry agglomeration,and factor allocation,thereby revealing the pathways through which the construction of green computing power infrastructure enhances inclusive green development efficiency.The findings provide empirical evidence and policy implications for optimizing the spatial layout of green computing power infrastructure,strengthening the synergy between green innovation and industrial agglomeration,and implementing differentiated industry-specific policies.

abstract_cn: 培育智慧农业集群是“十五五”时期加快农业现代化、建设农业强国的重要战略方向。作为一种新型的现代化大农业模式,智慧农业集群具有集聚形态复合化、数据资源共享化、数智技术内嵌化、要素互动密集化、外部效应累积化的鲜明特征。进入新时代以来,特别是“十四五”时期,中国农业产业集群的纵深发展为培育智慧农业集群奠定了坚实的产业基础,智慧农业的快速发展为培育智慧农业集群提供了有力的技术支撑。立足现实基础和实践经验,培育智慧农业集群可以沿着农业集群的智慧化转型和智慧农业的集群化发展两条基本路径推进。“十五五”时期,顺应智能经济发展新趋势、开创智慧农业集群发展新局面,要强化新型基础设施建设,夯实智慧农业集群发展基础;推动农业数智化转型升级,增强智慧农业集群核心能力;深化农业体制机制改革,激活智慧农业集群培育动力;统筹推进教育科技人才一体发展,强化智慧农业集群要素支撑。
abstract_en: Cultivating smart agricultural clusters is an important strategic direction to accelerate agricultural modernizationand build up China’s strength in agriculture during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. At present, research on agricultural industrialclusters and smart agriculture is relatively rich, but research on smart agricultural clusters is relatively limited. Based on clarifyingthe connotation and characteristics of smart agricultural clusters, this paper explains the internal logic of cultivating smartagricultural clusters and explores the practical pathways.The main findings are as follows. As a new type of modern large-scale agricultural model, smart agricultural clusters have thedistinct characteristics of complex cluster form, data resource sharing, embedded digital intelligence technology, intensiveinteraction of factors, and cumulative externalities. Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China (CPC),especially during the 14th Five-Year Plan period, the in-depth development of China’s agricultural industrial clusters has laid asolid industrial foundation for the cultivation of smart agricultural clusters, and the rapid rise of smart agriculture has providedstrong technical enabling support for the cultivation of smart agricultural clusters. Based on the realistic basis and practicalexperience, the cultivation of smart agricultural clusters can be promoted along two basic paths: the smart transformation ofagricultural industrial clusters and the cluster development of smart agriculture. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, to complywith the development trend of the smart economy and create a new situation for the development of smart agricultural clusters, it isnecessary to: (1) strengthen the construction of new infrastructure and consolidate the foundation for the development of smartagricultural clusters;(2) promote the digital and intelligent transformation of agriculture and enhance the core competency of smartagricultural clusters;(3) deepen the reform of the agricultural system and provide drivers for cultivating smart agricultural clusters;and (4) promote the integrated development of education, science, and technology, and talent, and strengthen the factor inputsupport for smart agricultural clusters.The contributions of the paper are threefold. First, based on the concept definition of smart agriculture and agriculturalindustrial cluster, it identifies the core connotation of smart agricultural clusters and clarifies their basic characteristics. Second,following the three logics of theory, history, and reality, it explains the inevitability and urgency of cultivating smart agriculturalclusters. Third, by studying and assessing the realistic basis and practical experience of cultivating smart agricultural clusters, itexplores the fundamental pathways for doing so.

title_cn: 年末“突击花钱”与惠农工程闲置:现实影响、底层动因与治理路径
title_en: Year-End Spending Spikes and the Idleness of Farmer-Benefiting Projects:Practical Impact,Underlying Drivers,and Policy Solutions
authors_cn: 秦国庆 | 杜宝瑞 | 朱玉春 | 高原
authors_en_and_affiliations: QIN Guoqing;DU Baorui;ZHU Yuchun;GAO Yuan(College of Economics&Management,Northwest A&F University;School of Agricultural Economics and Rural Development,Renmin University of China)
institutions_cn: 西北农林科技大学经济管理学院 | 中国人民大学农业与农村发展学院
index_title: 年末“突击花钱”与惠农工程闲置:现实影响、底层动因与治理路径
abstract_cn: 在乡村全面振兴的战略背景下,只有解决年末“突击花钱”及其引发的惠农工程闲置问题,才能创造出经得起实践、人民、历史检验的实绩。这不仅是提高各类强农惠农富农政策效能的迫切要求,也是树立和践行正确政绩观的应有之义。本文基于中部农业大省2908宗惠农工程调查数据,使用judge IV识别策略,评估年末“突击花钱”与惠农工程闲置的因果关系,检验效应背后的作用机制,并探讨年末“突击花钱”的底层动因与治理路径。结果发现,年末“突击花钱”显著加剧了惠农工程闲置现象。机制检验结果表明,年末“突击花钱”通过两种方式加剧工程闲置:一是降低工程质量,导致工程“不能用、不耐用”;二是造成供需错配,导致工程“不好用、不常用”。底层动因分析表明,驱使项目负责人年末“突击花钱”的主要动因可能是“拖延”而非“预防性储蓄”。治理路径分析表明,“零基预算”改革能够减少拖延行为,在一定程度上遏制年末“突击花钱”现象。本文为深入理解年末“突击花钱”的动因与后果提供了新的微观证据,有助于探索更加精准的“突击花钱”治理路径。
abstract_en: Under the comprehensive rural revitalization strategy,the issue of year-end spending spikes and the resulting idleness of farmer-benefiting projects must be addressed,for this is essential for improving policy effectiveness and upholding correct views on political performance.Only by addressing these issues can achievements be produced that stand the test of practice,the people,and history.This paper utilizes micro-level data from 2908 farmer-benefiting projects across six counties in a major agricultural province in central China to investigate whether these spending spikes causally lead to project idleness and to explore the underlying behavioral logic of local administrators.The main findings are as follows.First,using a judge instrumental variable(IV)design that leverages the leniency of randomly assigned auditors,this paper finds that year-end spending spikes significantly increase the probability of project idleness.Second,mechanism tests reveal two primary pathways:(1)to accelerate procurement,departments compromise on construction quality,rendering facilities unusable;(2)to shorten review periods,they overlook supply-demand mismatch,making projects ill-suited to local needs.Notably,the dominant mechanism of idleness exhibits significant heterogeneity across project categories.Third,motivation analysis indicates that project managers do not strategically adjust spending based on project difficulty or budget size.Consequently,administrative procrastination,rather than precautionary savings,is identified as the primary driver of these spending spikes.Fourth,evaluations of governance paths indicate that zero-based budgeting effectively targets procrastination,thereby reducing year-end spending spikes and mitigating project idleness.This paper presents the following contributions.First,by employing a judge IV design,it establishes a robust causal link between year-end spending spikes and project idleness,significantly expanding research on fiscal performance in rural China.Second,this study examines the underlying drivers and policy solutions for year-end spending spikes.It tests the"procrastination"and"precautionary savings"hypotheses while evaluating the effectiveness of reforms such as advance fund allocation and zero-based budgeting to provide more targeted governance pathways.

title_cn: 食物营养当量视角下粮食主产区政策效应研究
title_en: The Effects of Major Grain-Producing Area Policies from a Food-Nutrient Equivalent Perspective
authors_cn: 周力 | 苏子凡 | 李昊洋
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZHOU Li;SU Zifan;LI Haoyang(College of Economics and Management,Nanjing Agricultural University;School of Economics,Zhejiang University of Finance&Economics)
institutions_cn: 南京农业大学经济管理学院 | 浙江财经大学经济学院
index_title: 食物营养当量视角下粮食主产区政策效应研究
abstract_cn: 树立并践行大食物观,亟须从营养来源多样化角度全方位、多途径开发食物资源。本文将多种食物产量统一折算为卡路里、蛋白质等营养当量,构建食物营养当量分解模型,把2000-2022年食物营养当量分解为规模、结构和强度效应,并采用全国农村固定观察点调查数据,实证分析粮食主产区政策实施对食物营养当量及其分解效应的影响。研究发现:中国食物营养当量增长主要由规模效应驱动,但结构效应为负,反映出食物生产结构向单位产值营养密度相对低的品类集中,使食物营养当量的实际增幅小于仅由规模扩张所带来的增幅;粮食主产区政策实施总体上增加了食物营养当量,但分品类看,其正向作用主要体现在粮食作物,同时分别使经济作物卡路里当量、蛋白质当量降低32.8%和96.8%,使养殖业食物净卡路里当量、净蛋白质当量降低53.1%和47.1%;粮食主产区政策实施对分解效应的影响与上述发现相呼应,其中,对结构效应的负向影响随时间变化有所增强。机制分析发现,粮食主产区政策实施通过调整作物种植结构、降低养殖业比较利益等方式改变农户种植、养殖要素投入,进而影响食物产出。本文研究结论为大食物观下加快推进食物资源开发与粮食安全政策协同提供了有益参考。
abstract_en: Under the greater food approach,food security in China needs to be evaluated not only by staple grain supply but also by the diversity of food sources and nutrient composition.While major grain-producing area policies have played a fundamental role in safeguarding staple grain output,less is known about how they affect broader food supply from a nutrient-based perspective.To address this issue,this paper examines the effects of major grain-producing area policies using a food-nutrient equivalent approach.This paper converts the outputs of multiple food categories into food-nutrient equivalents based on nutrient content and develops a decomposition framework that separates total food-nutrient equivalents into scale,structure,and intensity effects.Using macro data from 2000 to 2022,this paper characterizes the evolution of China’s food-nutrient supply.Using Rural Fixed Survey Data and a geographic regression discontinuity design,this paper further identifies the policy effects of major grain-producing area policies at the household level.The results show that the growth of China’s food-nutrient supply is mainly scale-driven,while the structure effect is negative,implying that changes in food production composition reduce the actual increase in nutrient supply relative to scale expansion alone.Major grain-producing area policies significantly increase household food-nutrient supply overall,raising calorie equivalents by 13.2%and protein equivalents by 29.5%.The largest gains are found in grain production,which is consistent with the core objective of securing staple grain supply.Additionally,the policies reduce the nutrient equivalents of economic crops and livestock-based foods,indicating a reallocation of food production across categories.The corresponding results for the decomposition effects are broadly consistent with this pattern,especially in showing a negative structural adjustment associated with the policy.Mechanism analysis further suggests that the policies affect household production decisions by changing relative returns,crop choices,and input allocation in both planting and livestock production.This paper may contribute to existing literature in three respects.First,it extends food security evaluation from physical output to food-nutrient equivalents in a unified and comparable framework.Second,it proposes a decomposition framework that distinguishes scale,structure,and intensity effects in food-nutrient supply.Third,it provides micro-level evidence on how major grain-producing area policies reshape the food production structure through household behavioral responses.The findings suggest that,under the premise of safeguarding staple grain security,greater attention should be paid to the coordination between grain security policies and diversified food resource development.

title_cn: 轮作补贴能否提高粮食全要素生产率——来自东北三省玉米和大豆种植户的微观证据
title_en: Can Crop Rotation Subsidies Improve Grain Total Factor Productivity?Micro Evidence from Corn and Soybean Growers in Northeast China
authors_en_and_affiliations: YANG Xinyu;GAO Ming(School of Economics,Central University of Finance and Economics;Research Center for Rural Economy,Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the People's Republic of China)
institutions_cn: 中央财经大学经济学院 | 农业农村部农村经济研究中心
index_title: 轮作补贴能否提高粮食全要素生产率——来自东北三省玉米和大豆种植户的微观证据
abstract_cn: 轮作补贴是引导农户参与轮作的经济激励工具,对加强东北地区耕地保护、推动农业可持续发展具有重要作用。基于全国农村固定观察点2019-2023年东北三省农户数据,以玉米-大豆轮作补贴为例,本文系统分析了轮作补贴对玉米、大豆全要素生产率的影响及其作用路径。研究表明:第一,轮作补贴显著提升了玉米和大豆全要素生产率,其中对玉米全要素生产率的促进效应具有一定滞后性;第二,轮作补贴主要通过要素投入和技术采纳两条路径影响玉米和大豆全要素生产率,具体表现为减少大豆农药和玉米化肥投入,并影响农户对测土配方施肥、秸秆还田等保护性耕作技术的采纳;第三,异质性分析显示,轮作补贴对黑龙江省大豆种植户和吉林省玉米种植户提高粮食全要素生产率的促进作用更为显著。此外,轮作补贴对东北三省经营规模较大、耕地细碎化程度较低农户的大豆全要素生产率提升作用更为显著。基于以上分析,本文提出应动态调整轮作补贴对象和标准、构建适于轮作的农业社会化服务体系、健全土地流转市场与产权保护机制等政策启示。
abstract_en: The increase in grain production in China was mainly driven by the intensive use of cultivated land resources,which led to soil degradation and environmental pollution.Therefore,while promoting sustainable food production,improving the total factor productivity(TFP)of grain is the key task to ensure national food security.As a key measure for farmland protection and agricultural sustainable development,crop rotation has significant positive externalities in ecological conservation,but due to high costs and uncertain incomes,farmers have a low willingness to adopt it.Crop rotation subsidies are important policy instruments to solve this problem,but their effect on grain TFP and its mechanism have not been fully explored.Using data on maize and soya bean farmers in Northeast China from the National Fixed Observation Points in rural areas of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs for 2019 to 2023,this paper uses a fixed-effects model to analyze the impact of crop rotation subsidies on grain TFP,while conducting robustness tests and addressing endogeneity issues.The empirical results are as follows.First,the rotation subsidies significantly improve the TFP of corn and soybean,and the promotion effect on the TFP of corn is lagging.Second,the effect path of rotation subsidies on the TFP of corn and soybean is mainly through factor input and technology adoption,such as reducing the input of soybean pesticides and corn fertilizers,affecting farmers'adoption of technologies such as soil testing,formula fertilization,and straw returning to the field.Third,the heterogeneity analysis shows that the rotation subsidies for soybean farmers in Heilongjiang Province and corn farmers in Jilin Province have a more significant impact on the TFP.In addition,the rotation subsidies are more significant to improve the soybean TFP of large-scale farmers with low degree of cropland fragmentation in Northeast China.The marginal contribution of this paper lies in determining the impact of crop rotation subsidies on the TFP of corn and soybeans,analyzing the key transmission roles of chemical intermediate inputs and conservation tillage technologies,and examining the heterogeneity across scenarios such as farm size and province.These findings enrich the literature on the relationship between agricultural subsidies and agricultural TFP growth.

title_cn: 收入增长驱动农产品加工业演进的机制——基于农业全产业链视角的跨国经验证据
title_en: The Mechanism of Income Growth Driving the Evolution of the Agri-Food Processing Industry:Cross-Country Evidence from the Agricultural Whole Industrial Chain Perspective
authors_cn: 严斌剑 | 余宝林 | 王一如 | 周应恒
authors_en_and_affiliations: YAN Binjian;YU Baolin;WANG Yiru;ZHOU Yingheng(College of Economics and Management,Nanjing Agricultural University;Intelligent Laboratory for Food Security Governance and Policy,Nanjing Agricultural University;MSU Institute,Nanjing Agricultural University;School of Economics,Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics)

index_title: 收入增长驱动农产品加工业演进的机制——基于农业全产业链视角的跨国经验证据
abstract_cn: 农产品加工业是推动乡村一二三产业深度融合、实现农业现代化的战略支点。本文基于经济合作与发展组织的国家间投入产出表,构建了1995-2022年72个全球主要国家的面板数据集,从农业全产业链视角,实证分析了人均国民收入变动驱动农产品加工业结构演进的阶段特征与传导机制。研究发现:人均国民收入与农产品加工业综合发展指数呈倒U型关系;受需求结构升级与要素成本变动的共同驱动,农产品加工业的演进路径表现为由粗加工向精深加工升级,进而向服务化转型。中国正处于向产业服务化转型的关键期。跨国比较结果表明,人口规模较大和农业用地面积较广的国家,会更早进入后工业化阶段。本文还揭示了农业全球价值链分工地位演变在农产品加工业演进中的关键传导机制,并证实了不同的农业全球价值链参与模式具有非对称的调节效应。本文研究能为理解全球农产品加工业的演变逻辑提供实证支撑,为推动中国农业全产业链升级提供决策参考。
abstract_en: The agri-food processing industry(AFPl)is a strategic pivot for the integrated development of primary,secondary,and tertiary industries and a cornerstone for achieving agricultural and rural modernization.In the context of global value chain(GVC)restructuring,understanding the evolutionary logic of AFPI is crucial for the implementation of China's rural revitalization strategy.This study investigates whether the decline in AFPI share is a systemic paradigm shift or a temporary fluctuation,providing empirical support for avoiding"premature de-industrialization"and facilitating a high-quality transition into a strong agricultural nation.Grounding the analysis in Justin Yifu Lin's New Structural Economics,alongside the Engel and Baumol effects,this study constructs a theoretical framework for AFPI evolution from an agricultural GVC perspective.It develops a multidimensional,comprehensive development index encompassing vertical value-added efficiency and horizontal industrial positioning.The empirical analysis utilizes a global panel dataset covering 72 economies from 1995 to 2022,based on the OECD Inter-country Input-Output(ICIO)tables.This cross-country approach ensures standardized statistical calibers for systematic international comparisons of industrial trajectories.Empirical results confirm a significant inverted"U"-shaped relation between gross national income(GNI)per capita and the AFPI development index.The industry evolves through three stages:rough processing,deep processing,and transition toward servitization.Countries with large populations and extensive agricultural land,driven by scale economies,enter the post-industrial stage earlier.This study identifies the evolution of GVC division of labor as the core transmission mechanism,where income growth promotes structural transformation by elevating GVC positioning.Crucially,GVC participation modes exert asymmetric effects:Forward participation accelerates the leap toward high-value service links,while excessive backward participation may lead to"low-end lock-in".This study concludes that China is currently in a critical transition phase toward industrial servitization.Policy focus should shift from scale expansion to fostering new quality productive forces by supporting digital supply chains,food R&D,and brand marketing.Strategies such as"Processing at the Source"in the main producing areas are vital to transform resource endowments into competitive value-added gains.Strengthening GVC integration will enhance the resilience and international discourse power of China's agri-food system,aligning with the"dual circulation"development pattern.This study offers three primary innovations.First,it breaks the"single-sector"analytical paradigm by adopting an agricultural whole industrial chain perspective.Second,the constructed composite index provides a more precise measurement of industrial depth and breadth than output indicators.Finally,by treating GVC participation modes as moderating variables,it reveals the asymmetric regulatory effects of global trade on industrial paths,offering nuanced insights for emerging economies to overcome"low-end lock-in"and achieve structural upgrading.

title_cn: 乡村特色产业内生发展的多元路径——基于村社自主性与资源禀赋互构的组态视角
title_en: Diverse Pathways for the Endogenous Development of Rural Specialty Industries:A Configuration Perspective Based on the Inter-Construction of Village Community Autonomy and Resource Endowments
authors_cn: 张晓蕾 | 尚航标 | 李嘉琪
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZHANG Xiaolei;SHANG Hangbiao;LI Jiaqi(College of Economics and Management,Northeast Forestry University;School of Economics and Management,Jilin Agricultural University)
institutions_cn: 东北林业大学经济管理学院 | 吉林农业大学经济管理学院
index_title: 乡村特色产业内生发展的多元路径——基于村社自主性与资源禀赋互构的组态视角
abstract_cn: 发展乡村特色产业是拓宽农民增收渠道、实现乡村振兴的重要途径。然而,如何实现带动农民增收的乡村特色产业发展仍然是当前的实践难题。现有研究往往忽视了村社自主性与资源禀赋的协同作用,因而难以解释乡村特色产业发展内生动力生成的内在逻辑。本文构建了“村社自主性-资源禀赋”互构分析框架,利用中国乡村振兴综合调查(CRRS)2022年村级调查数据,运用模糊集定性比较分析方法和必要性分析方法,系统分析了乡村特色产业的多元内生发展路径。研究发现:第一,单一的前因条件均不是产生高特色产业发展水平的必要条件,但较高的乡村居民主体性在各组态中均作为核心条件出现。第二,两类驱动乡村特色产业内生发展的路径分别为资源约束下的精英引领与居民协同路径和禀赋支撑下的制度赋能与居民自发路径,且乡村精英自主性和制度资本存在一定的替代效应。第三,在经济发展水平较高与较低的省份,乡村特色产业的发展路径呈现差异化的特征。具体而言,经济发展水平较低省份的村庄对资源禀赋的依赖程度更高,主体与资源的协同更为关键;经济发展水平较高省份的村庄对资源禀赋的依赖程度较低,主体间的协同更为关键。因此,推动乡村特色产业发展,需要村庄内部主体进一步开展组织化赋权实践,激活村庄内部的集体行动能力,推动乡土资源价值的内生转化,以更高水平的村社自主性,因地制宜地启动、推进和加快乡村特色产业的内生发展,从而使之成为推进乡村全面振兴的新引擎。
abstract_en: Developing rural specialty industries is a crucial approach to broadening the channels for increasing farmers'income and achieving rural revitalization.However,how to actualize the development of rural specialty industries that effectively drive income growth remains a persistent practical challenge.Existing research often overlooks the synergistic effect between village community autonomy and resource endowments,making it difficult to explain the internal logic behind the generation of endogenous driving forces for such industries.To address this gap,this study constructs an inter-construction analytical framework of"village community autonomy and resource endowment".Utilizing the village-level survey data from the 2022 China Rural Revitalization Survey(CRRS),this study systematically analyzes the multiple endogenous development pathways and conditional mechanisms of rural specialty industries by employing fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis(fsQCA)and necessary condition analysis(NCA).This study reveals three key findings.First,no single antecedent condition is a necessary condition for producing a high level of specialty industry development;however,a high level of rural residents'subjectivity emerges as a core condition across all configurations,demonstrating its irreplaceable foundational role.Second,the driving modes for high-level specialty industry development exhibit multi-causal conjunctural and substitution effects,identifying two typical pathways:the elite-led and resident-synergy pathway under resource constraints,and the institutionally empowered and resident-spontaneous pathway supported by endowments.Furthermore,a certain substitution effect exists between rural elite autonomy and institutional capital.Third,influenced by regional economic conditions,the development pathways of rural specialty industries display significant spatial heterogeneity.Specifically,villages in less economically developed provincial-level regions rely more heavily on resource endowments,making the synergy between subjects and resources more critical.Conversely,villages in more economically developed provincial-level regions depend less on resource endowments,making the synergy among subjects more crucial.Therefore,this paper advocates that promoting the development of rural specialty industries requires implementing organized empowerment practices,activating collective action capabilities within villages,and driving the endogenous transformation of local resource values,thereby accelerating the endogenous development of rural specialty industries in a locally adapted manner through a higher level of village community autonomy.The main marginal contributions of this paper are threefold.First,from a theoretical perspective,it constructs an inter-construction analytical framework of"village community autonomy and resource endowment",revealing the dynamic generation mechanisms of industrial development through the dual lenses of subject interaction and endowment adaptation.Second,methodologically,it breaks through the conventional"net effect"paradigm by integrating fsQCA and NCA to capture the complex,asymmetric causal relationships in rural specialty industries.Third,in terms of empirical value,utilizing nationwide large-scale survey data,it precisely identifies multiple developmental pathways,offering targeted and externally valid decision-making references for villages with diverse endowments to achieve rural revitalization.

index_title: 马克思产业演进理论视角下地方政府推动特色产业演进的适应性治理机制
abstract_cn: 在县域经济转型升级和区域竞争加剧的背景下,特色产业已成为地方政府推动高质量发展的重要抓手,但在实践中仍面临培育路径不明确与发展成效不彰显的双重问题。鉴于此,本文基于马克思产业演进理论,结合适应性治理理论构建“机会开发-治理响应-产业演进”动态分析框架,通过对柳州螺蛳粉产业进行纵向案例分析,系统探讨地方政府如何通过适应性治理引导特色产业实现阶段性跃迁。研究发现:第一,地方政府的治理逻辑并非单一且静态,而是根据治理环境的不同呈现“顺应式”“嵌入式”“互构式”三类适应性治理响应;第二,地方特色产业沿着“特色产品培育-特色产品产业化-特色产业系统化”的路径演进,本质上是“产业的结构升级”“产业结构的升级”持续耦合互动的辩证过程;第三,地方政府的阶段性适应性治理构成产业升级的内生动力,上一阶段的产业演进成效又进一步构成下一阶段地方政府治理响应的基础。以上结论能为推进地区特色产业实现高质量发展提供理论借鉴和实践参考。
abstract_en: Against the backdrop of county-level economic restructuring and intensifying regional competition,the cultivation of local specialty industries has become an important pathway through which local governments promote high-quality development.In practice,however,such industries often face two interrelated difficulties:unclear cultivation pathways and unsatisfactory developmental outcomes.These problems are rooted partly in the fact that the role positioning and adaptive mechanisms of local governments remain unclear across different stages of industrial evolution.Given the multiple goals and complex governance tasks involved in the development of specialty industries,local governments need to move beyond the static question of whether to intervene and instead adopt differentiated governance responses suited to changing developmental conditions.In this context,this paper takes the Luosifen(river snail rice noodles)industry in Liuzhou as a longitudinal case to examine how local governments promote the staged evolution of specialty industries through adaptive governance.Based on adaptive governance theory and Marxist industrial evolution theory,this paper develops an analytical framework of"opportunity exploitationgovernance response—industrial evolution"and employs a longitudinal exploratory case-study design.This paper finds that:(1)In promoting the evolution of specialty industries,local governments exhibit three adaptive governance modes under different governance environments:accommodative governance,embedded governance,and co-constructive governance.Under these three modes,local governments assume the roles of guardian,architect,and collaborator,respectively,and follow the corresponding logics:identification logic,support logic,and adjustment logic.(2)Local specialty industries evolve along the path of"specialty product cultivation—specialty product industrializationspecialty industry systematization".It is essentially a dialectical process in which"structural upgrading within an industry"and"upgrading of the industrial structure"are continuously coupled and interact with each other.(3)The staged adaptive governance of local governments constitutes an endogenous driving force for industrial upgrading,while the outcomes of industrial evolution in the preceding stage further provide the basis for governance responses in the subsequent stage.The policy implications are as follows.First,local governments should establish dynamic identification mechanisms in accordance with the evolutionary stages of distinctive industries and match them with differentiated adaptive governance tool-kits,thereby shifting governance from static administration to adaptive adjustment.Second,local governments should promote both the vertical deepening within industries and the horizontal expansion of the broader industrial system in the process of upgrading distinctive industries,while establishing a two-way feedback mechanism through which new market demands generated by horizontal integration can be transmitted and,in turn,drive product and process innovation in vertically linked production segments,thereby forming a mutually reinforcing cycle.Third,local governments should transform the key achievements generated in one stage of governance into the practical starting point for the next stage of industrial development,with greater attention to the continuity and convertibility of governance outcomes.

title_cn: 破解“协而难治”:分层式组织与特色农业产业协同治理
title_en: Breaking the"Collaborative Yet Hard-to-Treat"Dilemma:Hierarchical Organization and Collaborative Governance of Specialty Agricultural Industries
authors_cn: 谢作渺 | 李圆圆 | 贾雯雯
authors_en_and_affiliations: XIE Zuomiao;LI Yuanyuan;JIA Wenwen(School of Management,Minzu University of China)

index_title: 破解“协而难治”:分层式组织与特色农业产业协同治理
abstract_cn: 本文结合湖北省长阳土家族自治县的魔芋产业案例,揭示分层式组织在特色农业产业多元主体共治中的治理逻辑。研究发现:首先,特色农业产业治理具有明显的复合性,产业链各环节因核心属性存在差异,会衍生出性质各异的治理问题。种植端受制于良种研发不足与生产动力不足的“瓶颈”,市场端则面临市场空间受限与价值链低端锁定的挑战。其次,政府、市场与社会主体通过分层式组织实现了特色农业产业整体的有效协同治理。在种植端,表现为“政府整体动员-龙头企业破局-合作社深耕”的渐进式分层组织,从而逐步突破种子繁育与规模化生产难题;在市场端,政府基于市场规律进行赋能,龙头企业和在地典型企业形成分工式分层组织,分别推动市场空间拓展与价值链升级。最后,分层式组织发挥治理效能的关键在于制度构建、关系联结与知识流动三类机制在不同治理情境中的有效协同。从各主体的比较优势看:政府组织者以制度构建为核心,辅以知识流动;市场组织者以制度构建与知识流动为双重核心;社会组织者以关系联结为核心,以知识流动为辅助。这种差异化的机制组合,为破解产业链各环节不同属性的问题提供了精准路径,从而有力推动了分层式组织对促进产业整体协同的关键作用。本文揭示了多元主体由共同在场转向有效协同的内在机理,为破解特色农业产业“协而难治”困境提供了理论解释与实践参照。
abstract_en: Against the backdrop of comprehensively promoting rural revitalization and high-quality economic development the specialty agricultural industries have become key drivers for activating county-level development.In a multi-actor governance landscape,some regions have built competitive industrial chains,while others remain mired in a dilemma of"difficult to govern despite cooperation,and ineffective despite co-governance".Taking the konjac industry in Changyang Tujia Autonomous County,Hubei Province,as a case study,this paper constructs a hierarchical organization to reveal the organizational logic of multi-actor co-governance in the specialty agricultural industries.The main findings of this paper are as follows.First,the governance of the specialty agricultural industries is distinctly composite.Different links of the industrial chain,due to heterogeneous core attributes,give rise to qualitatively different governance sub-problems.Second,the government,market,and social actors achieve effective collaborative governance of the entire specialty agricultural industry through the hierarchical organization.At the production(farming)end,a progressive hierarchicalorganization—"the government's overall mobilization,leading enterprises'breakthrough,and cooperatives'deep cultivation"—gradually overcomes the difficulties of seed breeding and large-scale production.At the market end,the government empowers based on market rules,while leading enterprises and typical local enterprises form a division-of-labor hierarchical organization,promoting market space expansion and value chain upgrading,respectively.Third,the effectiveness of the hierarchical organization depends on the effective synergy of three types of mechanisms—institutional construction,relational networking,and knowledge flow—across different governance contexts.The marginal contributions of this paper are threefold.First,it proposes the logic of hierarchical organization for the governance of specialty agricultural industries,offering a new theoretical perspective for understanding collaborative governance in China's specialty agriculture.Second,it reveals the contextual dependence of mechanism combinations in collaborative governance,enhancing theoretical explanations and practical relevance.Third,it adopts a problem governance-oriented dynamic process-tracing method,thereby providing a more complete dynamic depiction of the governance process.

title_cn: 《中国农村经济》创刊40年载文研究——兼论中国“三农”研究发展
title_en: Study on Published Articles in Chinese Rural Economy in the Past 40 Years:With a Discussion on the Development of China’s Academic Research About Agriculture,Rural Areas and Farmers
authors_cn: 《中国农村经济》编辑部 | 陈秋红 | 胡祎 | 柳荻 | 马太超 | 尚友芳
institutions_cn: 中国社会科学院农村发展研究所
index_title: 《中国农村经济》创刊40年载文研究——兼论中国“三农”研究发展
abstract_cn: 对学科内代表性学术期刊长期载文情况做出系统梳理和纵贯研究,能从成果发表角度客观展示中国“三农”研究的历史演变,整体呈现学科发展状况和思想脉络。本文通过分析《中国农村经济》创刊以来的载文情况,展现中国“三农”研究40年来的基本态势、发展脉络、重点主题和核心特征,展望未来“三农”研究的重点,并论述“三农”研究的基本遵循。研究结果表明:中国“三农”研究力量持续发展,以黄祖辉、叶兴庆和钟甫宁等为代表的44位专家构成《中国农村经济》40年来的核心作者,作者来源单位类型以1998年为界由以各级党政机关、事业单位为主向以高等院校和科研院所为主转变;研究方法在20世纪90年代由以定性思辨性研究为主转向以定量研究为主;相关科研项目对“三农”研究的扶持力度在2004年后明显增长,包括国家社会科学基金、国家自然科学基金等在内的国家级基金是“三农”研究资金的主要来源;农村改革与发展、农村土地制度、农民收入与反贫困、农村劳动力转移、粮食安全和农业农村绿色发展是40年来中国“三农”研究的6个重点主题。40年来,中国“三农”研究在实践中不断丰富和发展,“三农”改革和发展实践在理论创新引领下不断推进,理论研究与实践探索的螺旋式上升是中国“三农”研究演进的核心特征。未来,应加强对农村基本经营制度、乡村产业高质量发展、土地制度改革、新型城镇化和城乡融合发展、强农惠农富农支持与共同富裕、数字乡村与智慧农业、农村金融改革、生态环境治理和生态保护、农村社会治理与文化建设等重点领域的研究。中国“三农”研究应持续注重批判性借鉴西方理论,坚持问题导向,正确看待研究方法,并重视中国特色“三农”研究自主知识体系构建。
abstract_en: Systematically sorting out and conducting longitudinal research on articles in representative academic journals within a discipline in the long term can objectively show the historical evolution of China’s“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”studies from the perspective of published papers,and present the development status and ideological context of the discipline as a whole.This paper takes Chinese Rural Economy as an example.By analyzing the articles since its inception,this paper presents the basic situation,development context,key themes,and core characteristics of the evolution of China’s“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”studies in the past 40 years,looks forward to the possible key areas of“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”studies in the future,and discusses the basic principles of“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”studies.This paper mainly draws the following conclusions.With the development of the research force on“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”in China,44 experts represented by Huang Zuhui,Ye Xingqing,and Zhong Funing constitute the core authors of Chinese Rural Economy in the past 40 years,and the types of institutions where the authors worked changed from Party and government organs and public institutions at all levels to universities and research institutes in 1998.In the 1990s,the research methods changed from qualitative thinking to quantitative research.After 2004,the support of relevant research projects for“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”studies increased significantly.National funds,including the National Social Science Fund of China and the National Natural Science Foundation of China,are the main sources of research funds for“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”.Rural reform and development,rural land system,farmer income and anti-poverty,rural labor transfer,food security,and agricultural and rural green development are the key themes of China’s“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”studies in the past 40 years.China’s“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”studies have been continuously enriched in practice,and the reform and development practice of“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”have been continuously promoted by theoretical innovation.The spiral rise of theoretical research and practical exploration is the core feature of the evolution of China’s“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”studies.Based on the above analysis,this paper believes that it is necessary to strengthen research in key areas such as rural basic management system,high-quality development of rural industries,land system reform,new urbanization and urban-rural integrated development,strengthening agriculture,benefiting farmers,and raising rural living standards and common prosperity,digital countryside and smart agriculture,rural financial reform,ecological environment governance system and ecological protection,as well as rural social governance and cultural construction.China’s“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”studies should focus on critical reference to Western theories,adhere to the problem-oriented,correct view of research methods,and pay attention to the construction of an independent knowledge system of“agriculture,rural areas and farmers”studies with Chinese characteristics.

title_cn: 东西部协作促进了受援县城乡融合发展吗
title_en: Impact of East-west Collaboration on Integrated Urban-rural Development in Recipient Counties
authors_cn: 单德朋 | 向洋 | 王超
authors_en_and_affiliations: SHAN Depeng;XIANG Yang;WANG Chao(School of Economics,Southwest Minzu University;The Institute of Local Finance Research,Zhejiang University of Finance and Economics;School of Public Finance and Taxation,Zhejiang University of Finance and Economics)
institutions_cn: 西南民族大学经济学院 | 浙江财经大学地方财政研究院 | 浙江财经大学财政税务学院
index_title: 东西部协作促进了受援县城乡融合发展吗
abstract_cn: 着力推进城乡融合、区域协调发展,是中国内需增长最大的潜能所在。本文以东西部协作政策实施作为准自然实验,考察了县域结对帮扶对受援县城乡融合发展的影响,并着重分析了不同结对模式对受援县城乡融合发展的异质性影响。研究发现:东西部协作政策的实施,显著提升了受援县城乡融合发展水平,且主要通过人的融合、经济融合和社会融合三个维度共同发挥作用。该结论通过了一系列稳健性检验。异质性分析进一步表明,结对帮扶时间越长、双方产业互补度越高,东西部协作政策实施的效果越明显;而财政帮扶强度和双方经济差距则并非越大越好,二者均在程度适中的组别效果最佳。本文结论不仅有助于深入理解东西部协作政策实施对受援县城乡融合发展的影响及其作用机制,丰富跨地区协作的效应研究,也为优化东西部协作帮扶模式与结对关系提供了政策借鉴。
abstract_en: The construction of a new pattern of integrated urban-rural development,achieving bidirectional free flow of urban and rural factors,is an important guarantee for the realization of Chinese modernization.Building institutional channels for urban-rural integration is of great significance in breaking the practical constraints faced by urban-rural integration.The east-west collaboration is a major decision to promote coordinated regional development and common prosperity.Studying the impact of the east-west collaboration on urban-rural integration not only helps explore effective pathways for urban-rural integration but also provides references for improving the mechanism of east-west collaboration.This paper,based on the theory of factor flow,analyzes the main mechanisms by which the east-west collaboration influences urban-rural integration and conducts an empirical test using panel data from 398 counties in China from 2012 to 2021,treating the implementation of paired assistance in the east-west collaboration as a quasi-natural experiment.The results indicate that the east-west collaboration policy significantly enhances the integrated urban-rural development in recipient counties,and this conclusion remains robust after employing a series of robustness tests.Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the mode of the east-west collaboration is a key factor affecting integrated urban-rural development,and maintaining a long-term paired relationship between the collaborating parties,based on an appropriate intensity of financial assistance,is more conducive to promoting integrated urban-rural development.From the perspective of the matching degree of paired parties,the more moderate the economic gap and the higher the degree of industrial complementarity between the two parties,the more it benefits the positive role of the east-west collaboration in integrated urban-rural development.In the process of Chinese modernization,it is necessary to further clarify the long-term stability of the policy of east-west collaboration policy,and develop the east-west collaboration into an important platform for collaboration between the eastern and western regions.It is essential to extend the paired relationships to the county level,to optimize the paired model and assessment system.The east-west collaboration needs to focus on combining the cultivation of internal development capabilities of recipient counties and the industrial transfer from the eastern region.The marginal contributions of this paper are mainly reflected in three aspects.First,this paper directly investigates the impact of the implementation of the east-west collaboration on the urban-rural integration of the recipient counties,which enriches the multiple power mechanisms for integrated urban-rural development and provides empirical references to improve the east-west collaboration.Second,the paper manually constructs a dynamic pairing list at the county level for east-west collaboration and uses a time-varying difference-in-differences(DID)method to accurately assess the policy effects of east-west collaboration.Third,this paper not only focuses on the average policy effect of east-west collaboration on urban-rural integration in recipient counties but also analyzes the heterogeneity of the relationship between east-west collaboration and urban-rural integration from aspects such as the intensity of fiscal assistance,the duration of paired assistance,and the matching degree of paired entities.

title_cn: 东西部对口支援政策实施能否降低脱贫农户返贫风险
title_en: Can Paired Assistance Decrease the Risk of Returning to Poverty Among Rural Households Lifted Out of Poverty
authors_en_and_affiliations: JIA Nan;WANG He(School of Economics,Sichuan University)
institutions_cn: 四川大学经济学院
index_title: 东西部对口支援政策实施能否降低脱贫农户返贫风险
abstract_cn: 对口支援是中国特色国家治理的重要方式和机制,东西部对口支援在脱贫攻坚中发挥了重要作用,进一步考察东西部对口支援在新时期预防规模性返贫、建立稳定脱贫长效机制中的作用对巩固脱贫攻坚成果和乡村振兴意义重大。本文借助“携手奔小康”行动的外生冲击,综合使用“中国家庭金融调查”和“中国城乡社区治理调查”数据,借助复原力指标测度脱贫农户的返贫风险,通过双重差分法、合成双重差分法、倾向得分匹配双重差分法等因果识别方法考察了东西部对口支援政策实施对脱贫农户返贫风险的影响及主要作用机制。本文研究发现,东西部对口支援政策实施显著降低了脱贫农户的返贫风险,且对高返贫风险农户有良好的识别与帮扶效果,但对深度贫困地区农户和脱贫不稳定户则无政策倾斜。作用机制检验结果显示,产业帮扶、就业帮扶与消费帮扶共同稳定了脱贫农户的收入,医疗援助与人才援助共同提高了脱贫农户的人力资本水平,基础设施建设的帮扶效果则并不明显。据此,本文认为,应在保持东西部对口支援整体政策稳定的基础上,进一步调整对深度贫困地区的政策,加强产业帮扶与消费帮扶,缩小城乡公共服务差距。
abstract_en: This paper investigates the role of the paired assistance program between eastern and western regions in mitigating the risk of returning to poverty among rural households lifted out of poverty.The paired assistance program has contributed significantly to poverty alleviation during the campaign against absolute poverty.However,its potential to prevent the risk of returning to poverty and foster sustainable poverty alleviation in the context of rural revitalization remains underexplored.This paper aims to fill this gap by examining the effectiveness and mechanisms of the paired assistance program during the post-poverty alleviation era.This paper employs a quasi-experiment based on the“Hand-in-Hand to Build a Well-Off Society”initiative launched in 2017.It utilizes data from the China Household Finance Survey(CHFS),the China Community Governance Survey(CCGS),and the China County Statistical Yearbook.Using resilience indicators to measure the risk of returning to poverty,this paper uses difference-in-differences(DID),synthetic DID,and propensity score matching DID(PSM-DID)to evaluate the causal impact of the paired assistance program between eastern and western regions on the resilience of rural households lifted out of poverty.Empirical findings reveal that the paired assistance program between eastern and western regions significantly enhances the resilience of rural households lifted out of poverty.Notably,the program effectively identifies and supports households with a higher risk of returning to poverty,although it does not exhibit preferential support for severely impoverished areas or those who have just emerged from poverty but whose position is far from secure.Mechanistic analysis shows that the program’s effectiveness stems from multiple channels:(1)Industrial,employment,and consumption support contribute to stabilizing household income;(2)Medical and educational assistance improve human capital levels;(3)Infrastructure support shows limited impact.This paper further identifies the sustainability of the paired assistance program,finding that the program does not impose significant fiscal burdens on donor regions.Policy implications derived from the findings include:(1)sustaining the paired assistance program as a key policy for consolidating poverty alleviation achievements and promoting rural revitalization;(2)optimizing program mechanisms by prioritizing industrial and consumption assistance to create self-sustaining income growth;(3)strengthening educational and medical assistance to close urban-rural gaps in public services and interrupt the intergenerational transmission of poverty;(4)addressing policy gaps for severely impoverished areas and those who have just emerged from poverty but whose position is far from secure to ensure inclusive growth.This paper makes the following contributions.First,it expands the theoretical framework of paired assistance by integrating income process theories to explain the program’s impact on the risk of returning to poverty.Second,it provides the first empirical assessment of the“Hand-in-Hand to Build a Well-Off Society”initiative and offers robust causal evidence of its effects.Third,it explores the general equilibrium effects and sustainability of the program,a dimension rarely addressed in existing studies.

title_cn: 灵活就业如何影响农村家庭收入流动
title_en: How Flexible Employment Effect the Rural Household Income Mobility
authors_cn: 郭露 | 王峰 | 彭刚
authors_en_and_affiliations: GUO Lu;WANG Feng;PENG Gang(School of Statistics and Data Science,Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics;School of Statistics,Dongbei University of Finance and Economics;School of Statistics,Southwestern University of Finance and Economics)
institutions_cn: 江西财经大学统计与数据科学学院 | 东北财经大学统计学院 | 西南财经大学统计学院
index_title: 灵活就业如何影响农村家庭收入流动
abstract_cn: 凭借较低的进入门槛,灵活就业为大量农村劳动力提供了非农就业契机,但其不稳定特性也为农村家庭收入向上流动带来了挑战。本文基于中国家庭金融调查数据实证检验灵活就业及相关就业状态转换的农村家庭收入流动效应。研究发现:相较于未参与灵活就业的农村家庭,参与灵活就业有利于农村家庭收入向上流动。具体而言,若农村劳动力期初处于失业、务农或创业状态,转向灵活就业能够促进其家庭收入向上流动;若农村劳动力期初处于正规就业状态,其退出正规就业后如果能够转向灵活就业则可避免其家庭收入向下流动;若农村劳动力期初处于灵活就业状态,持续参与灵活就业、转向机会型创业或正规就业均能促进其家庭收入向上流动,但后两者对于农村家庭收入向上流动的边际效应更大。异质性分析发现:灵活就业的农村家庭收入流动效应在低收入组别中更强,即推动了“提低”“扩中”,且在平台经济发展更好的地区更有利于发挥持续灵活就业的农村家庭收入流动效应。本文认为,推动农村劳动力参与灵活就业、改善灵活就业环境和加快灵活就业者向正规就业转换等措施能够促进农村家庭收入向上流动。
abstract_en: Flexible forms of employment have met the employment needs of surplus labor in rural areas,stimulated new vitality in the rural employment market,and provided strong support for high-quality,full employment for the common prosperity.However,despite the low entry barriers,the unstable nature of flexible employment poses a challenge to the upward mobility of rural household incomes.Against this background,it is of great theoretical and practical significance to study the relationship between flexible employment and rural household income mobility.Based on the 2015,2017,and 2019 China Household Finance Survey data,the paper empirically investigates the impact of flexible employment on rural household income mobility.The conclusions of this paper show that the rural labor forces’beginning or continuing participation in flexible employment is conducive to the upward mobility of household income.If the rural labor forces are unemployed,working in agriculture,or starting a business at the beginning of the period,flexible employment can provide non-agricultural employment opportunities and promote upward household income mobility;if the rural labor forces are in formal employment at the beginning of the period,flexible employment can provide supplemental income after exiting from formal employment and avoid downward household income mobility.For rural flexible workers,continued participation in flexible employment,shifting to opportunistic entrepreneurship,or formal employment can contribute to upward household income mobility;however,the marginal effect of the latter two on upward household income mobility is larger.In addition,the income mobility effect of flexible employment is significantly stronger in the low-income group,and the income mobility effect of sustained flexible employment is more favorable to rural households in areas with a better development on the platform economy.Based on the above conclusions,this paper puts forward the following policy implications.First,we should fully understand the important role of flexible employment and actively promote the participation of rural labor in flexible employment.Second,we should strengthen the protection of flexible employment,improve the environment for flexible employment,increase the stability of flexible employment,and increase the income of low-income groups through sustained flexible employment.Thirdly,we should give full play to the advantages of the platform economy,so that the dividends of the platform economy will benefit more rural families,popularize the use of mobile Internet,and strengthen digital literacy training,thus continuously bridging the digital divide.Finally,we should improve the employment statistics monitoring system and enrich employment statistics.The possible marginal contributions of this paper are reflected in the following three aspects.Firstly,this paper focuses on rural households and takes the number of labor forces involved in flexible employment in households as the entry point,enriching relevant research on the socio-economic effects of flexible employment.Secondly,this paper,from the dynamic perspective of the two-period income rank changes of rural households,systematically examines the impact of the rural labor forces’participation in flexible employment on the income mobility of their households.Thirdly,this paper further decomposes the employment dynamics of rural labor in relation to flexible employment through the changes in the type of employment in the two periods of rural labor,and explores the effective ways to promote the upward mobility of rural household income through flexible employment.

title_cn: 户籍制度改革对城镇居民家庭消费的影响
title_en: The Impact of the Household Registration System Reform on Urban Households’Consumption
authors_cn: 毛盛志 | 王军辉 | 张吉鹏
authors_en_and_affiliations: MAO Shengzhi;WANG Junhui;ZHANG Jipeng(School of Economics,Southwestern University of Finance and Economics;Survey and Research Center for China Household Finance,Southwestern University of Finance and Economics;School of Economics,Shandong University)
institutions_cn: 西南财经大学经济学院 | 西南财经大学中国家庭金融研究中心 | 山东大学经济学院
index_title: 户籍制度改革对城镇居民家庭消费的影响
abstract_cn: 本文基于中国家庭消费的特征事实,创建一个包含户籍制度和内生移民决策的理论框架,从迁移决策与落户选择、生育与教育支出、居住成本和社会保障等维度,探讨户籍制度改革对城镇居民家庭消费的影响。本文利用2013-2021年的5轮中国家庭金融调查数据,分析发现:户籍制度改革对城镇居民家庭消费的影响主要体现在农转非居民家庭上,促使其人均消费支出提高了13%~15%;户籍制度改革对老年组城镇户籍居民家庭、中年组农转非居民家庭的人均消费支出影响较大,但对农民工家庭消费的影响不显著。进一步的分析表明:户籍制度改革使得农转非居民家庭的人均消费支出提高了4.8%,但比城镇户籍居民家庭的消费低约3.6%。充分提高城镇居民家庭的消费潜力,需要进一步深化户籍制度改革,为农民工家庭提供更好的公共服务,并加强农民工就业培训和配套政策体系建设,提升城市治理水平,推动农民工更好地融入城市。
abstract_en: A deep understanding of the relationship between the household registration system reform and urban residents’consumption is crucial for better formulating relevant policies,coordinating the expansion of domestic demand and the deepening of supply-side structural reforms,and promoting Chinese modernization and high-quality development.To study the impact of the 2014 household registration system reform on urban household consumption,this paper analyzes the stylized facts of urban households’consumption by deploying the China Household Finance Survey(CHFS)data.Following Choukhmane et al.(2023),this paper incorporates the household registration system,land system,and social security system into a three-period overlapping generations model,and theoretically explores the impact of the household registration system reform on the total consumption of various types of households.Moreover,given the CHFS data from 2013 to 2019,this paper uses the difference-in-differences(DID)method to estimate the impact of the 2014 household registration system reform on urban household consumption.The paper finds that the impact of the household registration system reform on household consumption of urban residents is mainly reflected in the impact on rural migrants who have transferred from rural hukou to urban hukou,causing their per capita consumption expenditure to increase by 13%-15%.However,the impact on rural migrants is insignificant.The heterogeneity analysis reveals that the reform of the household registration system has a greater impact on local urban households in the elderly group,and middle-aged households who have transferred from rural hukou to urban hukou.The reform of the household registration system has increased the per capita consumption expenditure of households who have transferred from rural hukou to urban hukou by 4.8%,but it is about 3.6%lower than the per capita consumption expenditure of local urban households.Therefore,to improve residents’consumption in the future,we must first deepen the reform of the household registration system,promote the equalization of basic public services including pensions,medical care,affordable housing,and education,reduce the household registration costs of rural migrants.Additionally,it is necessary to strengthen the employment training and supporting system for the rural migrants,and improve their human capital level,thereby improving their ability to settle down and live in cities.Finally,it is necessary to improve urban governance and develop social service organizations to provide better community services to the rural migrants,enriching their spiritual and cultural life and promoting their better integration into cities.This paper mainly contributes to existing literature in three aspects.Firstly,this paper builds up an innovative theoretical framework,including the household registration system,land system,and social security system,to explore the systematic impact of the household registration system reform on household consumption from multiple perspectives.Secondly,this paper distinguishes between rural migrants and residents who have transferred from rural hukou to urban hukou,and analyzes the heterogeneous impact of the household registration system reform on household consumption of residents with different hukou types.Finally,this paper discusses the heterogeneous impacts of the household registration system reform on the consumption of urban residents from the perspective of endogenous migration and settlement decisions.

title_cn: 代际居住距离增加降低了农村家庭子女的养老支持吗
title_en: Does the Increase in Intergenerational Living Distance Reduce the Elderly Support for Children in Rural Families
authors_en_and_affiliations: LU Wenxiu;WU Fangwei(Institute of Finance and Economics,Shanghai University of Finance and Economics;Institute of Urban and Rural Development,Shanghai University of Finance and Economics)
institutions_cn: 上海财经大学财经研究所 | 上海财经大学城乡发展研究院
index_title: 代际居住距离增加降低了农村家庭子女的养老支持吗
abstract_cn: 家庭养老是中国最重要的养老模式,但人口老龄化和大规模人口流动导致农村老年空巢家庭日益增加,家庭养老功能引发担忧。论文基于生活照料、精神慰藉和经济支持三个维度来测度农村家庭子女的养老支持水平,分析代际居住距离对农村家庭子女养老支持的影响及其机制。研究发现:第一,总体上,代际居住距离增加显著降低了农村家庭子女的养老支持水平,这一影响在子女数量少、不与配偶同住、低收入的农村家庭中更加明显。单一维度上,随着代际居住距离增加,子女提供的生活照料和经济支持下降,但精神慰藉增加。第二,代际居住距离增加通过提高子女日常照料的机会成本和社会养老服务消费,降低养老支持水平。其中,家庭经济状况更好的农村失能老年人使用社会养老服务的可能性更大。第三,代际居住距离增加使农村老年人实际的养老模式与期望发生偏离,农村老年人的病时照护需求和分享心事需求的满足对象由子女向其他主体转移。文章研究结论不仅为重新审视家庭养老功能是否弱化提供了新视角,也为把握农村社会养老服务的着力点提供了经验支撑。
abstract_en: Family support for the elderly is the most important mode of old-age support in China,but population aging and large-scale population mobility have led to an increasing number of elderly empty-nest families in rural areas,and the weakening family support for the elderly in rural areas has been widely discussed.This paper measures children’s old-age support in rural families in three dimensions:daily life care,spiritual comfort,and economic support,analyzes the impact of intergenerational residential distance on children’s old-age support in rural families and its mechanism,and empirically tests it using the Chinese Longitudinal Healthy Longevity Survey(CLHLS).The findings of this paper are as follows.(1)Increased intergenerational residential distance significantly reduces children’s old-age support,with a decrease in daily life care and financial support,an increase in spiritual comfort support,and an even greater decrease in children’s old-age support for older people who have fewer children,do not live with their spouses,and have low incomes.(2)Intergenerational residential distance reduces children’s old-age support by increasing the opportunity cost of daily life care provided by children and the consumption of social old-age services by the elderly.(3)Older people who are disabled and have better family economic status have a higher probability of using social care services.(4)The increase in intergenerational residential distance causes the actual pattern of old-age support for the rural elderly to deviate from expectations,and the rural elderly’s needs for care in times of illness and sharing their thoughts have shifted to the community and other relatives.This paper offers the following policy implications.(1)We should accelerate the construction of new-type urbanization with county towns as important carriers and provide policy support for the transfer of old-age pensions and medical insurance for the elderly who have been relocated with their families,which is an important way to alleviate the contradiction between rural families’old-age support and stable employment of young adults.(2)We should build a multi-level elderly care system for different types of older persons:purchasing elderly care services for low-income older persons and guiding social capital to provide specialized elderly care services for middle-and high-income older persons in accordance with the needs of the market.(3)Rural areas have the social capital to develop mutual support for the elderly,so the development of mutual support for the elderly in rural areas should be considered an important initiative to alleviate the rural old-age support problems.The marginal contributions of this paper are as follows.(1)Constructing a system of indicators of children’s old-age support in the three dimensions of daily life care,spiritual comfort,and economic support helps understand the changes in children’s old-age support in rural families.(2)This paper focuses on the effect of intergenerational residential distance on children’s old-age support,which expands the scope of research on the impact of residential arrangements on children’s old-age support.(3)This paper measures the opportunity cost of children’s provision of old-age support and portrays the mechanism by which intergenerational residential distance affects old-age support by influencing the opportunity cost of children’s caregiving,thus making up for the inadequacy of the mechanism analysis in the existing studies.

title_en: How Long-term Care Insurance Can Alleviate the Plight of“One Person’s Incapacity,the Whole Family’s Imbalance”:From the Perspective of Rural Adult Children’s Labor Supply
authors_cn: 卢素兰 | 钟海霞 | 冯艳维 | 宁满秀
authors_en_and_affiliations: LU Sulan;ZHONG Haixia;FENG Yanwei;NING Manxiu(College of Economics and Management,FujianAgriculture and Forestry University;College of Rural Revitalization,FujianAgriculture and Forestry University)

index_title: 长期护理保险制度何以破解“一人失能,全家失衡”困局——基于农村子女劳动供给的视角
abstract_cn: 建立长期护理保险制度,是积极应对人口老龄化,实现失能老年人老有所养和缓解“一人失能,全家失衡”困境的重要举措。本文将长期护理保险政策试点开展作为准自然实验,采用2014年、2016年、2018年和2020年中国家庭追踪调查数据,运用双重差分法考察长期护理保险政策实施对农村子女劳动供给的影响。研究发现:第一,长期护理保险政策实施对农村子女劳动供给产生显著的正向影响;第二,异质性分析表明,长期护理保险政策实施能够对老一代、女性和家庭收入水平低的农村子女劳动供给产生更加明显的促进效应;第三,机制分析表明,长期护理保险政策实施通过降低农村子女对失能父母的照料支持促进农村子女劳动供给。上述研究结果表明,长期护理保险政策实施能有效缓解农村家庭赡老压力,并释放农村年轻劳动力。本文认为,需持续推进长期护理保险政策,将保障对象扩至更大范围的农村地区,并因地制宜地实施差异化的农村长期护理保险政策;同时,结合农村劳动力结构特点,建设农村专业护理队伍,为农村失能老人提供更专业化、更有针对性的护理照料服务。
abstract_en: The establishment of the long-term care(LTC)insurance system is an important measure to respond positively to the aging of the population,achieve a sense of security for the disabled elderly and alleviate the plight of the“one person’s incapacity,the whole family’s imbalance”in old age.This study treats the pilot of the LTC insurance as a quasi-natural experiment and utilizes panel data from the China Family Panel Studies(CFPS)collected in 2014,2016,2018,and 2020.Employing the difference-in-differences(DID)method,it investigates the impact of the implementation of LTC insurance on the labor supply of rural adult children.The findings are as follows.Firstly,the LTC insurance policy has a significant positive impact on the labor supply of rural adult children.Secondly,the heterogeneity analysis shows that the implementation of the LTC insurance policy has a more significantly positive impact on the labor supply of the older generation,women,and rural adult children from lower-income families.Thirdly,the mechanism analysis shows that the implementation of LTC insurance policy promotes the labor supply of rural adult children by reducing the care support of rural children to their elderly parents.The above research results indicate that the implementation of LTC insurance policy can effectively alleviate the pressure of elderly care for rural families and increase the supply of the rural labor force.Therefore,there is a need to continuously promote the LTC insurance policy,extending its coverage to a wider range of rural areas,and implementing differentiated LTC insurance policies in rural areas according to local conditions.At the same time,based on the characteristics of rural labor structure,a professional nursing team in rural areas should be established to provide more specialized and targeted nursing care services for the disabled elderly in rural communities.The marginal contributions of this paper are as follows:Firstly,this paper focuses on rural areas where the care system for the disabled elderly is imperfect,care resources are more scarce,and the burden of adult children’s care is heavier,which not only enriches research on rural labor supply but also expands the evaluation chain of the implementation effect of the LTC insurance policy.Secondly,this paper constructs a work-leisure model for rural adult children including LTC insurance policies,and uses a large sample of micro-data in China to quantitatively evaluate the policy effect of the LTC insurance based on the DID model.Finally,this paper further verifies the mechanism that the implementation of the LTC insurance policy can reduce the care support of rural adult children to their parents,and promote the full employment of rural adult children.

authors_en_and_affiliations: MA Cuiping(Rural Development Institute,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences)
institutions_cn: 中国社会科学院农村发展研究所
index_title: 农村集体经营性建设用地入市:地方政府制度创新行为研究
abstract_cn: 地方政府的创新实践为完善农村集体经营性建设用地制度提供了重要的决策支撑。本文以国家33个农村集体经营性建设用地入市试点县(市、区)为研究对象,在归纳总结地方政府有关土地入市制度创新实践的基础上,从激励约束视角探讨地方政府制度创新的行为逻辑。研究发现:地方政府在中央政府顶层制度框架内,通过因地制宜扩展土地入市范围、创新土地入市模式、扩大土地入市用途、探索入市土地增值收益分配方式等举措,积极响应中央政府有关农村集体经营性建设用地入市的决策部署;制度创新是地方政府对中央政府激励机制作出的能动响应,其动力既源于对制度变动多元目标的追求,如提高土地资源配置效率、降低产权交易成本、促进区域平衡发展,也源于地方政府期望获得政治荣誉及晋升。进一步分析表明:中央政府在构建顶层制度框架的同时,也为地方政府制度创新预留了空间;地方政府具有制度创新的主观能动性,但制度创新的空间要视顶层制度的可变通余地而定;地方政府更倾向于采取边际调整的方式拓展既有制度边界。据此,完善农村集体经营性建设用地入市制度应推动国家顶层制度设计同基层探索有机结合,在国家层面尽快配套出台农村集体经营性建设用地入市具体指导意见或办法;加快地方各级国土空间规划审批和实施,防范随意调整规划和借规划调整改变耕地用途;强化农村土地改革的系统性和协同性,激发土地要素活力。
abstract_en: The innovative practices of local governments have provided important decision-making support for the improvement of the system of rural collectively commercialized land.This paper takes China's 33 county-level areas that have been chosen as pilots to build the collective commercialized land market as the research object.Based on summarizing the innovative practices of local governments about the rural collective commercialized land market,this paper discusses the behavioral logic of local govermments'institutional innovation from the perspective of the incentive constraints theory.This paper finds that local govermments actively respond to the central government's deployment,such as expanding the scope of land entering the market according to local conditions,innovating the land transaction mode,expanding the commercialized use of land,and exploring the distribution of value-added gains from the rural collective commercialized land market.Of course,these initiatives follow the top-level institutional design of the central government.Theoretical analysis suggests that institutional innovation is a dynamic response of local govermments to central govermment incentives.Local governments'institutional innovation is driven by the pursuit of multiple profits from institutional change,such as improving the efficiency of land resource allocation,reducing the cost of property rights transactions,and easing social conflicts.It also stems from the expectation of local governments to improve central-local relations and thus gain political honors as well as promotions.Further analysis suggests that while the central govermment builds a top-level institutional framework,it reserves space for local governments'institutional innovation;local governments have the initiative to innovate,but the scope for institutional innovation depends on the variable space of the top-level system;and local goverments are more inclined to take a marginal adjustment approach to extend the boundaries of established systems.This study highlights that the reform of rural collective commercialized land systems should promote the organic combination of national top-level institutional design and grass-roots exploration.To expeditiously introduce specific guidelines or measures at the national level for the rural collective commercialized land market,the design of the top-level system should consider the differences between regions,and encourage different regions to explore institutional innovation based on local conditions.It is necessary to accelerate the approval and implementation of territorial spatial planning at the local levels and prevent the arbitrariness of changes in land planning and the opportunity for arable land to be converted to other uses.The government should strengthen the systemic and synergistic nature of rural land tenure reform in practice,for example,strengthening the synergy with the reform of rural land acquisition,the reform of the rural homestead system,the reform of the rural property rights system,and the reform of the rental housing system.Additionally,we should expand and enrich the commercialized use of rural collective commercialized land,prioritizing the land demand for the comprehensive revitalization of villages.

title_cn: 组织治理契约:组织化推动土地资源资本化的理论机制与实践探索
title_en: Govern Contracts by Organization:Theory and Practice of Organizational Promotion to Land Resource Capitalization
authors_cn: 周立 | 汪庆浩 | 罗建章
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZHOU Li;WANG Qinghao;LUO Jianzhang(School ofAgricultural Economics and Rural Development,Renmin University of China;School of Public Policy and Management,Tsinghua University;China Institute for Rural Studies,Tsinghua University)
institutions_cn: 中国人民大学农业与农村发展学院 | 清华大学公共管理学院 | 清华大学中国农村研究院
index_title: 组织治理契约:组织化推动土地资源资本化的理论机制与实践探索
abstract_cn: 针对土地资源资本化面临的产权残缺和市场流转困境,已有研究提出了产权清晰论和市场完善论两种观点,前者认为确权确地是前提,只有产权明晰,才能通过流转实现土地资源的价值量化;后者认为市场有效是前提,只有通过交易实现合理定价,才能实现土地资源的价值显化。然而,在农村土地制度改革要坚守“三条底线”的背景下,两种观点的实践挑战主要体现为:一方面,过分强调产权清晰可能导致交易成本过高,抑制了流转需求;另一方面,资源定价过分依赖双边市场则会导致土地的权利与收益分配混乱,无法实现资源活化。上述两种观点本质上是在缺乏有效契约主体的前提下,对核心契约增加边缘契约,以提供确保契约有效性的“药方”,可以归纳为“契约治理契约”。对此,本文提出在不完全契约条件下,以“组织治理契约”为内核的组织有效论,并论证在产权清晰和市场完善的基础上,通过有效的“组织治理契约”,形成土地资源资本化的充分条件。基于此,本文构建“确股量化-价值显化-资源活化”的土地资源资本化分析框架,通过理论演绎论证“组织化确权-组织化交易-组织化托底”的“组织治理契约”作用机理,并进一步以内蒙古自治区鄂尔多斯市达拉特旗林原村“一社四部”案例,揭示组织化推动土地资源资本化的实践探索。研究发现,构建归属清晰、权能完整、流转顺畅、保护严格的中国特色社会主义农村集体产权体系,完善农村产权交易平台和提高村庄组织化程度是推动土地资源资本化的重要前提。《中华人民共和国农村集体经济组织法》的颁布实施,进一步确立了农村集体经济组织在村庄组织和治理上的法律地位,农村集体经济组织作为集体经济组织成员权的代行主体,能够成为“组织治理契约”的治理主体,从而以组织化推动土地资源资本化,发展新型农村集体经济。
abstract_en: Given the incomplete property rights and the dilemma of market circulation faced by the capitalization of land resources,existing studies have put forward two theoretical explanations:one is the theory of clear property rights,which,based on the transaction cost theory,puts forward that clear property rights can realize the circulation of resources.The other is the market perfection theory.Based on the two-sided market theory,it holds that reasonable pricing can promote resource trading and realize resource capitalization.Against the institutional background of insisting that the nature of collective ownership of rural land will not change,the above two theoretical viewpoints have encountered many challenges in practice.In essence,under the premise of lacking effective contract subjects,it is impossible to improve the core contract with incomplete property rights by adding extermal contracts,so it is impossible to ensure the effectiveness of the contract."Govern contracts by organization"is an important means for an organization to promote the capitalization of resources,and rural collective economic organizations are the key govermance subjects.Therefore,clear property rights and a perfect market are only two necessary conditions to realize the capitalization of land resources.On this basis,it is necessary to add the necessary condition of effective organizations to form a sufficient condition for the capitalizationofland resources.Compared with existing research,this paper has the following two marginal contributions.On the one hand,it talks about govern contracts by contract"with"govern contracts by organization"and solves the problem of the absence of contract subject in the situation of incomplete contract.It believes that the organizational mode of replacing collective membership rights with collective economic organizations is the third necessary condition for the capitalization of land resources,and demonstrates how effective organization,clear property rights,and a perfect market constitute sufficient conditions for the capitalization of land resources.On the other hand,based on the theoretical mechanism of"govern contracts by organization",this paper constructs the analytical framework of"stock confirmation quantification-value manifestation-resource activation"and the theoretical mechanism of"organizational confirmation-organizational transaction-organizational backing".It reveals the process of realizing goverm contracts by organization"by collective economic organizations to promote the capitalization of land resources through the practical exploration of"one economic cooperative,four departments"in Linyuan Village,Inner Mongolia.This paper proposes the following policy implications.First,it clarifies the legal nature ofshare","equity,and"stock"in the reform of the rural collective property rights system,expanding the power of assets and shares of rural collective economic organizations.Second,it is necessary to strengthen the function of collective economic organizations to act as members of collective economic organizations and improve the property rights trading platform.Third,it is essential to ensure that the collective economic organization is the ultimately responsible person for the contract ownership and the right to buy back the essential shares.

title_cn: 新一轮土地确权实施的农村劳动力跨部门配置效应
title_en: Effects of the New Round of Land Tenure Certification on Rural Labor Allocation Across Sectors
authors_cn: 吴佳璇 | 王晓兵 | 陆岐楠
authors_en_and_affiliations: WU Jiaxuan;WANG Xiaobing;LU Qinan(School of Advanced Agricultural Sciences,Peking University;School of Agricultural Economics and Rural Development,Renmin University of China)
institutions_cn: 北京大学现代农学院 | 中国人民大学农业与农村发展学院
index_title: 新一轮土地确权实施的农村劳动力跨部门配置效应
abstract_cn: 基于全国农村固定观察点调查数据和乡镇层面的土地确权时间数据,本文采用多时点双重差分法识别了新一轮土地确权对农村家庭劳动力配置的影响。研究发现,土地确权总体上显著促进了农村劳动力外出非农就业,但对农业全要素生产率水平不同的农户具有异质性影响:总体上农户农业全要素生产率水平越低,土地确权对其家庭中劳动力外出非农就业的促进作用越强。这说明,土地确权使不具有农业生产比较优势的农村劳动力转移到非农部门,具有农业生产比较优势的农村劳动力留在农业部门,从而优化了农村劳动力的跨部门配置。此外,土地确权显著提高了具有农业生产比较优势的农户的农业长期投资水平,并促使土地从较低农业全要素生产率的农户流转到较高农业全要素生产率的农户,进一步实现了要素的有效配置。本文在中国现有土地制度背景下构建了土地产权制度改革影响劳动力配置的分析框架,为理解土地产权制度安排与农村家庭要素配置的关系提供了经验证据。
abstract_en: Using data from the National Rural Fixed Observation Points Survey and town-level land certification timing data,this study employs a multi-period difference-in-differences(DID)approach to identify the effects of the new round of land tenure certification on rural labor allocation among sectors.This study seeks to examine the impact of the new round of land certification on rural labor allocation across sectors in China.Building on this,it further analyzes the role of the land certification process in facilitating the efficient allocation of other production factors.The main findings of this study are as follows.First,the land certification has significantly promoted the outflow ofrural labor to non-agricultural employment,with heterogeneous effects based on agricultural total factor productivity(TFP)across households before the land certification.This result indicates that land certification facilitates the reallocation of rural labor,shifting those without a comparative advantage in agriculture to non-agricultural sectors,while those with a comparative advantage remain in agriculture,thus optimizing cross-sectoral rural labor allocation.Second,the new round of land certification has a more significant role in promoting labor migration to non-agricultural employment in villages with lower pre-certification property stability,provincial-level regions with low labor export,and plain regions.Third,land certification significantly increases long-term agricultural investments among households with a comparative advantage in agricultural production,and facilitates the transfer of land from households with lower agricultural TFP to those with higher agricultural TFP,further achieving an eficient allocation of production factors.The above findings have several important implications.First,it is crucial to consolidate the achievements of the new round of land tenure certification by formulating and implementing subsequent management policies.These policies should further solidify the relationship between land and farmers'property rights,ensure effective coordination between the new round of land certification and the renewal of contracts upon the expiration of the second round of land contracts.Second,in non-plain regions where labor migration is hindered by geographical constraints,the govermment should strengthen infrastructure development and implement corresponding employment support policies to ensure that land tenure reform benefits vulnerable groups in these areas.Third,future efforts should focus on further improving rural factor markets and land transfer markets,maximizing the benefits of land property rights reforms in optimizing land allocation and promoting long-term investments.This study contributes to existing literature in three aspects.First,this paper examines the overall impact of the new round of land tenure certification on rural labor transfer and measures the comparative advantages in agricultural production of households by exploiting household-level agricultural TFP before the research period.Second,this paper mitigates the estimation bias by using town-level land certification timing data,compared to county-level or even province-level timing data in existing literature.Third,this paper rules out the confounding policy effects of the New Rural Social Pension Insurance and the New Rural Cooperative Medical Scheme by contrlling them in our multi-period DID model,thus better identifying the causal effects of land tenure certification on rural household labor allocation.
