title_cn: 就餐方式如何影响中国城镇常住居民的膳食结构与需求弹性
title_en: How Do Eating Patterns Affect the Dietary Composition and Demand Elasticity of Urban Residents in China?
authors_cn: 乔聪聪 | 周莹 | 田旭
authors_en_and_affiliations: QIAO Congcong;ZHOU Ying;TIAN Xu(College of Economics and Management,China Agricultural University;College of Economics and Management,Henan Agricultural University;Academy of Global Food Economics and Policy,China Agricultural University)
institutions_cn: 中国农业大学经济管理学院 | 河南农业大学经济与管理学院 | 中国农业大学全球食物经济与政策研究院
index_title: 就餐方式如何影响中国城镇常住居民的膳食结构与需求弹性
abstract_cn: 外出就餐已成为中国城镇常住居民的主要食物消费方式之一。然而,受数据限制,目前尚缺乏系统比较居民在家与外出就餐两种方式下食物消费结构及需求弹性差异的实证研究。本文基于9个省113个城市的调研数据,分析城镇常住居民在家和外出就餐食物消费结构的差异,并应用LES-QUAIDS两阶段需求模型,分别估计了在家与外出就餐时各类食物的需求弹性。研究发现:第一,居民外出就餐时更倾向于消费肉类、水果以及谷薯类,较少摄入奶类、蛋类和水产品。第二,外出就餐时各类食物均存在较高溢价,溢价幅度为2~13倍,其中蔬菜的外出就餐溢价幅度最高。第三,在家就餐时,肉类和水产品的收入弹性分别为0.19和0.21,其余食物的收入弹性均低于0.1;而外出就餐的收入弹性为0.05~0.52,显著高于在家就餐,其中,肉类和水产品的收入弹性较高。第四,外出就餐的自价格弹性普遍高于在家就餐,水产品尤为突出,但外出就餐时肉类的自价格弹性低于在家就餐。研究结果表明,收入增长对居民在家就餐时的食物消费量几乎没有影响,但对外出就餐尤其是对水产品和肉类的消费有显著的推动作用;食物价格上涨时,在家就餐需求受到的影响更大。食物需求预测结果显示,外出就餐消费占比将逐步提高,到2030年,谷薯类和蛋类消费量将进一步与《中国居民膳食指南(2022)》推荐量接近,蔬菜、水果、水产品以及奶类的消费量不足问题将有所缓解,但肉类摄入量偏高的趋势仍将延续。本文为理解不同就餐模式下的食物消费行为提供了新的实证证据;但考虑到数据覆盖范围和模型固有的局限性,研究结论仍需在更广泛的样本和动态视角下进一步验证。
abstract_en: Food away from home(FAFH)has become one of the main sources of food consumption for urban residents in developing countries.However,due to data limitations,empirical research systematically comparing dietary structures and demand elasticities between food at home(FAH)and FAFH remains scarce.Drawing on data from 113 cities in 9 Chinese provinces collected through an independent survey,this paper examines differences in food consumption structures among urban residents in China across different dining settings(FAFH or FAH).This paper applies a two-stage linear expenditure system-quadratic almost ideal demand system(LES-QUAIDS)demand model to estimate income and price elasticities of various food categories for both dining contexts.This paper yields four key findings.First,residents tend to consume more meat,fruits,and grains when choosing FAFH,while the intake of dairy,eggs,and aquatic products is relatively lower.Second,there are significant price premiums for foods consumed away from home,ranging from 2 to 13 times those of FAH consumption,with vegetables having the highest price premium for FAFH.Third,the income elasticity for FAH is generally low(0.19 for meat and 0.21 for aquatic products,with others below 0.1),whereas that for FAFH varies more widely(from 0.05 to 0.52),with relatively high values for certain animal-based food such as aquatic products and meat.Fourth,own-price elasticities for FAFH are higher,especially for aquatic products.However,for meat,the own-price elasticity is lower when consumed away from home.These findings suggest that income growth has little impact on the quantity of food consumed at home but significantly influences food consumption away from home,particularly for meat and aquatic products.When food prices rise,the demand for food at home is more affected.The price elasticity analysis reveals heterogeneous consumer responses across food types and dining settings.The projected results of future food demand indicate that the share of FAFH will gradually increase.By 2030,the consumption of cereals,tubers,and eggs will move closer to the recommended levels outlined in the Dietary Guidelines for Chinese Residents(2022).The problem of insufficient consumption of vegetables,fruits,aquatic products,and dairy is expected to improve to some extent.However,the problem of excessive meat consumption will further deteriorate.This paper provides new empirical evidence for understanding food consumption behavior under different eating patterns.Nonetheless,considering the limited geographic coverage and inherent constraints of the model,further validation using broader and dynamic datasets is warranted.

title_cn: 生态保护补偿制度何以有效实施——基于调适性协作的视角
title_en: How Can the Ecological Protection Compensation System Be Effectively Implemented?From the Perspective of Adaptive Collaboration
authors_en_and_affiliations: YE Qinglin;CHU Zhujie(School of International and Public Affairs,Shanghai Jiao Tong University)
institutions_cn: 上海交通大学国际与公共事务学院
index_title: 生态保护补偿制度何以有效实施——基于调适性协作的视角
abstract_cn: 本文基于调适性协作的视角,以赤田水库流域为例,阐释生态保护补偿制度实施效果从“补偿不受益”到“补偿共受益”的内在机理。研究发现,赤田水库流域生态保护补偿制度得以有效实施的关键是调适性协作,即“激励约束-动机适配-能力互补”的动态调适。一方面,生态保护补偿制度通过构建激励约束机制,动态调适地方政府的环境治理动机和能力,逐步实现高质量发展和环境保护的目标。另一方面,地方政府能动地调适其环境治理动机,进而优化激励约束机制,并阶段性地形成对财政、人力等有形和无形资源的依赖诉求。同时,地方政府借助纵向介入、横向合作和社会协同等多种协作关系,提升其获取、分配和使用关键性资源的能力,强化激励约束机制,并协调其环境治理动机。调适性协作的作用在于动态识别地方政府环境政策执行偏差的阶段性变化,并采取相应的纠偏机制。
abstract_en: Ecological conservation compensation is an important institutional tool for improving the ecological civilization system and advancing the modemization of environmental govemance,playing a crucial role in promoting the harmonious coexistence of humans and nature.Taking the implementation of the ecological conservation compensation system in the Chitian Reservoir basin as a case study,this paper constructs an analytical framework for the effective implementation of the ecological conservation compensation system from the perspectives of the principal-agent theory and the resource dependence theory.It conducts a theory-building process tracing to reveal the intermal mechanism underlying the effective implementation of ecological conservation compensation.This paper describes four modes of implementing the ecological conservation compensation system:single horizontal,dual horizontal,vertical-led dual horizontal,and multi-subject collaborative participation,as well as their resulting implementation effects of“compensation without mutual benefit”and“compensation with mutual benefit”This paper finds that the key to the effectiveness of the ecological conservation compensation system lies in adaptive collaboration,following the logic of“incentive and constraintmotivation adaptation-capability complementarity”。First,the implementation of the ecological conservation compensation system dynamically adjusts the environmental governance motivations and capabilities of local govermments through establishing incentive and constraint mechanisms,gradually achieving the goals of high-quality development and environmental protection.Second,local govermments proactively adjust their environmental governance motivations,thereby optimizing incentive and constraint mechanisms,and periodically forming dependency demands for tangible and intangible resources such as financial,human,legitimacy,and regional network resources.Finally,local govermments enhance their capabilities to acquire,allocate,and utilize key resources through multiple collaborative relationships,including vertical intervention,horizontal cooperation,and social collaboration,strengthen incentive and constraint mechanisms,and coordinate their environmental governance motivations.Furthermore,this paper summarizes the general operational mechanism of adaptive collaboration,namely,the mechanism for identifying and correcting deviations in the implementation of local environmental policies.Based on the research conclusions,this paper proposes the following policy implications.First,we should give full play to the incentive and constraint roles of the ecological conservation compensation system.Second,we should dynamically balance the rigid constraints of the system and differences in regional governance motivations and capabilities.Third,we should systematically strengthen the interaction and coordination between the ecological conservation compensation system and other govermnance systems.The main marginal contributions of this paper are as follows.First,it reveals the intemal mechanism for the effective implementation of the ecological conservation compensation system and analyzes solutions to the dificulties faced in its implementation.Second,it identifies factors such as motivation adaptation and capability complementarity in local govemments'environmental govemance,providing a new theoretical perspective to explain why the ecological conservation compensation system can be effectively implemented.Third,it examines the interaction mechanism among the influencing factors of the implementation of the ecological conservation compensation system,further clarifying the core logic underlying its effective implementation.

title_cn: 国家重点生态功能区转移支付政策的实施能否提升县域乡村振兴水平
title_en: Can the Transfer Payment for National Key Ecological Function Zones Enhance County-Level Rural Revitalization?
authors_en_and_affiliations: YANG Qiuyue;YANG Zhen(School of Marxism,Anhui University;Institute of Industrial Economics,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;Research Center for Technological Innovation,Tsinghua University)
institutions_cn: 安徽大学马克思主义学院 | 中国社会科学院工业经济研究所 | 清华大学技术创新研究中心
index_title: 国家重点生态功能区转移支付政策的实施能否提升县域乡村振兴水平
abstract_cn: 国家重点生态功能区转移支付政策旨在实现环境保护、民生改善和生态扶贫三重目标,对试点县域乡村振兴具有重要作用。本文基于2003-2020年中国县域数据和遥感数据,全面评估中国各县域的乡村振兴水平,并以国家重点生态功能区转移支付政策实施为准自然实验,采用渐进双重差分法考察了国家重点生态功能区转移支付政策的实施对县域乡村振兴水平的影响。研究发现:第一,实施国家重点生态功能区转移支付政策显著提高了试点县域的乡村振兴水平,有助于该地区经济社会的高质量发展。并且,生态转移支付规模与县域乡村振兴水平呈正相关关系,省级生态转移支付规模每提高1个标准差,县域乡村振兴水平平均提升约4.7073%。第二,机制分析结果表明,该政策能够通过推动产业结构优化、改善公共服务质量和提升绿色转型绩效三重机制提升试点县域的乡村振兴水平。第三,异质性分析结果表明,该政策的实施对县域乡村振兴水平的影响在生物多样性维护型、水源涵养型和防风固沙型功能区是显著的,对中部、东部地区和低污染地区乡村振兴水平的影响是显著的。本文研究结论能为健全生态转移支付制度、推动乡村全面振兴提供政策启示。
abstract_en: The transfer payment for National Key Ecological Function Zones(TPNKEFZ)refers to the central government allocating special funds through the equalization transfer payment program to guide local governments in strengthening ecological conservation,enhancing public service standards,and promoting sustainable development.The policy's core value lies in optimizing rural industrial structures,improving local public service,fostering ecological culture,and increasing farmers'incomes through ecological fiscal transfers(EFT),thereby ultimately achieving the goal of comprehensive rural revitalization characterized by thriving businesses,pleasant living environment,social etiquette and civility,effective governance,and prosperity.Based on county-level data and remote sensing data from 2003 to 2020,this paper comprehensively evaluates rural revitalization levels in China's county-level regions.This paper treats the TPNKEFZ as a quasi-natural experiment and utilizes the staggered difference-in-differences(DID)method to investigate the effect of EFTs on rural revitalization.The results show that the TPNKEFZ policy significantly improves rural revitalization in pilot areas and promotes high-quality economic and social development.The mechanism analysis shows that the TPNKEFZ policy can enhance rural revitalization in pilot areas by the industrial structure optimization effect,the public service improvement effect,and the green transformation effect.The heterogeneity analysis reveals that the policy exerts more pronounced effects on rural revitalization in counties classified as biodiversity conservation zones,water conservation zones,and windbreak-sand fixation zones,with stronger impacts also observed in central and eastern regions and low-pollution areas.The findings of this study provide policy inspiration for the central govemment to improve the EFT system and promote rural revitalization.The contributions of this paper are manifested in three key aspects.First,by examining the impact of the TPNKEFZ policy on county-level rural revitalization,this paper extends research on the ecological and social effects of EFTs and provides a new analytical framework.Second,this paper adopts the TPNKEFZ policy as a case,conducting a dual analysis that not only evaluates its impact on county-level rural revitalization but also elucidates the transmission mechanisms in three dimensions:industrial structure optimization,public service quality enhancement,and green transformation performance improvement.Third,based on a sample of 1743 Chinese counties,this paper employs the staggered DID model and instrumental variable approach to assess the impact of the TPNKEFZ policy on county-level rural revitalization,addressing data limitations and endogeneity concerns to enhance policy effect evaluation accuracy.

title_cn: 特岗教师计划实施如何影响县域农村人力资本水平
title_en: How Does the Special Post Teacher Program Affect Rural Human Capital in Counties
authors_en_and_affiliations: WANG Xuan;GUO Chenyang(School of Public Finance and Management,Yunnan University of Finance and Economics;School of Economics,Xiamen University)
institutions_cn: 云南财经大学财政与公共管理学院 | 厦门大学经济学院
index_title: 特岗教师计划实施如何影响县域农村人力资本水平
abstract_cn: 加强新时代农村教师队伍建设,有助于促进义务教育优质均衡发展,实现共同富裕。本文以中国农村义务教育阶段学校教师特设岗位计划的实施为准自然实验,识别其对农村人力资本水平的影响。结果表明:第一,特岗教师计划的实施对农村人力资本水平具有积极效应,对个体受教育年限以及是否获得高中程度学历均有显著的正向影响。每派遣一次特岗教师,将会使项目县(市、区)农村学生受教育年限增加0.18年、获得高中程度学历的概率增加3.5%。第二,特岗教师计划的实施具有明显的益贫效应,位于原国家级贫困县、家庭经济相对贫困的个体受特岗教师计划实施的影响更大;同时,特岗教师计划可显著提升代际流动性,父母受教育程度更低、父母工资收入更低的个体,其人力资本水平的提升效应越明显。第三,在作用机制方面,特岗教师计划主要通过提高师生比和提高教师学历的方式提升农村学生的人力资本水平。本文从教育供给侧结构性改革中的农村教师资源投入视角出发,相应结论能为中国义务教育优质均衡发展与农村人力资本积累提供经验证据。
abstract_en: The Third Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China(CPC)has identified improving the mechanism for promoting high-quality and balanced compulsory education as the direction of educational reform.In terms of high-quality and balanced compulsory education,the balanced distribution of high-quality teachers is particularly important.This paper takes the implementation of the Special Program for Recruiting Teachers to Rural Compulsory Education Schools in 2006 as a quasi-natural experiment and uses the 2015 National 1%Sample Population Survey data to explore how this policy affects rural human capital.Theoretically,on the one hand,the special post teacher program directly improves the teaching quality in rural schools by introducing teachers with bachelor's degrees or above.The systematic teaching of special post teachers can enhance academic performance;open guidance of special post teachers can stimulate learning interest and improve the classroom atmosphere;and the localized background of teachers can reduce the sense of distance in education at a higher level.On the other hand,the special post teacher program increases the teacher-student ratio in rural schools in the central and westen regions,effectively reducing the burden on teachers and allowing them to focus more on teaching improvement and knowledge update,thereby enhancing teaching quality and boosting students'confidence.Additionally,the increase in the teacher-student ratio enables teachers to have more energy for individualized tutoring,which is conducive to improving the overal learning environment.The empirical results are as follows.First,the special post teacher program has a positive effect on the human capital in rural areas,with significant positive impacts on both the years of education received by individuals and the probability of obtaining senior high school education Second,the special post teacher program has obvious pro-poor effects,with individuals from the original national-level poverty-stricken counties and those from relatively poor family backgrounds being more affected by the program.Additionally,the program can significantly enhance intergenerational mobility,with the improvement in human capital being more pronounced for individuals whose parents have lower educational attainment and lower income.Third,in terms of the mechanisms,it is verified that the special post teacher program mainly improves the human capital of students by increasing the teacher-student ratio and the educational qualifications of teachers.The policy implications of this paper are as follows.First,it is necessary to strengthen the coordination and integration of the special post teacher program with other educational policies to avoid duplicate resource investment.Second,it is necessary to implement better teacher treatment guarantee measures to optimize the teacher structure.Third,it is necessary to stimulate the innovative vitality of the program and explore an educational and teaching system that suits local conditions to enhance the endogenous development momentum of rural education.The conclusions provide empirical evidence for the high-quality and balanced development of compulsory education and the accumulation of rural human capital in China.

title_cn: 教育如何影响城乡收入差距——基于分位点测算教育禀赋效应与回报效应
title_en: How Does Educational Development Affect the Urban-Rural Income Gap:Based on the Quantile Estimation of the Endowment Effect and Return Effect of Education
authors_en_and_affiliations: QU Yue;ZHAO Xin(Institute of Population and Labor Economics,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;School of Economics,University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences)
institutions_cn: 中国社会科学院人口与劳动经济研究所 | 中国社会科学院大学经济学院
index_title: 教育如何影响城乡收入差距——基于分位点测算教育禀赋效应与回报效应
abstract_cn: 本文基于中国城市劳动力调查数据(CULS),利用RIF-OB分解方法,从禀赋效应和回报效应两方面,实证分析受教育程度对不同收入分位点上城乡收入差距的影响。研究发现,2010-2023年,城乡间教育差距与收入差距未显著改善,城乡间本科及以上学历占比差距不断扩大。就教育对城乡收入差距的影响而言,2010年,主要是教育禀赋差异影响城乡收入差距;2016年和2023年,教育回报差异扩大了中低收入分位点上的城乡收入差距。进一步研究发现,相较于城镇户籍劳动力,农村户籍劳动力的教育代际向上流动效应较弱且未得到明显改善。城乡间教育代际传递效应的不同扩大了城乡间教育禀赋差异,不利于缩小城乡收入差距。城乡教育回报率变化存在差异,2016年以后,城镇户籍劳动力的教育回报率显著高于农村,特别是中低收入分位点上的城乡教育回报率差异有所扩大,教育回报差异成为阻碍城乡收入差距改善的重要因素。以教育发展来畅通向上发展通道、缩小收入差距,需要关注农村户籍劳动力的教育机会与教育公平,促进教育与劳动力市场相匹配,使劳动力能够获得与其受教育水平相称的回报。
abstract_en: Against the backdrop of continuous educational development,disparities exist in educational levels and their returns between urban and rural areas.Additionally,the urban-rural income gap varies at different income quantiles.Therefore,this paper,based on a more detailed perspective of income quantiles and educational ttainment,uses the China Urban Labor Survey(CULS)data and the RIF-OB decomposition method to empirically study the impact of urban-rural differences in educational endowment and return on the urban-rural income gap at different income quantiles and its variations.The findings show that from 2010 to 2023,the educational gap and income gap between urban and rural areas have not significantly improved.As for the impact of education on the urban-rural income gap,in 2010,it was mainly the educational endowment effect;in 2016 and 2023,the educational return differences expanded the urban-rural income gap at the lower and middle-income quantiles.Further analysis reveals that compared to laborers with urban hukou,the intergenerational upward mobility effect of education for laborers with rural hukou has been weaker and has not significantly improved from 2010 to 2023.The difference in intergenerational educational transmission effects has widened the educational endowment gap,which is not conducive to narrowing the urban-rural income gap.By calculating the educational return of urban and rural laborers separately,it is found that there are differences in the changes of educational return rates between urban and rural areas.After 2016,the educational return rate for laborers with urban hukou has been significantly higher than that for those with rural hukou,especially at the lower and middle-income quantiles,where the gap in educational return rates has widened,and has become an important factor hindering the improvement of the urban-rural income gap.To facilitate upward mobility and narrow the income gap through educational development,it is necessary to pay close atention to the educational opportunities and faimess for laborers with rural hukou.This will effectively promote the matching of education and the labor market,enabling laborers to receive returns commensurate with their educational attainment.The marginal contributions of this paper are as follows.First,it analyzes the impact of differences in the educational endowment and return on the urban-rural income gap at different income quantiles,and compares the differences at different educational levels,further detailing relevant research.Second,it compares and observes the differences in educational improvement between urban and rural areas and the dynamic changes in their impact on the urban-rural income gap,which helps understand the recent educational development situation and the status of educational returms.In addition,it helps examine whether the basic education development for the low-income quantile groups in urban and rural areas has played a universal function,and analyzes the differences in the roles of basic education and higher education at different income quantiles.

title_cn: 智慧农业应用能否提升企业全要素生产率——基于173570家农业企业的实证研究
title_en: Can the Application of Smart Agriculture Enhance Enterprise Total Factor Productivity?An Empirical Study Based on 173,570 Agricultural Enterprises
authors_cn: 王明哲 | 陈慧 | 汤佳 | 张延龙
authors_en_and_affiliations: WANG Mingzhe;CHEN Hui;TANG Jia;ZHANG Yanlong(School of Public Policy and Management,Tsinghua University;Faculty of Applied Economics,University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;School of Population and Health,Renmin University of China;Institute of Rural Development,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences)
institutions_cn: 清华大学公共管理学院 | 中国社会科学院大学应用经济学院 | 中国人民大学人口与健康学院 | 中国社会科学院农村发展研究所
index_title: 智慧农业应用能否提升企业全要素生产率——基于173570家农业企业的实证研究
abstract_cn: 智慧农业作为一项重要的颠覆性农业技术,对发展农业新质生产力具有重要意义。本文基于2021-2023年具有代表性的173570家农业企业微观数据,分析了智慧农业应用对农业企业全要素生产率的影响。研究结果显示,智慧农业应用显著提高了农业企业的全要素生产率。作用机制方面,智慧农业应用主要通过实现技术进步和优化资源配置来提升农业企业的全要素生产率。进一步分析表明,智慧农业应用对养殖业企业、国有企业和国家级农业产业化龙头企业的全要素生产率提升具有更大作用。同时,智慧农业应用具有显著的溢出效应,能够间接促进其他农业企业全要素生产率的提升,对区域农业全要素生产率的提升也具有积极影响。本文不仅丰富了智慧农业应用与农业企业生产效率提升之间关系的理论研究,也为加快培育农业新质生产力提供了现实参考。
abstract_en: As a pivotal disruptive agricultural technology,smart agriculture holds significant implications for developing new quality productive forces in agriculture.Based on microdata from 173,570 representative agricultural enterprises in China from 2020 to 2022,this paper systematically analyzes the impact of smart agriculture applications on the total factor productivity(TFP)of enterprises,while further examining the underlying mechanisms,heterogeneous effects,and spillover effects.The findings of this study are as follows.First,the application of smart agriculture enhances the TFP of agricultural enterprises.After a series of robustness tests,this conclusion stll holds.Furthermore,the regression result of using the digital rural pilot policy as an exogenous shock once again validates the establishment of this positive effect.Second,the application of smart agriculture enhances the TFP of agricultural enterprises through technological progress and optimal allocation of resources.Third,the application of smart agriculture plays a greater role in enhancing the TFP of livestock breeding enterprises,state-owned enterprises,and national-level leading agricultural industrialization enterprises.Fourth,the application of smart agriculture has a significant spillover effect.It can not only indirectly improve the TFP of other agricultural enterprises,thereby accelerating the technological diffusion of the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain,but also have a positive impact on the improvement of the TFP in regional agriculture through the mechanism of connecting and benefiting farmers of agricultural enterprises,fully demonstrating the multiplier effect formed by the mechanism of connecting and benefiting farmers.Based on these empirical findings,this study puts forward the following policy implications.First,we should increase policy support for smart agriculture.Second,we should promote the in-depth integration of smart agriculture and rural economic development.Third,we should strengthen the cultivation of talents and the popularization of technologies in smart agriculture.The marginal contributions of this paper are as follows.First,it focuses on the impact of smart agriculture applications on the TFP of agricultural enterprises,addressing a critical research gap in this field.Second,it shows how smart agriculture improves the TFP of agricultural enterprises,providing a comprehensive analytical framework for understanding their relationship.Third,it expands the analysis of the spillover effects of smart agriculture applications.

title_cn: 地方政府控股金融机构如何影响企业创新水平——以城市信用社改制为准自然实验
title_en: How Government Ownership of Financial Institutions Affects Corporate Innovation:A Quasi-Natural Experiment from Ownership Reform of Urban Credit Cooperatives
authors_cn: 刘贯春 | 王琪红 | 叶永卫 | 何枫
authors_en_and_affiliations: LIU Guanchun;WANG Qihong;YE Yongwei;HE Feng(Lingnan College,Sun Yat-sen University;Institute of Mezzoeconomics,Sun Yat-sen University;College of Public Finance and Investment,Shanghai University of Finance and Economics;School of Finance,Capital University of Economics and Business)
institutions_cn: 中山大学岭南学院 | 中山大学中观经济学研究院 | 上海财经大学财税投资学院 | 首都经济贸易大学金融学院
index_title: 地方政府控股金融机构如何影响企业创新水平——以城市信用社改制为准自然实验
abstract_cn: 如何为企业创新营造良好的融资环境是实现创新驱动型经济增长的关键所在。本文将城市信用社改制为城市商业银行视为一项准自然实验,利用渐进式双重差分方法考察地方政府控股金融机构如何影响企业创新水平。研究发现,城市信用社改制显著降低了企业专利申请数量,其核心作用机制在于企业债务期限缩短引致的创新投入不足。异质性分析表明,对于财政压力大和城市信用社改制力度大的地区以及创新密集型企业,城市信用社改制对企业创新的抑制效应更强。进一步讨论发现,企业创新质量在城市信用社改制后亦显著下降。特别地,全国统一大市场建设有助于缓解地方政府控股金融机构对企业创新的抑制效应。得益于地方政府对基础设施投入力度的加大,城市信用社改制在整体上提升了企业生产率和总产出。本文认为,在缓解政企融资竞争关系以促进企业创新的同时,还需要考虑地方政府融资以加大生产性公共支出所带来的经济增长效应,进而推动经济高质量发展。
abstract_en: Amidst a new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation reshaping the global innovationlandscape, enterprises, as key drivers of technological innovation, are expected to play a pivotal role in promoting high-qualityeconomic development and advancing technological self-reliance and self-strengthening at higher levels. However, enterprises stillgrapple with challenges such as insufficient investment in innovation and weak innovation capabilities. Therefore, exploringeffective ways to cultivate a conducive financing environment for corporate innovation to effectively strengthen enterprises’innovation capacity is of great significance for transitioning to an innovation-driven economic growth mode.This paper exploits the ownership reform of urban credit cooperatives into city commercial banks as a quasi-naturalexperiment, and leverages matched data from the China Industrial Enterprise Database and the Patent Database spanning1998–2009 to systematically investigate how local government ownership of financial institutions affects corporate innovation.Econometric analysis using a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) approach reveals that the reform of urban creditcooperatives significantly reduced firms’ patent applications. These findings satisfy the parallel trends assumption and remain robustacross various robustness checks, including controls for non-random selection into the ownership reform and adjustments forconcurrent policies during the study period. Mechanism analysis shows that the ownership reform of urban credit cooperativessignificantly shortened firms’ debt maturity structure, characterized by a decline in long-term liabilities and a rise in short-termliabilities. This shift, in turn, led to a reduction in firms’ innovation investment. Heterogeneity test shows that this effect is morepronounced in regions with higher fiscal pressure and greater reform intensity, and firms with higher R&D intensity. Furtheranalysis shows that the number of invention patents and the positive sensitivity of sales revenues to patent applications significantlydecrease, revealing that this ownership reform worsens corporate innovation quality. In particular, the establishment of a unifiednational market helps alleviate the innovation-inhibiting effects of government ownership of financial institutions, and the increasedinfrastructure investment by local governments is conducive to improving firms’productivity and output.Our findings highlight the need for a nuanced evaluation of government ownership in financial institutions. While alleviatingfinancing competition between governments and firms to promote corporate innovation, it is necessary to account for the economicgrowth effect of productive public expenditures. This paper makes two key contributions. First, it innovatively differentiates thefundamental distinctions between the establishment of urban commercial banks and the reform of urban credit cooperatives,providing a systematic evaluation of the latter’s impact on corporate innovation. Second, leveraging the exogenous nature of theownership reform of urban credit cooperatives, this paper bridges two strands of literature—debt maturity structure and firminnovation, as well as government-enterprise financing competition and firm innovation—thereby enriching existing research.

title_en: Agricultural Institutional Genes and Their Political-Economic Implications:With a Discussion on Building an Autonomous Knowledge System for Agricultural Political Economics
authors_en_and_affiliations: LUO Biliang(National School of Agricultural Institution and Development,South China Agricultural University,Guangdong Provincial Key Research Base of Philosophy and Social Sciences-Agricultural and Rural Policy and Reform Innovation Research Center,South China Agricultural University)

index_title: 农业制度性基因及其政治经济学含义——兼论农业政治经济学的自主知识体系构建
abstract_cn: 在人类文明的历史进程中,农业一直框定着社会演化的底层逻辑。谷物种植及由其决定的人口定居、村庄形成与国家造就,表明农业制度性基因蕴含着重要的政治经济学含义。本文旨在揭示以下内容:第一,农业制度性基因体现为以土地产权为核心、以生产组织为载体、以文化伦理为纽带的制度惯性与路径依赖机制。第二,农耕定居模式本质上是人类为突破能量获取“瓶颈”而进行的“制度创新”,人类驯化了自然,自然也反向驯化了人类,“双向驯化”诱发了典型的“农庄效应”。第三,在时间偏好、等级社会、信任机制、性别角色等多个维度的生成根源方面,农业实践给出的证据或许是最具说服力的历史性解释。第四,中国的农耕文化遗产能够从历史遗存转型为破解现代性危机的思想资源,为人类文明演进提供中国智慧。本文强调,从农业视角理解人类历史与未来,对构建中国以制度性基因为主线的农业政治经济学自主知识体系具有重要的理论价值与时代意义。
abstract_en: Throughout the historical progression of human civilization,agriculture has consistently framed the underlying logic of social evolution.Grain cultivation,along with the resulting population setlement,village formation,and state-building,demonstrates that the institutional genes of agriculture carry significant implications of political economy.Exploring and decoding the institutional genes embedded in Chinese agrarian culture can provide unique historical depth and theoretical resources for constructing an autonomous knowledge system of agricultural political economy.Their core connotations are manifested as mechanisms of institutional inertia and path dependence,centered on land property rights,structured through production organizations,and linked by cultural ethics.First,land is not only a factor of production but also a material carrier of power relations.From imperial ownership in ancient China to modern collective land ownership,the logic of land allocation profoundly influences social stratification and resource distribution mechanisms.Second,the seasonal,regional,and life-dependent nature of agricultural production dictates that organizational forms must integrate with natural rhythms and local knowledge.Grain cultivation and settled agriculture not only influence the evolutionary path of production organization but also serve as a controllable foundation for the formation of states.Third,the collectivistic culture,risk aversion awareness,and temporal cognitive framework derived from agrarian civilization underpin the cognitive beliefs shaping social order and behavioral choices,while continuously disciplining the decision-making logic of both individuals and groups.Through the framework of"agricultural institutional functions-vertical institutional architecture-horizontal multidimensional influences-knowledge system construction',this paper draws the following conclusion:First,agricultural institutional genes manifest as mechanisms of institutional inertia and path dependence,centered on land property rights,structured through production organizations,and linked by cultural ethics.Second,agrarian setlement pattern represent an"institutional innovation"developed by humanity to overcome energy acquisition botlenecks.While humans domesticated nature,nature in turn domesticated humans this mutual domestication triggered the classic"farmstead effect'.Third,the evidence provided by agricultural practices may offer the most compelling historical explanation for the origins of such concepts as time preferences,trust mechanisms,and gender roles.Fourth,China's agrarian cultural heritage possesses the potential to transform from historical relics into intellectual resources for addressing modernity crises,thereby contributing Chinese wisdom to the evolution of human civilization.Understanding human history and the future through an agricultural lens holds significant theoretical value.China's agricultural political economy will demonstrate core value in three aspects:in the historical dimension,it shaped East Asia's governance systems and economic models;in the realistic dimension,it drives symbiotic evolutionary development momentum;and in the future dimension,it willinject Eastern wisdom into the transformation of global governance.

title_en: The Excellent Traditional Agricultural Culture of China Empowering the Modernization of Agriculture and Rural Areas:Realistic Dilemmas,Internal Mechanisms,and Implementation Paths
authors_cn: 年猛 | 夏添 | 曾智鹏
authors_en_and_affiliations: NIAN Meng;XIA Tian;ZENG Zhipeng(Institute of Rural Development,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;Research Institute for the Economy of Westermn China,Southwestern University of Finance and Economics)

abstract_cn: 中华文明博大精深、源远流长,其中中华优秀传统农耕文化是其重要根基,在中华文明的形成与发展过程中发挥了基础性作用。中华优秀传统农耕文化根植于农业农村,其演进过程与农业发展阶段具有高度一致性,反映了不同生产力水平下农业生产关系的变化。尽管工业化与城镇化的冲击致使中华优秀传统农耕文化赓续面临主体断层与空间流失的困境,但五千多年来孕育的中华优秀传统农耕文化从未间断,生命力依然旺盛,并对中国主流价值观形成长期、稳定的影响。中华优秀传统农耕文化蕴含的德治观、重农观、民本观、田园观等内涵,在社会治理、激发民力、经济发展等方面仍具有独特的当代价值。中华优秀传统农耕文化通过推动农村产业发展、优化乡村治理、促进物质文明与精神文明协调发展,为实现农业农村现代化提供内在驱动力。其实现路径在于推动保护与开发、坚守文化本源与创新发展、市场与政府的协同推进。赓续中华优秀传统农耕文化、充分挖掘其当代价值,不仅能够为中国农业农村现代化建设提供传统智慧,也能够充分符合中国国情、彰显中国特色。
abstract_en: Chinese civilization,rooted in farming traditions,is deeply intertwined with the evolution of agricultural development.Excellent traditional farming culture,as the foundation of Chinese civilization,has shaped production modes,social structures,and value systems for thousands of years.However,industrialization and urbanization have brought challenges such as generational discontinuities and spatial erosion,threatening its continuation.Against this backdrop,this paper examines how traditional farming culture can be revitalized and integrated into China's agricultural and rural modermization.This paper adopts a theoretical framework linking"cultural continuation-intermal mechanism-implementation path'.Drawing upon Marx's theory of culture and the contemporary understanding of cultural inheritance,this paper integrates historical analysis of China's agricultural development stages with evidence from demographic changes,land use evolution,and rural social transformations.Methodologically,it combines historical institutional analysis with literature review and comparative policy analysis,supported by secondary statistical sources and authoritative policy documents.The findings of this paper indicate that excellent traditional farming culture has inherent mechanisms that align with the modernization of agriculture and rural areas.First,it empowers rural industrial development by fostering cultural industries,branding agricultural products,and creating tourism and creative sectors.Second,it contributes to effective rural govermance through moral cultivation,mutual assistance,and community-based regulation,thereby enhancing autonomy and cohesion.Third,it strengthens ecological sustainability by promoting harmonious human-nature relationships,reflected in farming techniques such as cyclical land use and eco-agriculture.Finally,it supports coordinated development of material and spiritual civilization,embodying values such as diligence,collectivism,and family ethics that remain vital in rural modermization.The policy implications ofthis paper are as follows.The government should cultivate multiple actors in cultural transmission,reconstruct and preserve rural cultural spaces as carriers of heritage,and innovate funding mechanisms to mobilize public,financial,and social capital.Furthermore,combining traditional farming wisdom with modern technology and industrial practices can enhance adaptability and resilience,ensuring that cultural heritage serves as a living resource in modermization.This paper contributes to existing literature in three aspects.First,it bridges the gap between descriptive studies of farming culture and applied research on modernization,offering a systematic analytical framework.Second,it broadens the perspective by linking farming culture with industrial development,govemance,ecology,and social trust,enriching cross-disciplinary discussions.Third,it proposes actionable policy pathways that embed Chinese characteristics into agricultural and rural modermization,providing theoretical support and practical guidance for advancing Chinese modernization.

title_cn: 农村现代化发展滞后性的表征与原因探析
title_en: An Analysis on the Manifestations and Causes of the Lag of Rural Modernization Development
authors_en_and_affiliations: GUO Xibao(School of Economics and Management,Guangxi Normal University)
institutions_cn: 广西师范大学经济管理学院
index_title: 农村现代化发展滞后性的表征与原因探析
abstract_cn: 农村现代化发展滞后于农业现代化和城镇化是经济发展过程中的一个必经阶段。本文重点考察了农村现代化发展滞后性的表征和原因。首先,阐释农村现代化的核心意涵与主要衡量指标。农村现代化的核心意涵是农村居民生活水平和生活质量的现代化,农民收入水平是其主要衡量指标。其次,详细考察农村现代化发展滞后于农业现代化和城镇化的表征与原因。农村现代化发展滞后于农业现代化的主要表征是农民收入水平显著低于农业劳动生产率,其根源在于国家发展政策优先顺序的变化和农业产业链、价值链的延长。农村现代化发展滞后于城镇化的主要表征是农民收入水平显著低于城市居民收入水平,其主要根源在于农业劳动力转移的异质性、城乡二元户籍制度改革滞后和市场机制下要素流动的累积性因果循环。本文分析发现:农村现代化与农业现代化和城镇化的发展差距呈现先上升后下降的趋势,这种趋势不是中国特有的现象,而是世界各国经济发展过程中的共同规律。本文的政策含义是,要把农民增收作为推进农村现代化的主要抓手。
abstract_en: For decades,China's rural modermization has lagged behind agricultural modernization and even further behind urbanization,yet few have conducted scholarly analysis on this phenomenon.This paper attempts to demonstrate that this phenomenon is an inevitable stage in the process of economic development and is not permanent.When industrialization and urbanization reach a more advanced stage,the pace of rural modernization will accelerate,and the gap between rural modernization and agricultural modermnization,as well as urbanization,will gradually narrow and eventually reach a balanced state among the three.Describing the lag in China's rural modermnization relative to agricultural modemization and urbanization requires frst identifying appropriate indicators to benchmark their respective development levels.This paper adopts the modemization of rural residents living standards and quality of life as the core indicators of rural modermization,with per capita disposable income of rural residents used as its proxy indicator.Agricultural labor productivity(represented by output value per agricultural labor)is used as the measure for agricultural modernization,while the disposable income of urban residents is used as the indicator for urbanization development level.Comparative analyses of these indicators reveal that over the past four decades,China's rural modemization has consistently lagged behind agricultural modernization and urbanization,but the gap shows a trend of first expanding and then narrowing.The inverted U-shaped relationship between rural and agricultural modermization is caused by changes in the prioritization of national development policies and the extension of the agricultural industrial and value chains.The inverted U-shaped relationship between rural modermization and urbanization is primarily driven by the transformation of the urban-rural dual structure.The conclusions are as follows:first,the lag of rural modermization behind agricultural modernization and urbanization is an objective law,observed not only in China but also in developed countries.Second,the imbalance among rural modermization,agricultural modernization,and urbanization is not permanent.As industrialization,urbanization,and agricultural modernization advance to higher stages,the process of rural modernization begins to accelerate,and the development between agriculture and rural areas,as well as between urban and rural areas,gradually tends toward balance and coordination.Third,the reasons for the lag of rural modernization behind agricultural modemization are fundamentally different from those behind urbanization.The policy implications of this paper are that the fundamental way to address the lag in rural modernization is to increase farmers'income level.Moreover,extending govermment public services to rural areas are also important ways to narrow the gap between rural modernization and agricultural modernization and urbanization.The contributions are as follows.First,it provides a scholarly analysis on the reasons and mechanisms behind the lag of rural modernization,demonstrating that this lag is a regular phenomenon in the process of economic development.Second,it reveals that the relationship among rural modemization,agricultural modernization,and urbanization follows an inverted U-shaped pattem that first expands and then narrows.Third,it clarifies the relationship between the goals and means ofrural modermnization,identifying the modernization of farmers'living standards and quality of life as the core indicators for measuring rural modernization,and the increase of farmers income as the key lever for advancing rural modernization.

title_cn: 农村集体经营性建设用地入市对地方政府土地出让行为的影响
title_en: The Impacts of Rural Collective Operating Construction Land Marketization on Local Government Land Leasing Behavior
authors_cn: 王志锋 | 徐晓明 | 李万新 | 葛雪凝
authors_en_and_affiliations: WANG Zhifeng;XU Xiaoming;LI Wanxin;GE Xuening(School of Management Science and Engineering,Central University of Finance and Economics;Postal Savings Bank of China Co.,Ltd.;School of Energy and Environment,City University of Hong Kong,China;Institute of Statistical Science,National Bureau of Statistics of China)

abstract_cn: 农村集体经营性建设用地入市,有助于完善农村土地权能、赋予农民更充分的财产权益,但其试点政策成效受到地方政府行为的影响。本文从地方政府行为的视角,研究2015年实施农村集体经营性建设用地入市试点政策的背景下地方政府土地出让行为的变化及其原因。在理论分析方面,本文揭示了财政可持续性目标诉求下地方政府土地出让行为变化的驱动机制,为理解农村集体经营性建设用地入市试点政策实施对地方政府土地出让行为的实际影响提供逻辑框架。在实证分析方面,本文运用PSM-DID方法的研究发现:农村集体经营性建设用地入市打破了地方政府单一供地主体地位,对其财政收入带来负面冲击。为保证土地财政收入的稳定性,试点地区政府将减少供地面积、抬升土地出让单价。并且,这一现象对于商服用地、住宅用地和高等级地块的出让以及财政压力较大地区体现得更加明显。此外,本文还讨论了地方政府土地出让行为变化对农民财产权益相关改革成效的影响,建议在深化土地改革过程中考虑地方政府的应对措施以及地区差异,在保障农民财产权益与稳定地方政府财源之间做好平衡,实现中央政策目标与实效的统一,加快城乡土地市场一体化进程。
abstract_en: To establish a unified urban-rural construction land market,safeguard farmers'land rights,and increase their property income,and to thoroughly implement the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committe regarding land reform,China launched the three rural land system reform pilots in 2015.Rural collective operating construction land marketization is an important component of this reform.Rural collective operating construction land marketization empowers farmers to have more adequate property rights,breaks local governments'monopoly as the sole supplier of land,restricts the revenue local govermments obtain from land transfers,and changes the original revenue-sharing mechanism between the govermment and rural collectives.Although there are extensive studies discussing the land transfer behaviors local govermments may adopt to maximize their interests during the land transfer process,the discussion on local governments'land transfer behaviors after the diversification of land suppliers is insufficient.From the perspective of local govermment behavior,this paper investigates the changes in local govermments'strategic land supply behaviors and their underlying logic under the implementation of the pilot policy in 2015.Theoretically,this paper reveals the transmission mechanism driving changes in local govermments'land supply behavior under the goal of fiscal sustainability,providing a logical framework for understanding the impact of the pilot policy on local govermments.Empirically,using the PSM-DID method,this paper finds that rural collective operating construction land marketization may have a negative impact on local governments'fiscal revenue.To ensure the stability of land fiscal revenue,the pilot area govemment will reduce the land supply area and raise the land unit price.This effect is more pronounced for commercial and residential land,higher-grade land,and regions undergreaterfiscal pressure.Furthermore,this paper discusses the impact of the behavior of local govermments on the reform achievements related to farmers'property rights and proposes corresponding countermeasures.Future efforts to deepen land reform must acknowledge adaptive responses and heterogeneity of local govermments,strike a balance between safeguarding farmers'property rights and stabilizing local govermment fiscal revenue,unify policy objectives with practical outcomes,and advance the integration of urban and rural landmarkets.

index_title: 农地规模经营利益分配秩序的生成逻辑研究——基于乡土伦理视角的考察
abstract_cn: 农地规模经营作为中国农业现代化的重要实践方式之一,其背后蕴藏的利益分配秩序及其生成逻辑值得关注。本文基于乡土伦理视角,以豫东南上蔡县的农地规模经营实践为例,探讨经营大户与小农户之间利益分配秩序的生成逻辑。研究发现:农地规模经营中的地利分配,不仅表现为地租的分配,还隐含着多元的、非正式的利益分配实践形式,形成了一种具有风险共担与收益共享双重目标指向的地利共享秩序。在日常生活中,大户与小农户基于人情关系的“帮忙”种地、信任建立下的地租弹性化调整以及声誉积累中的社会责任担当等因素,共同促成了地利共享秩序的生成,这构成了利益分配秩序生成的隐性路径。在防偷盗、哄抢的关键事件互动中,大户与小农户对生存伦理话语的建构、情理兼顾的边界把控以及“拟亲式”互动情景的搭建,使得地利共享秩序的规则边界与约束力进一步明晰,这构成了利益分配秩序形成的显化路径。在两条实践路径的结合下,地利共享秩序被大户与小农户内化于心,并最终成为农地流转市场交易秩序的重要构成部分,促使二者形成相对均衡的利益关系格局,进而为中国的农业转型创造了更大的发展弹性与调适空间。这对于反思中国农业转型的经济伦理逻辑以及伦理基础具有启示意义。
abstract_en: Large-scale farmland management,as an important practice of China's agricultural modernization,presents a generative logic of benefit-distribution order whose underlying mechanisms merit rigorous scholarly interrogation.From the perspective of vermacular ethics,this paper takes the practice of large-scale farmland management in Shangcai County in southeastem Henan as an example to discuss the generation logic of the benefit-distribution order between large-scale agricultural operators and smallholders.The findings reveal that the distribution of land benefits in large-scale farmland management encompasses not only the formal allocation of land rent but also a pluralistic set of informal benefit-sharing practices.Together,these arrangements constitute an order that simultaneously pursues risk sharing and benefit sharing.In daily life,reciprocal"help"farming between large-scale operators and smallholders,trust-based flexibility in land-rent adjustment,and reputation-driven social responsibility collectively engender an order of land access and benefit sharing.This constellation of practices constitutes the tacit pathway through which the distribution order emerges.In the pivotal interactions against theft and looting,large-scale operators and smallholders co-construct a discourse of subsistence ethics,delicately balance the boundaries between sentiment and rationality,and establish quasi-kin interactive scenarios.These practices render the normative boundaries and binding force of the land-benefit-sharing order increasingly explicit,thus constituting the manifest pathway through which the benefit-distribution order is formed.Under the combination of the two practical paths,the order of benefit distribution of land is intermalized by large-scale operators and smallholders,and eventually becomes an important part of the transaction order of the rural land circulation market,which promotes the formation of a relatively balanced interest relationship pattern between the two parties,and then creates greater flexibility and adjustment space for China's agricultural transformation.This paper has enlightening significance for reflecting on the economic and ethical logic and the ethical foundation of China's agricultural transformation.

title_cn: 流转契约属性对新型林业经营主体经营规模变化的影响
title_en: Impact of Transfer Contractual Attributes on Operational Scale Changes of New Forestry Management Entities
authors_cn: 朱臻 | 王立成 | 谢芳婷 | 刘璨 | 沈月琴
authors_en_and_affiliations: ZHU Zhen;WANG Licheng;XIE Fangting;LIU Can;SHEN Yueqin(Rural Revitalization Academy ofZhejiang Province,Zhejiang Agricultural and Forestry University;School of Economics and Management,Zhejiang Agricultural and Forestry University;School of Economics and Management,Nanjing Forestry University;School of Economics and Management,Beijing University of Agriculture)
institutions_cn: 浙江农林大学浙江省乡村振兴研究院 | 浙江农林大学经济管理学院 | 南京林业大学经济管理学院 | 北京农学院经济管理学院
index_title: 流转契约属性对新型林业经营主体经营规模变化的影响
abstract_cn: 培育新型林业经营主体,实现集体林规模经营,是深化集体林权制度改革的重要政策措施之一,但在实践中,出现部分新型林业经营主体的林地经营规模缩小、林业适度规模经营尚未达到预期政策效果的现象。本文基于不完全契约与博弈理论,利用国家林业和草原局发展研究中心2016年、2018年、2020年对8个省份269个新型林业经营主体的抽样跟踪调查得到的平衡面板数据,分析流转契约属性对新型林业经营主体经营规模变化的作用机制,探讨履约制度环境在其中发挥的调节作用,并采用双向固定效应模型的最小二乘虚拟变量估计方法进行实证检验。本文的研究结果显示:第一,书面契约、长期契约、由村“两委”参与签订的契约有助于扩大新型林业经营主体的经营规模,这种影响在不同经营目标、主体类型以及地区之间呈现明显的异质性特征。第二,履约制度环境在流转契约属性对新型林业经营主体经营规模变化的影响中发挥调节作用,良好的履约制度环境有助于流转契约属性促进新型林业经营主体扩大经营规模。鉴于此,本文提出如下政策启示:进一步规范经营权流转契约,保障新型林业经营主体的长期流转经营权;充分发挥村“两委”组织在林权流转行为与调解纠纷中的引导与协调作用,为新型林业经营主体经营管理创造良好制度环境;应结合国有与集体林权属性、林业分类经营目标和不同地区自然条件制定差异化林业适度规模经营支持政策。
abstract_en: Cultivating new forestry management entities to achieve large-scale management is one of important policy options for deepening China's Collective Forest Tenure Reform;however,empirical evidence reveals that the management scale of new forestry management entities decreased which means the large-scale management has not achieved the expected goals of policies.Based on incomplete contract theory and game theory,this paper utilizes balanced panel data from 269 new forestry management entities across eight provinces in 2016,2018,and 2020,collected by the Development Research Center of the National Forestry and Grassland Administration,to analyze the mechanism through which transfer contractual attributes affect changes in the management scale of these entities,and examines the moderating role of contract implementation institutional environment.Empirical analysis was conducted using the least squares dummy variable estimation technique within a two-way fixed effects model.The findings of this paper are as follows.(1)Written contracts,long-term contracts,and those involving village"two committees"help expand the management scale of new forestry management entities.(2)The contract implementation institutional environment plays a moderating role in the impact of transfer contractual attributes on changes in the management scale.A sound contract implementation institutional environment enhances the positive effect of contract attributes on scaling up operations.(3)The influence of contractual attributes on management scale exhibits heterogeneity across management objectives,regions,and typesofentities.This paper proposes three policy implications.(1)Establish standardized forest tenure transfer contracts to secure long-term management rights.(2)Enhance the role of village two committees"in guiding and coordinating transfers to improve the operational environment.(3)Implement tailored policies for promoting appropriately scaled forestry management under specific conditions.The marginal contributions of this paper are as follows.(1)It constructs a theoretical framework connecting transfer contractual attributes to management scale,explaining the policy-practice gap.(2)Using national tracking survey data,it examines how these attributes dynamically affect management scale.Through econometric models,the study tests the moderating role of the contract implementation environment,analyzes heterogeneity across management objectives,regions,and entities,and proposes targeted policy measures.

title_cn: 传统资源型农业“渐进式创新”的多重制度逻辑——以天然橡胶产业为例
title_en: The Multiple Institutional Logics of Incremental Innovation in Traditional Resource-Based Agriculture:A Case Study of the Natural Rubber Industry
authors_en_and_affiliations: LI Hanbing;LI Gang(Institute of Industrial Economics,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences)
institutions_cn: 中国社会科学院工业经济研究所
index_title: 传统资源型农业“渐进式创新”的多重制度逻辑——以天然橡胶产业为例
abstract_cn: 本文基于制度逻辑与资源编排的理论整合视角,以中国天然橡胶产业为典型案例,构建“多重制度逻辑下的资源编排”分析框架,探讨传统资源型农业在制度和技术上实现“渐进式创新”的内在机制。研究发现,传统资源型农业的“渐进式创新”是由国家逻辑、市场逻辑与社群逻辑协同驱动的复杂过程。国家逻辑通过战略需求识别、政策工具创新和资源定向配置等方式形成制度楔子效应,奠定创新发展的结构性基础;市场逻辑依托价格信号传导机制,构建要素重组与知识重构的反馈回路,激发创新活力;社群逻辑则凭借关系网络的嵌入,在制度变迁中发挥社会化调适功能,有效缓冲制度摩擦。研究表明,天然橡胶产业在多重制度逻辑交织的背景下,通过动态资源编排过程,突破地理限制约束,完成了从生产效率提升到产业链安全保障的跨越,并在国际标准制定中重塑了技术话语权。本文揭示,制度环境与资源行动的动态适配是传统资源型农业“渐进式创新”的核心机制,国家、市场与社群三重逻辑的协同演化,能够使产业现有基础得到有效利用,实现传统产业基础能力的渐进提升与价值跃迁,为理解传统资源型农业转型提供了新的理论视角。
abstract_en: As a fundamental sector of the national economy,traditional resource-based agriculture is not stagnant;rather,it undergoes proactive,iterative transformation alongside institutional change.This transformation is supported by comprehensive upgrades in institutions and industrial infrastructure,exhibiting a characteristic"spiral'progression.From an integrated theoretical perspective of institutional logics and resource orchestration,this paper uses China's natural rubber industry as a typical case and constructs an analytical framework of"resource orchestration under multiple institutional logics"to explore the intrinsic mechanisms behind"incremental innovation"in traditional resource-based agriculture at both institutional and technological levels.The paper finds that"incremental innovation"in traditional resource-based agriculture is driven by a complex interplay of state,market,and community logics.State logic creates an"institutional wedge effect'through strategic demand identification,policy instrument innovation,and targeted resource allocation,laying the structural foundation for innovation.Market logic leverages price signals to establish feedback loops for factor recombination and knowledge restructuring,thereby stimulating innovative vitality.Community logic,embedded in relational networks,serves a socialization and adaptation function during institutional transition,effectively mitigating institutional friction.This paper demonstrates that in the context of multiple coexisting logics,the natural rubber industry has overcome geographical constraints through dynamic resource orchestration,achieving a transition from productivity enhancement to industrial chain security,and reshaping technological discourse in intemational standard-setting.Furthermore,this paper reveals that the dynamic alignment between institutional environment and resource action constitutes the core mechanism of incremental innovation in traditional resource-based agriculture.The co-evolution of state,market,and community logics effectively leverages existing industrial foundations to faciltate incremental capability upgrading and value leapfrogging.The marginal contributions of this paper are threefold.First,it identifies the micro-level mechanism whereby organizations strategically orchestrate resources to reconcile institutional tensions,overcome structural constraints,and propel incremental innovation within traditional resource-based industries operating under multiple institutional logics.Second,through an examination of the long-term evolution of China's state-owned natural rubber industry,this paper theorizes the process mechanism of dynamic mutual construction and co-evolution among multiple institutional logics,clarifying how technological accumulation and capability transition are achieved under pervasive state influence and sustained capital investment.Third,it extends theoretical frameworks about multi-logic interactions,industrial resilience,and incremental innovation,while offering micro-level insights into how state-local interactions foster the gradual development and critical breakthroughs in strategic,long-cycle industries,thereby underpinning national industrialization and structural upgrading.

title_cn: 外卖配送新业态发展促进消费的双重效应:总量增进与城乡分化
title_en: The Dual Effects of New Food Delivery Formats on Promoting Consumption:Total Increase and Urban-Rural Divide
authors_en_and_affiliations: GAO Ziming;HU Shancheng(School of Business Administration,Northeastern University;School of Business,Ningbo University)
institutions_cn: 东北大学工商管理学院 | 宁波大学商学院
index_title: 外卖配送新业态发展促进消费的双重效应:总量增进与城乡分化
abstract_cn: 当前,中国的经济运行面临消费不足的挑战,以外卖配送为代表的新业态的兴起为扩大内需提供了新动能。本文在理论上分析了外卖配送新业态发展影响消费的作用机理,并结合外卖配送站点设立信息和中国家庭收入调查数据(CHIP)进行定量评估。实证结果表明,城市外卖配送站点累计设立数量每增加100个,家庭年总消费平均增加约0.447万元,城镇居民家庭比农村居民家庭的平均提升幅度大。消费总量增进效应主要源于外卖配送新业态发展增加了家庭收入,优化了消费环境,能够与外卖配送相关的配套体系发挥协同作用。城乡消费分化效应则源于城乡地区外卖配送新业态发展不平衡及城乡家庭经济状况不同。本文研究结论为充分发挥外卖配送等新业态在扩大内需、改善居民福利等方面的作用提供了重要支撑,并为优化数字经济政策以促进城乡融合提供了有益参考。
abstract_en: China's current economic performance is challenged by insufficient consumer demand,while the emergence of new business models such as online food delivery has provided new driving forces for expanding domestic demand.This study theoretically examines the mechanism through which the development of the food delivery industry influences household consumption and provides a quantitative assessment using data on the establishment of delivery stations combined with microdata from the China Household Income Project(CHIP).Empirical results indicate that for every additional 100 food delivery stations established at the city level,average household consumption increases by approximately CNY 44,470.The boost is more pronounced in urban households compared to rural ones.The increase in aggregate consumption stems from three channels:the growth of the food delivery sector raises household incomes,improves the consumption environment,and leverages synergies from supporting logistical and digital infrastructure.The urban-rural disparity in consumption effects arises from the imbalanced development of delivery services across regions and different baseline income levels between urban and rural households.These findings underscore the potential of new business formats like food delivery in stimulating domestic demand and enhancing household welfare.Additionally,they offer insights into refining digital economy policies to promote urban-rural integration.This study analyzes the impact of food delivery services on household consumption from both aggregate and distributional perspectives,providing comprehensive empirical evidence that addresses gaps in existing literature.Its marginal contributions are threefold.First,it fills a void in research on how the growth of the food delivery industry affects consumption in both urban and rural settings.While prior studies have focused on the indirect effects of e-commerce,digital finance,or the sharing economy on consumption,or examined the direct economic impacts of delivery platforms on employment and income,this study systematically investigates both direct and indirect consumption effects,pathways of influence,and urban-rural heterogeneity,thereby broadening the scope of research on new business models in the context of consumption.Second,this study constructs a theoretical framework integrating labor markets,goods markets,and institutional development.It elucidates the mechanisms through which food delivery promotes consumptionincome enhancement,environmental optimization,and systemic synergy,while exploring divergence effects between urban and rural areas resulting from disparities in income and sector development.It offers a more comprehensive understanding of how new business formats affect consumption and shape regional inequality.Third,this study provides robust empirical evidence based on multi-level matched data.Due to the novelty of platform-based delivery services,prior research has been constrained by data availability.This study employs web-crawled data on delivery stations,matched with household survey and socioeconomic statistics at different levels,to construct an integrated dataset for analysis.The empirical findings hold significant implications for improving policy design for supporting urban-rural integration and balanced regional development.

title_cn: 政务微信公共服务水平对县域经济发展的影响
title_en: The Impact of Government WeChat Public Service Level on the Development of the County Economy
authors_cn: 熊子怡 | 魏敏 | 张科
authors_en_and_affiliations: XIONG Ziyi;WEI Min;ZHANG Ke(School of Management,Xiamen University;School ofTourism,Nanchang University)
institutions_cn: 厦门大学管理学院 | 南昌大学旅游学院
index_title: 政务微信公共服务水平对县域经济发展的影响
abstract_cn: 政务微信公共服务作为中国数字治理的关键实践,已经成为加快转变政府职能和推进治理能力现代化的重要抓手。本文基于2009-2021年中国县域统计数据和夜间灯光数据,重点考察政务微信公共服务对县域经济发展的影响及其内在机理。研究发现:政务微信公共服务水平的提高能够显著促进县域经济发展,该结论经过内生性问题处理和一系列稳健性检验后仍然成立;机制分析表明,政务微信公共服务水平的提高不仅可以降低制度性交易成本,激发企业家创业精神,还可以通过降低政策不确定性进而提升企业投资活力,促进县域经济发展;异质性分析发现,政务微信公共服务水平的提高对县域经济发展的促进作用在金融资源要素较丰富和市场潜力较大的地区更为显著。本研究不仅丰富了有关数字治理内涵和县域经济影响因素方面的成果,也为健全基层政府治理体系和促进县域经济高质量发展提供了理论和决策参考依据。
abstract_en: As an important component of digital government construction,government WeChat public services has become an important tool for optimizing government functions and advancing the modernization of governance capacity.However,existing literature has not fully discussed the causal relationship between government WeChat public services,a digital govermance solution with Chinese characteristics,and the county economy.Examining this issue holds important theoretical and practical significance for advancing urban-rural integration and promoting regional coordinated development in the new era.Based on county-level statistical data and nightime light data from 2009 to 2021,this paper examines the impact of government WeChat public services on the development of the county economy and its underlying mechanisms.The findings of this paper are as follows.First,the improvement of govermment WeChat public service level significantly promotes local economic development,and the conclusion is established through robustness tests.Second,the mechanism examination reveals that the improvement of government WeChat public service level reduces institutional transaction costs,thereby stimulating entrepreneurial activity.Additionally,it alleviates policy uncertainty and enhances investment levels,thereby promoting the development of the county economy.Third,heterogeneity analysis indicates that the positive effect of the improvement of govermment WeChat public service level on the development of the county economy is more significant in regions with richer financial resources and greater market potential.This study not only enriches existing literature on digital governance and the influencing factors of the development of the county economy,but also provides important theoretical insights and decision-making references for promoting high-quality development of the county economy through the improvement of grassroots government governance systems.The marginal contributions of this paper are as follows.First,this paper is the first to apply rigorous economic analysis to systematically examine the economic impacts of government WeChat public services,a distinctive digital governance instrument in China.Second,from the perspectives of entrepreneurship and investment,this paper reveals the underlying mechanisms and measurable impacts of government WeChat public services on the development of the county economy.It not only advances existing literature on digital governance in China,but also underscores the critical role of platforms such as government WeChat in promoting economic growth.Third,this paper provides novel evidence supporting the theory that a service-oriented government can foster economic growth from a unique perspective,while offering valuable policy implications for strengthening long-term grassroots governance through digital transformation.

title_en: Promoting Agricultural Industrial Revitalization Through New Industrialization and New Urbanization:A Perspective of the Relationship Between People and Land

index_title: 以新型工业化和新型城镇化推进农业产业振兴——基于人地关系的视角
abstract_cn: 党的二十届三中全会在完善城乡融合发展体制机制中明确要求统筹新型工业化、新型城镇化和乡村全面振兴。考虑到产业振兴在乡村全面振兴中的首要地位和农业在乡村产业中的核心地位,本文从理论和实践层面探究当前推进农业产业振兴面临的主要障碍,并构建基于优化城乡产业、人口和土地空间配置的城乡融合发展机制。本文认为,当前农业产业振兴面临的主要困境是人多地少的人地矛盾,即大量农业转移人口不能彻底摆脱与农村土地的依附关系,造成户均土地经营规模过于狭小,农业劳动生产率难以提高。这一人地矛盾需要通过统筹推进新型工业化、新型城镇化和乡村全面振兴来破解,以农业生产力发展释放农业剩余劳动力,以新增就业机会推进职业转变,以市民化推进身份转变;而充分发挥新型工业化和新型城镇化对乡村产业振兴的推动作用,则需要同步推进城乡土地同权化和配置市场化改革,消除土地要素在城乡之间自由流动、平等交换的障碍,为优化城乡产业、人口和土地空间配置创造条件。本文的研究为推进农业产业振兴、解决城乡区域发展不平衡问题以及促进城乡共同繁荣发展提供了新的启示。
abstract_en: Building on the Third Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China(CPC),which called for the coordinated advancement of new industrialization,new urbanization,and comprehensive rural revitalization to promote integrated urban-rural development,the Fourth Plenary Session further emphasized making solid progress in advancing comprehensive rural revitalization.Industrial revitalization,particularly agricultural industrial revitalization,is the top priority of rural revitalization.It not only drives farmers’income growth and enhances rural economic vitality but also lays a solid foundation for comprehensive revitalization by promoting employment,optimizing industrial structures,and improving infrastructure.This paper argues that the excessively small per-household land operation scale is the core constraint on agricultural industrial revitalization in China.At the root of this issue lies the imbalance in the human-land relationship:a significant portion of surplus rural labor remains attached to farmland and cannot fully transition to non-agricultural sectors,resulting in persistently low agricultural labor productivity.Given the limited potential for increasing arable land supply,enhancing agricultural productivity hinges on the orderly transfer and effective resettlement of agricultural labor.To address this challenge,a systemic approach is required—one that promotes integrated urban-rural development by coordinating new industrialization,new urbanization,and rural revitalization.This includes:(1)enhance agricultural productivity to release surplus rural labor;(2)leverage synergies across the three strategies to expand non-agricultural employment opportunities and facilitate structural transformation in employment;and(3)advance the urbanization of rural migrants to enable identity conversion and expand average land operation scale,thereby improving agricultural labor productivity.Achieving these goals hinges on improving the institutional framework for integrated urban-rural development.This requires establishing mechanisms for the equal exchange and two-way flow of production factors between urban and rural areas,and across sectors.At present,unequal land property rights between urban and rural areas and the administrative allocation of land resources remain prominent issue in China,restricting the free flow of production factors.Thus,promoting land system reform centered on the equalization of urban and rural land rights and the market-based allocation of land resources is essential to easing the human-land contradiction in agriculture.Specifically,it is necessary to establish a unified urban-rural construction land market,boost guarantee ability of land element for high-quality development of regions with competitive strengths,and advance the voluntary and compensated withdrawal of farmers’land rights.This study provides new insights for advancing agricultural industrial revitalization and promoting integrated urban–rural prosperity and development.

title_cn: 粮食跨周期宏观调控:内涵特征、实现逻辑及政策设计
title_en: Connotative Characteristics,Implementation Logic and Policy Design of Cross-Cyclical Macro Regulation of Grain
authors_en_and_affiliations: YANG Xin;DONG Ying(Rural Development Institute,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences;College of Economics and Management,South China Agricultural University)
institutions_cn: 中国社会科学院农村发展研究所 | 华南农业大学经济管理学院、广东省哲学社科重点实验室-农业农村政策与改革创新实验室
index_title: 粮食跨周期宏观调控:内涵特征、实现逻辑及政策设计
abstract_cn: 将藏粮于地、藏粮于技战略具体化为粮食跨周期宏观调控体系,有利于实现粮食安全多元化治理目标。在区分粮食安全常态阶段与应急阶段的基础上,粮食跨周期宏观调控以供需风险防范的前瞻性、生产效益提升的长期性、产能结构变化的动态性为内涵特征。其实现逻辑在于,通过跨越粮食经济周期转变农业技术进步方向和产出贡献结构,实现粮食产能增长下增产潜力与实际产量结构的弹性调整。在常态阶段,粮食综合生产能力提高主要来自粮食增产潜力扩大,即通过资源环境型农业技术驱动农业全要素生产率增长,侧重防范粮食阶段性过剩和改善粮食生产收益;在应急阶段,粮食综合生产能力提高主要来自粮食增产潜力向实际产量的转化。在粮食供给风险较小时,通过从资源环境型向高产高效型农业技术进步方向的转变实现粮食增产;在粮食供给风险加剧时,则需进一步加大投入可变要素来确保粮食快速增产。围绕粮食跨周期宏观调控的可行性与有效性,需构建主要由粮食规模经营主体组成的粮食产能储备库,以及与之配套的粮食安全状态信号机制和粮食产能结构调整激励机制,并通过制度结构优化与财政支出管控降低实施成本。
abstract_en: The macro regulation system of grain is a stabilizer for preventing and defusing grain security risks.With the advancement of building up China’s strength in agriculture,the governance objectives of food security are becoming increasingly complex and multifaceted.However,the existing macro regulation system for grain struggles to accommodate these goals.Concretizing the strategy of Increasing Grain Capacity through Soil Conservation and Technology into a cross-cyclical macro control system of grain is conducive to achieving diversified governance objectives in food security.The thought of cross-cyclical macro regulation of grain,which takes both short-term and long-term goals into account,has been formed in existing literature.However,cross-cyclical macro regulation of grain has not yet been formally defined,and its implementation logic and policy design still require further research.This paper defines cross-cyclical macro regulation of grain as involving forward-looking risk prevention in terms of supply and demand,the long-term improvement in production efficiency,and the dynamic adjustment of production capacity based on the distinction between the normal and emergency phases of food security.The core logic involves shifting agricultural technology and output across cycles to balance potential and actual production.During normal periods,grain production capacity grows through accumulated potential,driven by technological progress that is oriented towards resources and the environment to drive total factor productivity growth,while preventing food overproduction and enhancing income.During emergency periods,comprehensive grain production capacity growth comes from actual production growth.Specifically,under mild grain supply risks,technology shifts towards high yield and efficiency.While under severe grain supply risks,the rapid growth of output is ensured by heavy input of variable factors.To ensure the feasibility and effectiveness of cross-cyclical macro regulation of grain,a grain production capacity reserve system led by large-scale grain producers should be established,along with food security signaling mechanisms and capacity structure adjustment incentives.And the implementation costs can be reduced through institutional structural optimization and fiscal expenditure control.The contributions of this study are as follows.Firstly,it concretizes the strategy of Increasing Grain Capacity through Soil Conservation and Technology into a practical cross-cyclical macro regulation system of grain.Secondly,it clarifies the transition from potential production to actual production as grain production capacity grows,and theorizes differentiated cross-cyclical macro regulation of grain linked to the degree of grain supply risk.Thirdly,it designs a policy framework around large-scale grain producers with controlling implementation costs by optimizing the institutional structure of macro regulation of grain and title_cn: 高标准农田建设政策实施对粮食生产气候韧性的影响
title_en: The Impact of the Policy of High-Standard Farmland Construction on the Climate Resilience of Grain Production
authors_cn: 彭长生 | 刘阳 | 钟钰
authors_en_and_affiliations: PENG Changsheng;LIU Yang;ZHONG Yu(School of Economics and Management,Anqing Normal University;Institute of Agricultural Economics and Development,Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences)
institutions_cn: 安庆师范大学经济与管理学院 | 中国农业科学院农业经济与发展研究所
index_title: 高标准农田建设政策实施对粮食生产气候韧性的影响
abstract_cn: 本文选取中国2005-2017年省级面板数据,通过构建SBM-DEA模型测度粮食生产气候韧性,并利用连续DID模型实证分析高标准农田建设政策实施对粮食生产气候韧性的影响机制和效应。研究结果显示,高标准农田建设政策实施对粮食生产气候韧性具有显著的正向促进作用,并且,经过一系列稳健性检验后,该结果依然稳健。异质性分析发现,在“胡焕庸线”东南部和中国湿润半湿润地区,高标准农田建设政策实施对粮食生产气候韧性产生了显著的正向影响。机制分析发现,高标准农田建设政策实施对粮食生产气候韧性的提升,主要是通过提高农业机械化作业效率、增加有效灌溉比例和扩大土地经营规模来实现的。进一步分析发现,高标准农田建设政策实施显著提升了粮食生产面对气候冲击的复原力。本文研究结果表明,当前高标准农田建设政策实施在降低粮食生产系统气候风险方面具有整体有效性和区域异质性,未来需进一步从政策力度、区域差异、补贴配套和政策协同等多个维度优化高标准农田建设政策的实施路径。
abstract_en: In recent years,the frequent occurrence of extreme climates has threatened global food security.As one of the global climate-sensitive regions,China is particularly severely affected,so enhancing the climate adaptability of grain production is an urgent priority.Climate resilience has become a key indicator for evaluating climate change response strategies worldwide.The climate resilience of food production(CRFP)refers to the ability of the grain production system to adapt,recover,and achieve sustainable development when responding to the adverse impacts of climate change.The construction of high-standard farmland is a key policy to improve land quality and capacity for disaster prevention and mitigation,but the impact and mechanisms of this policy on the climate resilience of grain production remain unclear.This study uses the China’s provincial panel data from 2005 to 2017,constructs an SBM-DEA model to measure the CRFP,and uses a continuous DID model to empirically analyze the impact and mechanism of the policy of the high-standard basic farmland construction on the CRFP.The results of the study demonstrate that the policy of high-standard farmland construction exerts a significantly positive promotional effect on the climate resilience of grain production.Moreover,this result remains robust following a series of robustness tests.Heterogeneity analysis reveals that in the southeastern region of the“Hu’s Line”as well as in the humid and semi-humid regions of China,the policy of high-standard farmland construction imposes a significantly positive impact on the climate resilience of grain production.Mechanism analysis indicates that the enhancement of the climate resilience of grain production driven by the policy of high-standard farmland construction is primarily achieved by means of improving the operational efficiency of agricultural mechanization,increasing the proportion of effective irrigation,and expanding the scale of land management.Further analysis shows that the policy of high-standard farmland construction significantly strengthens the resilience of grain production in the face of climate shocks.The findings suggest that the current policy of high-standard farmland construction exhibits overall effectiveness and regional heterogeneity in mitigating climate risks within the grain production system.In the future,it is necessary to refine the policy implementation pathway of the high-standard farmland construction from multiple perspectives,including policy intensity,regional disparities,subsidy support,and policy coordination.This study makes two main contributions.First,by linking high-standard farmland with the climate resilience of grain production,it opens up a new perspective for in-depth research on theories related to agricultural sustainable development.Second,it decomposes climate resilience into vulnerability and resilience,deepens the understanding of the connotation of resilience,and provides targeted decision-making support.The study provides solid empirical evidence for addressing the impact of climate change on grain production,consolidating the title_cn: 品种审定制度市场化改革对科研机构育种创新的影响——兼论种业科技创新体系转型
title_en: The Impact of Market-Oriented Reform on Breeding Innovation of Scientific Research Institutions:Discussion on the Transformation of Scientific and Technological Innovation System
authors_cn: 雷馨圆 | 仇焕广 | 王术坤
authors_en_and_affiliations: LEI Xinyuan;QIU Huanguang;WANG Shukun(College of Economics and Management,Fujian Agriculture and Forestry University;School of Economics,Liaoning University;Rural Development Institute,Chinese Academy of Social Sciences)
institutions_cn: 福建农林大学经济与管理学院 | 辽宁大学经济学院 | 中国社会科学院农村发展研究所
index_title: 品种审定制度市场化改革对科研机构育种创新的影响——兼论种业科技创新体系转型
abstract_cn: 有效激励科研机构专注公益性育种、构建适应新时代发展需要的种业科技创新体系,是推进种业振兴行动需要解决的关键问题。本文在理论上分析了品种审定制度市场化改革对科研机构育种创新的影响,在此基础上利用2012-2021年全国1575个科研机构的品种审定数据,实证分析了品种审定制度市场化改革对科研机构公益性育种和商业化育种的影响。研究发现:品种审定制度市场化改革在强化科研机构公益性育种的同时,也能显著激励其商业化育种行为;拓展性分析表明,改革显著提升了商业化育种中高质量品种的数量,但高质量品种的占比并未显著提高。基于上述结论,本文进一步讨论了种业科技创新体系转型的必要性,重点从提升科研机构公益性育种收益、强化种业企业商业化育种优势两个方面探讨其转型逻辑,构建了以政府制度保障为基础、科研机构公益性育种为支撑、企业商业化育种为核心的种业科技创新体系运行机制,并提出相应的政策建议。
abstract_en: The seed industry is vital to national food security and agricultural productivity.Within China’s seed scientific and technological innovation system,commercial breeding and public breeding are the two essential pillars.Enterprises have led commercial breeding,while research institutes have shouldered both public and commercial breeding.To improve coordination,the Chinese government has promoted a clearer functional division and collaboration between research institutions and seed enterprises.The 2016 market-oriented reform of the variety approval system(hereafter,the market-oriented reform)diversified approval standards and expanded channels.Yet,its impact on research institutions’breeding behavior remains unclear.Specifically,how have these institutions adjusted their breeding orientation and innovation quality in response to the reform?Addressing this question is crucial for assessing the reform's effectiveness and the compatibility of the current innovation system with the marketization trend.This study first establishes a theoretical framework to analyze how the market-oriented reform affects breeding innovation by research institutions.It then empirically analyzes a comprehensive dataset of 1,575 research institutions nationwide from 2012 to 2021,capturing all officially approved crop varieties.The analysis examines the reform's dual effects on both commercial and public breeding,and investigates whether it promoted institutional specialization or intensified role mismatch.The results reveal two key findings.First,the market-oriented reform strengthened public breeding,but also stimulated commercial breeding activities in research institutions.,indicating a functional mismatch as the latter is an enterprise role.Second,the market-oriented reform improved the quality of research institutions’commercial breeding outcomes without changing their quantity-expansion innovation pattern.These findings reveal structural flaws in the current system:under-incentivized public breeding and underutilized commercial breeding capabilities of enterprises.Based on these findings,the paper proposes a transformation of China’s seed innovation system.The proposed transformation logic emphasizes:(1)enhancing the return mechanisms and institutional guarantees for public breeding within research institutions;and(2)reinforcing enterprises’comparative advantage in market-oriented breeding through intellectual property protection,R&D subsidies,and innovation-driven market access.An integrated mechanism is outlined,grounded in governmental institutional safeguards,supported by research institutions’public breeding,and centered on enterprises’commercial breeding.The study makes two marginal contributions.First,whereas prior works largely focused on theoretical discussions of how-to incentive public breeding,this paper provides the first large-scale empirical evidence linking the 2016 market-oriented reform to research institutions’breeding behavior.Second,it advances the understanding of the institutional compatibility between China’s seed innovation system and
